---
title: "Skill Trends in East Asia"
subtitle: "Insights from Online Job Postings"
date: today
format:
  html:
    theme:
      light: cosmo
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 3
    toc-location: right
    smooth-scroll: true
    code-fold: show
    embed-resources: true
    fig-width: 9
    fig-height: 6
include-in-header:
  text: |
    <link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,">
    <style>
      :root {
        --bg-soft: #f8fafc;
        --ink-strong: #0f172a;
        --ink-mid: #334155;
        --card-border: #e2e8f0;
        --brand: #2563eb;
        --brand-2: #0891b2;
        --brand-3: #7c3aed;
      }

      body {
        color: var(--ink-mid);
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f8fbff 0%, #ffffff 40%);
        font-feature-settings: "ss01", "cv01";
      }

      #quarto-document-content p,
      #quarto-document-content li,
      #quarto-document-content dd {
        text-align: justify;
        text-justify: inter-word;
      }

      #title-block-header {
        margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
      }

      #title-block-header .title {
        font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 4.2vw, 3.35rem);
        line-height: 1.06;
        letter-spacing: -0.03em;
        color: var(--ink-strong);
      }

      #title-block-header .subtitle,
      #title-block-header p.subtitle {
        font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 2vw, 1.55rem);
        line-height: 1.2;
        color: #475569;
        margin-top: 0.45rem;
      }

      .report-eyebrow {
        display: block;
        color: #94a3b8;
        letter-spacing: 0.16em;
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 0.76rem;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
      }

      .hero {
        border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
        background: radial-gradient(1200px 280px at 0% 0%, #dbeafe 0%, #f8fafc 55%, #ffffff 100%);
        border-radius: 18px;
        padding: 1.4rem 1.2rem 1rem 1.2rem;
        margin: 0.2rem 0 1.2rem 0;
        box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06);
      }

      .hero h2 {
        margin-top: 0.2rem;
        margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
        color: var(--ink-strong);
        letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      }

      .hero p {
        margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
        text-align: justify;
      }

      .kpi-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(150px, 1fr));
        gap: 0.8rem;
        margin: 0.8rem 0 1.4rem 0;
      }

      .kpi-card {
        background: white;
        border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
        border-radius: 14px;
        padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05);
      }

      .kpi-label {
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        color: #64748b;
        margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      }

      .kpi-value {
        color: var(--ink-strong);
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 1.3rem;
        line-height: 1.2;
      }

      .section-card {
        background: #fff;
        border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
        border-radius: 16px;
        padding: 1rem 1rem 0.4rem 1rem;
        margin: 0.8rem 0 1rem 0;
        box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04);
      }

      .step-detail {
        border-left: 3px solid #cbd5e1;
        padding: 0.6rem 0 0.6rem 1.2rem;
        margin: 1.2rem 0;
      }

      .step-detail h4 {
        font-size: 1.05rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
        color: #0f172a;
      }

      .step-detail .step-badge {
        display: inline-block;
        font-size: 0.72rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        padding: 0.15rem 0.55rem;
        border-radius: 999px;
        margin-right: 0.4rem;
        vertical-align: middle;
      }

      .step-detail .step-badge-blue   { background: #e0f2fe; color: #0369a1; }
      .step-detail .step-badge-amber  { background: #fef3c7; color: #b45309; }
      .step-detail .step-badge-teal   { background: #ccfbf1; color: #0d9488; }
      .step-detail .step-badge-violet { background: #ede9fe; color: #7c3aed; }
      .step-detail .step-badge-indigo { background: #dbeafe; color: #1d4ed8; }
      .step-detail .step-badge-green  { background: #dcfce7; color: #15803d; }

      .cell[data-engine="mermaid"] .cell-output-display,
      .quarto-figure {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
      }

      .pipeline-jump-note {
        margin-top: 0.25rem;
        margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
        font-size: 0.88rem;
        color: #64748b;
      }

      .table caption {
        caption-side: bottom;
        color: #64748b;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        padding-top: 0.5rem;
      }

      .table thead th {
        background: #f1f5f9;
        color: #0f172a;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
      }

      .table tbody tr:hover {
        background: #f8fafc;
      }

      .market-table th {
        user-select: none;
        cursor: pointer;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }

      .market-table th.active-sort {
        color: var(--ink-strong);
      }

      .market-table td,
      .market-table th {
        vertical-align: middle;
      }

      .market-row-high td {
        background: #f8fbff;
      }

      .market-row-upper_middle td {
        background: #fffdf7;
      }

      .market-row-lower_middle td {
        background: #f7fdfa;
      }

      .market-row-benchmark td {
        background: #fbf9ff;
      }

      .market-table tbody tr:hover td {
        filter: brightness(0.985);
      }

      .source-note {
        margin-top: 0.95rem;
        padding-top: 0.8rem;
        border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
      }

      .source-note-label {
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        color: #64748b;
        margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
      }

      .source-links {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 0.7rem 1.4rem;
      }

      .source-link {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: baseline;
        gap: 0.28rem;
        color: #0f6cbd;
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 1rem;
        line-height: 1.25;
        text-decoration: none;
        border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(15, 108, 189, 0.28);
        padding-bottom: 0.08rem;
        transition: color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease;
      }

      .source-link:hover,
      .source-link:focus {
        color: #0a5aa0;
        border-bottom-color: rgba(10, 90, 160, 0.5);
      }

      .source-link-ext {
        color: #7fb0d8;
        font-size: 0.9em;
      }

      .paper-link {
        position: relative;
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: baseline;
        gap: 0.28rem;
        color: #0f6cbd;
        font-weight: 700;
        line-height: 1.25;
        text-decoration: none;
        border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(15, 108, 189, 0.28);
        padding-bottom: 0.02rem;
        transition: color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease;
      }

      .paper-link:hover,
      .paper-link:focus {
        color: #0a5aa0;
        border-bottom-color: rgba(10, 90, 160, 0.5);
      }

      .paper-link:hover,
      .paper-link:focus-visible {
        z-index: 20;
      }

      .paper-tooltip {
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
        top: calc(100% + 10px);
        z-index: 100;
        visibility: hidden;
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(-4px);
        transition: opacity 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease, visibility 0s linear 160ms;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        min-width: 14rem;
        max-width: min(26rem, 92vw);
        padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem;
        border-radius: 10px;
        border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
        background: #fff;
        color: var(--ink-mid);
        font-size: 0.8125rem;
        font-weight: 500;
        line-height: 1.5;
        text-align: left;
        text-decoration: none;
        box-shadow: 0 12px 36px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12), 0 0 0 1px rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.9);
        pointer-events: none;
      }

      .paper-tooltip::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        left: 1rem;
        top: -6px;
        width: 10px;
        height: 10px;
        background: #fff;
        border-left: 1px solid var(--card-border);
        border-top: 1px solid var(--card-border);
        transform: rotate(45deg);
      }

      .paper-tooltip em {
        font-style: italic;
        color: var(--ink-strong);
      }

      .paper-link:hover .paper-tooltip,
      .paper-link:focus-visible .paper-tooltip {
        visibility: visible;
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
        transition: opacity 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease, visibility 0s;
      }

      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        .paper-tooltip {
          transition: none;
        }
      }

      .modal-link-btn {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.35rem;
        margin-top: 0.7rem;
        padding: 0.5rem 0.85rem;
        border-radius: 999px;
        border: 1px solid #cfe0f3;
        background: #f8fbff;
        color: #0f6cbd;
        font-weight: 700;
        text-decoration: none;
        cursor: pointer;
      }

      .modal-link-btn:hover,
      .modal-link-btn:focus {
        background: #eef6ff;
        color: #0a5aa0;
        border-color: #b8d2ee;
      }

      .pill {
        display: inline-block;
        border-radius: 999px;
        padding: 0.22rem 0.6rem;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-weight: 600;
      }

      .pill-row {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 0.35rem;
        margin: 0.35rem 0 0.2rem 0;
      }

      .skill-pill-row {
        display: inline-flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 0.28rem;
        vertical-align: middle;
      }

      .skill-pill-common,
      .skill-pill-distinctive {
        display: inline-block;
        border-radius: 999px;
        padding: 0.18rem 0.52rem;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        line-height: 1.25;
        font-weight: 600;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }

      .skill-pill-common {
        background: #dbeafe;
        color: #1d4ed8;
      }

      .skill-pill-distinctive {
        background: #ffedd5;
        color: #9a3412;
      }

      .pill-high { background: #dbeafe; color: #1e3a8a; }
      .pill-upper { background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; }
      .pill-lower { background: #ccfbf1; color: #115e59; }
      .pill-benchmark {
        color: #5b21b6;
        border: 1px solid #c4b5fd;
        background: repeating-linear-gradient(
          -45deg,
          #f5f3ff,
          #f5f3ff 6px,
          #ede9fe 6px,
          #ede9fe 12px
        );
      }

      .map-tooltip {
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 20;
        pointer-events: none;
        opacity: 0;
        min-width: 220px;
        max-width: 280px;
        padding: 0.7rem 0.8rem;
        border-radius: 12px;
        border: 1px solid #dbe3f0;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.97);
        box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.14);
        backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
      }

      .map-tooltip-title {
        color: var(--ink-strong);
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 0.95rem;
        margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
      }

      .map-tooltip-row {
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        color: var(--ink-mid);
        margin: 0.12rem 0;
      }

      .map-tooltip-label {
        color: #64748b;
        font-weight: 600;
      }

      .map-country-active {
        stroke: #0f172a !important;
        stroke-width: 1.2 !important;
        filter: brightness(0.98);
      }

      .cs-tooltip {
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 30;
        pointer-events: none;
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(-2px);
        padding: 0.55rem 0.7rem;
        border-radius: 10px;
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0f172a 0%, #1e293b 100%);
        color: #f8fafc;
        box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.28);
        font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
        white-space: nowrap;
        transition: opacity 0.12s ease;
      }

      .cs-tip-h {
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 0.84rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.01em;
        margin-bottom: 0.18rem;
      }

      .cs-tip-v {
        font-size: 1.15rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        line-height: 1.1;
        color: #93c5fd;
      }

      .cs-tip-v span {
        font-size: 0.72rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: #cbd5e1;
        padding-left: 0.2rem;
      }

      .cs-tip-s {
        margin-top: 0.28rem;
        font-size: 0.76rem;
        color: #cbd5e1;
      }

      .map-controls {
        position: absolute;
        top: 12px;
        left: 12px;
        z-index: 15;
        display: flex;
        gap: 0.4rem;
      }

      .map-control-btn {
        border: 1px solid #dbe3f0;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
        color: #0f172a;
        border-radius: 10px;
        min-width: 2.2rem;
        height: 2.2rem;
        padding: 0 0.65rem;
        font-size: 0.95rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        line-height: 1;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
        backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
        cursor: pointer;
      }

      .map-control-btn:hover,
      .map-control-btn:focus {
        background: #ffffff;
        border-color: #bfd2ea;
      }

      .pipeline-diagram {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
        gap: 0.8rem;
        margin: 1.6rem 0 1rem 0;
        padding: 1rem;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f8fafc 0%, #f1f5f9 100%);
        border-radius: 14px;
        border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
      }

      .pipeline-step {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        text-align: center;
        justify-content: flex-start;
        min-width: 165px;
        max-width: 185px;
        flex: 1;
        padding: 0.9rem 0.8rem 0.95rem 0.8rem;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78);
        border: 1px solid rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.95);
        border-radius: 16px;
        box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05);
        transition: transform 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease;
        cursor: pointer;
      }

      .pipeline-step:hover,
      .pipeline-step:focus-within {
        transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.025);
        box-shadow: 0 18px 34px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.10);
        border-color: #cbd5e1;
      }

      .pipeline-step:focus-visible {
        outline: 3px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.22);
        outline-offset: 2px;
      }

      .pipeline-step-top {
        width: 100%;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 0.7rem;
        margin-bottom: 0.7rem;
      }

      .pipeline-step-number {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        min-width: 2.05rem;
        height: 2.05rem;
        padding: 0 0.45rem;
        border-radius: 999px;
        border: 1px solid #dbe3f0;
        background: #ffffff;
        color: #64748b;
        font-size: 0.73rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
        transition: transform 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease;
      }

      .pipeline-icon {
        width: 60px;
        height: 60px;
        border-radius: 18px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        margin-bottom: 0.7rem;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
        transition: transform 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease, filter 160ms ease;
      }

      .pipeline-step:hover .pipeline-icon,
      .pipeline-step:focus-within .pipeline-icon {
        transform: scale(1.06);
        box-shadow: 0 14px 28px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12);
        filter: saturate(1.06) brightness(1.02);
      }

      .pipeline-step:hover .pipeline-step-number,
      .pipeline-step:focus-within .pipeline-step-number {
        transform: scale(1.04);
        color: var(--ink-strong);
        border-color: #cbd5e1;
        box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
      }

      .pipeline-label {
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 0.96rem;
        color: var(--ink-strong);
        line-height: 1.22;
        margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
        min-height: 2.35rem;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
      }

      .pipeline-detail {
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        color: #64748b;
        line-height: 1.45;
        padding: 0 0.15rem;
        flex: 1;
        display: flex;
        align-items: flex-start;
      }

      .compare-controls {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 0.8rem;
        margin: 0.3rem 0 1rem 0;
      }

      .compare-control {
        min-width: 100%;
      }

      .compare-control label {
        display: block;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: #64748b;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
      }

      .view-toggle-group {
        display: inline-flex;
      }

      .view-toggle-btn {
        border: 1px solid #bfdbfe;
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #f8fbff 100%);
        color: #1d4ed8;
        border-radius: 999px;
        padding: 0.48rem 0.9rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 0.84rem;
        line-height: 1;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: background 140ms ease, color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease;
        box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.10);
      }

      .view-toggle-btn:hover,
      .view-toggle-btn:focus {
        border-color: #93c5fd;
        background: #eff6ff;
        color: #1d4ed8;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.14);
      }

      .view-toggle-btn.active {
        background: #eff6ff;
        border-color: #93c5fd;
        color: #1d4ed8;
        box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.12);
      }

      .country-button-group {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 0.55rem;
      }

      .country-group-wrap {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 1rem;
        align-items: stretch;
      }

      .country-group {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 0.4rem;
        width: 100%;
      }

      .country-group-label {
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.07em;
        color: #94a3b8;
        padding-left: 0.15rem;
      }

      .country-group-pills {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 0.45rem;
      }

      .country-pill {
        border: 1px solid #dbe3f0;
        background: #ffffff;
        color: var(--ink-strong);
        border-radius: 999px;
        padding: 0.5rem 0.8rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        line-height: 1;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: background 140ms ease, color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease, transform 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04);
      }

      .country-pill:hover,
      .country-pill:focus {
        transform: translateY(-1px);
        border-color: #bfd2ea;
      }

      .country-pill.active {
        background: #eff6ff;
        border-color: #93c5fd;
        color: #1d4ed8;
        box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.12);
      }

      .country-pill.disabled {
        background: #f8fafc;
        color: #94a3b8;
        border-color: #e2e8f0;
        cursor: not-allowed;
        box-shadow: none;
      }

      .compare-helper {
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        color: #94a3b8;
      }

      .compare-note {
        font-size: 0.84rem;
        color: #64748b;
        margin: 0.2rem 0 0.9rem 0;
      }

      .compare-charts {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 1rem;
      }

      .compare-panel-title {
        font-size: 1.05rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--ink-strong);
        margin: 0.2rem 0 0.45rem 0;
      }

      .heat-tip {
        position: absolute;
        pointer-events: none;
        z-index: 30;
        background: #0f172a;
        color: #f8fafc;
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 7px 10px;
        font-size: 0.74rem;
        line-height: 1.35;
        box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.28);
        max-width: 280px;
        transition: opacity .12s ease;
      }

      .heat-tip-c { font-weight: 700; }
      .heat-tip-r { color: #cbd5e1; margin-top: 2px; }
      .heat-tip-v { font-weight: 800; margin-top: 3px; font-size: 0.92rem; }

      .heat-legend {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 0.3rem 0.85rem;
        margin: 0.5rem 0 0.2rem 0;
      }

      .heat-legend-item {
        display: flex;
        align-items: baseline;
        gap: 0.3rem;
        font-size: 0.74rem;
      }

      .heat-legend-code {
        font-weight: 800;
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }

      .heat-legend-label { color: #64748b; }

      .heat-legend-box {
        padding: 0.55rem 0.7rem;

    <script>
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        const title = document.querySelector("#title-block-header .title");
        if (title && !document.querySelector(".report-eyebrow")) {
          const tag = document.createElement("span");
          tag.className = "report-eyebrow";
          tag.textContent = "ANALYTICAL NOTE";
          title.parentNode.insertBefore(tag, title);
        }

        document.querySelectorAll(".pipeline-step[data-target]").forEach(function (step) {
          const activate = function () {
            const targetId = step.getAttribute("data-target");
            const target = document.getElementById(targetId);
            if (!target) return;
            target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
          };

          step.addEventListener("click", activate);
          step.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
            if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
              event.preventDefault();
              activate();
            }
          });
        });
      });
    </script>

::: {.hero}
## Executive Summary

This report analyses labour demand in East Asia through
the lens of online job advertisements, with a focus on how employers
signal required skills across occupations and markets. It combines
labour-market analysis with modern NLP methods, including automated
translation, sentence-level classification, and LLM-assisted skill
extraction, to turn unstructured vacancy text into comparable measures
of skill demand.

Using ESCO-based mappings, the report compares the composition of
requested skills and knowledge areas across countries, with special
focus on digital competencies and indicators of relative labour demand
derived from job posting intensity. Labour markets across East Asia are
undergoing
rapid transformation, with increasing digitization reshaping how
employers search for talent. Online job postings (OJPs) provide a useful
proxy for real-time labour demand, particularly for mid- and high-skill
occupations.
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false

topojson = import("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/topojson-client@3/+esm")

world = fetch(
  "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/world-atlas@2/countries-110m.json"
).then(r => r.json())

// ISO 3166-1 numeric → label + income group + offer counts
countryMeta = ({
  "392": { name: "Japan",        group: "high",         iso3: "JPN", offers: 302262 },
  "410": { name: "South Korea",  group: "high",         iso3: "KOR", offers: 169933 },
  "158": { name: "Taiwan",       group: "high",         iso3: "TWN", offers: 117672 },
  "702": { name: "Singapore",    group: "high",         iso3: "SGP", offers: 149582 },
  "764": { name: "Thailand",     group: "upper_middle", iso3: "THA", offers: 65544 },
  "360": { name: "Indonesia",    group: "upper_middle", iso3: "IDN", offers: 113505 },
  "458": { name: "Malaysia",     group: "upper_middle", iso3: "MYS", offers: 176662 },
  "704": { name: "Vietnam",      group: "lower_middle", iso3: "VNM", offers: 134424 },
  "608": { name: "Philippines",  group: "lower_middle", iso3: "PHL", offers: 175615 },
  "356": { name: "India",        group: "benchmark",    iso3: "IND", offers: 223220 },
})

benchmarkMeta = ([
  { name: "Mexico", group: "benchmark", iso3: "MEX", offers: 219762 },
  { name: "Poland", group: "benchmark", iso3: "POL", offers: 134784 },
])

mapBenchmarkMetaById = ({
  "484": { name: "Mexico", group: "benchmark", iso3: "MEX", offers: 219762 },
  "616": { name: "Poland", group: "benchmark", iso3: "POL", offers: 134784 },
})

allMarketMeta = [
  ...Object.values(countryMeta),
  ...benchmarkMeta,
]

palette = ({
  high:         "#1d4ed8",
  upper_middle: "#f59e0b",
  lower_middle: "#0d9488",
  benchmark:    "#7c3aed",
  bg:        "#f1f5f9",
  border:    "#ffffff",
  ocean:     "#eff6ff",
  land:      "#e2e8f0",
})

// Label anchor positions [lon, lat] with nudge
labelAnchors = [
  { id: "392", lon: 140,  lat: 37,   dx: 8,  dy: 0   },
  { id: "410", lon: 128,  lat: 36,   dx: -45,dy: 12  },
  { id: "158", lon: 121,  lat: 23.5, dx: 8,  dy: 8   },
  { id: "764", lon: 101,  lat: 14,   dx: -10,dy: 16  },
  { id: "704", lon: 107,  lat: 16,   dx: 10, dy: 0   },
  { id: "458", lon: 109,  lat: 3,    dx: -50,dy: -8  },
  { id: "608", lon: 122,  lat: 12,   dx: 10, dy: 0   },
  { id: "702", lon: 104,  lat: 1.3,  dx: -55,dy: 8   },
  { id: "360", lon: 118,  lat: -2,   dx: 0,  dy: 14  },
  { id: "356", lon: 79,   lat: 22,   dx: -10,dy: 0   },
  { id: "484", lon: -102, lat: 23,   dx: 10, dy: 0   },
  { id: "616", lon: 19,   lat: 52,   dx: 8,  dy: 0   },
]

laborForceOverrides = ({
  TWN: { year: 2025, value: 12028000 },
})

laborForceByIso3 = Object.fromEntries(await Promise.all(
  [...new Set(allMarketMeta.map(d => d.iso3))].map(async iso3 => {
    if (laborForceOverrides[iso3]) {
      return [iso3, laborForceOverrides[iso3]]
    }
    const url = `https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/${iso3}/indicator/SL.TLF.TOTL.IN?format=json&per_page=3`
    const data = await fetch(url).then(r => r.json())
    const row = (data?.[1] || []).find(d => d.value != null)
    return [iso3, row ? { year: Number(row.date), value: Number(row.value) } : null]
  })
))

gdpGrowthOverrides = ({
  TWN: { year: 2025, value: 8.63 },
})

gdpGrowthByIso3 = Object.fromEntries(await Promise.all(
  [...new Set(allMarketMeta.map(d => d.iso3))].map(async iso3 => {
    if (gdpGrowthOverrides[iso3]) {
      return [iso3, gdpGrowthOverrides[iso3]]
    }
    const url = `https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/${iso3}/indicator/NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG?format=json&per_page=3`
    const data = await fetch(url).then(r => r.json())
    const row = (data?.[1] || []).find(d => d.value != null)
    return [iso3, row ? { year: Number(row.date), value: Number(row.value) } : null]
  })
))

fmtInt = d3.format(",")
fmtRate = d3.format(".1f")

groupLabels = ({
  high: "High-income",
  upper_middle: "Upper-middle-income",
  lower_middle: "Lower-middle-income",
  benchmark: "Benchmark",
})

metricsFor = (meta) => {
  const lf = laborForceByIso3[meta.iso3]
  const gdp = gdpGrowthByIso3[meta.iso3]
  return {
    ...meta,
    income_group: groupLabels[meta.group],
    labor_force: lf?.value ?? null,
    labor_force_year: lf?.year ?? null,
    real_gdp_growth_2025: gdp?.value ?? null,
    real_gdp_growth_year: gdp?.year ?? null,
    offers_per_100k: (meta.offers != null && lf?.value)
      ? (meta.offers / lf.value) * 100000
      : null,
  }
}

countryRowsById = Object.fromEntries(
  Object.entries(countryMeta).map(([id, meta]) => [id, metricsFor(meta)])
)

mapRowsById = Object.fromEntries(
  [...Object.entries(countryMeta), ...Object.entries(mapBenchmarkMetaById)]
    .map(([id, meta]) => [id, metricsFor(meta)])
)

benchmarkRows = benchmarkMeta.map(metricsFor)

groupOrder = ({ high: 0, upper_middle: 1, lower_middle: 2, benchmark: 3 })

reportRows = [...Object.values(countryRowsById), ...benchmarkRows]
  .sort((a, b) => groupOrder[a.group] - groupOrder[b.group] || b.offers - a.offers)

tooltipHtml = (row) => {
  const offersText = row.offers == null ? "n/a" : fmtInt(row.offers)
  const lfText = row.labor_force == null ? "n/a" : fmtInt(row.labor_force)
  const per100k = row.offers_per_100k == null ? "n/a" : fmtRate(row.offers_per_100k)
  const gdpText = row.real_gdp_growth_2025 == null ? "n/a" : fmtRate(row.real_gdp_growth_2025)
  const lfYear = row.labor_force_year ? ` (${row.labor_force_year})` : ""
  return `
    <div class="map-tooltip-title">${row.name}</div>
    <div class="map-tooltip-row"><span class="map-tooltip-label">Income group:</span> ${row.income_group}</div>
    <div class="map-tooltip-row"><span class="map-tooltip-label">Job offers:</span> ${offersText}</div>
    <div class="map-tooltip-row"><span class="map-tooltip-label">Labor force${lfYear}:</span> ${lfText}</div>
    <div class="map-tooltip-row"><span class="map-tooltip-label">Offers per 100k LF:</span> ${per100k}</div>
    <div class="map-tooltip-row"><span class="map-tooltip-label">Real GDP growth (2025):</span> ${gdpText}%</div>
  `
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| fig-cap: "Analyzed countries grouped by income status."

{
  const W = 860, H = 560;
  const container = d3.create("div")
    .style("position", "relative")
    .style("max-width", "100%")
    .style("overflow", "hidden");

  const tooltip = container.append("div")
    .attr("class", "map-tooltip");

  const controls = container.append("div")
    .attr("class", "map-controls");

  const projection = d3.geoMercator()
    .center([108, 18])
    .scale(480)
    .translate([W / 2, H / 2]);

  const path = d3.geoPath(projection);

  const land = topojson.feature(world, world.objects.countries);

  const svg = container.append("svg")
    .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, W, H])
    .attr("width", W)
    .attr("height", H)
    .style("max-width", "100%")
    .style("height", "auto")
    .style("font-family", "system-ui, sans-serif");

  // Ocean and subtle background grid feel
  svg.append("rect")
    .attr("width", W).attr("height", H)
    .attr("fill", palette.ocean);

  const mapLayer = svg.append("g");

  // Stripe pattern for benchmark country (India)
  const defs = svg.append("defs");
  const hatch = defs.append("pattern")
    .attr("id", "benchmarkHatch")
    .attr("patternUnits", "userSpaceOnUse")
    .attr("width", 8)
    .attr("height", 8)
    .attr("patternTransform", "rotate(45)");

  hatch.append("rect")
    .attr("width", 8)
    .attr("height", 8)
    .attr("fill", "#f5f3ff");

  hatch.append("line")
    .attr("x1", 0).attr("y1", 0)
    .attr("x2", 0).attr("y2", 8)
    .attr("stroke", palette.benchmark)
    .attr("stroke-width", 2);

  const showTooltip = (event, row) => {
    const [x, y] = d3.pointer(event, container.node());
    const rect = container.node().getBoundingClientRect();
    const tooltipWidth = 250;
    const tooltipHeight = 120;
    const left = Math.min(rect.width - tooltipWidth - 12, Math.max(12, x + 14));
    const top = Math.min(rect.height - tooltipHeight - 12, Math.max(12, y + 14));
    tooltip
      .html(tooltipHtml(row))
      .style("left", `${left}px`)
      .style("top", `${top}px`)
      .style("opacity", 1);
  };

  const hideTooltip = () => {
    tooltip.style("opacity", 0);
  };

  const zoom = d3.zoom()
    .scaleExtent([0.15, 6])
    .on("zoom", (event) => {
      mapLayer.attr("transform", event.transform);
    });

  svg.call(zoom);

  controls.append("button")
    .attr("class", "map-control-btn")
    .attr("type", "button")
    .attr("title", "Zoom in")
    .text("+")
    .on("click", () => {
      svg.transition().duration(220).call(zoom.scaleBy, 1.35);
    });

  controls.append("button")
    .attr("class", "map-control-btn")
    .attr("type", "button")
    .attr("title", "Zoom out")
    .text("−")
    .on("click", () => {
      svg.transition().duration(220).call(zoom.scaleBy, 1 / 1.35);
    });

  controls.append("button")
    .attr("class", "map-control-btn")
    .attr("type", "button")
    .attr("title", "Reset view")
    .style("min-width", "auto")
    .text("Reset")
    .on("click", () => {
      svg.transition().duration(260).call(zoom.transform, d3.zoomIdentity);
    });

  // Countries
  const countryPaths = mapLayer.selectAll("path.country")
    .data(land.features)
    .join("path")
      .attr("class", "country")
      .attr("d", path)
      .attr("fill", d => {
        const m = mapRowsById[d.id];
        if (!m) return palette.land;
        return m.group === "benchmark" ? "url(#benchmarkHatch)" : palette[m.group];
      })
      .attr("stroke", palette.border)
      .attr("stroke-width", 0.5)
      .attr("opacity", d => mapRowsById[d.id] ? 1 : 0.6)
      .style("cursor", d => mapRowsById[d.id] ? "pointer" : "default");

  countryPaths
    .filter(d => mapRowsById[d.id])
    .on("mouseenter", function(event, d) {
      d3.select(this).classed("map-country-active", true);
      showTooltip(event, mapRowsById[d.id]);
    })
    .on("mousemove", function(event, d) {
      showTooltip(event, mapRowsById[d.id]);
    })
    .on("mouseleave", function() {
      d3.select(this).classed("map-country-active", false);
      hideTooltip();
    });

  // Small-country markers (Singapore is invisible at 110m)
  for (const anc of labelAnchors) {
    if (anc.id === "702") {
      const [cx, cy] = projection([anc.lon, anc.lat]);
      const m = mapRowsById[anc.id];
      mapLayer.append("circle")
        .attr("cx", cx).attr("cy", cy).attr("r", 4)
        .attr("fill", m.group === "benchmark" ? palette.benchmark : palette[m.group])
        .attr("stroke", palette.border)
        .attr("stroke-width", 1)
        .style("cursor", "pointer")
        .on("mouseenter", (event) => showTooltip(event, m))
        .on("mousemove", (event) => showTooltip(event, m))
        .on("mouseleave", hideTooltip);
    }
  }

  // Labels
  const labels = mapLayer.append("g").attr("class", "labels");

  for (const anc of labelAnchors) {
    const [x, y] = projection([anc.lon, anc.lat]);
    const m = mapRowsById[anc.id];
    if (!m) continue;

    labels.append("text")
      .attr("x", x + (anc.dx || 0))
      .attr("y", y + (anc.dy || 0))
      .attr("text-anchor", "start")
      .attr("font-size", "11px")
      .attr("font-weight", 600)
      .attr("fill", "#1e293b")
      .attr("paint-order", "stroke")
      .attr("stroke", "#ffffffcc")
      .attr("stroke-width", 3)
      .text(m.name);
  }

  // Legend
  const lg = svg.append("g")
    .attr("transform", `translate(20, ${H - 106})`);

  const items = [
    { label: "High-income economies", color: palette.high, hatch: false },
    { label: "Upper-middle-income economies", color: palette.upper_middle, hatch: false },
    { label: "Lower-middle-income economies", color: palette.lower_middle, hatch: false },
    { label: "Benchmark", color: palette.benchmark, hatch: true },
  ];

  items.forEach(({ label, color, hatch }, i) => {
    const marker = lg.append("rect")
      .attr("x", 0).attr("y", i * 22)
      .attr("width", 14).attr("height", 14)
      .attr("rx", 2)
      .attr("fill", color);
    if (hatch) {
      marker
        .attr("fill", "url(#benchmarkHatch)")
        .attr("stroke", color)
        .attr("stroke-width", 1);
    }
    lg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 20).attr("y", i * 22 + 12)
      .attr("font-size", "12px")
      .attr("fill", "#334155")
      .text(label);
  });

  return container.node();
}
```

### Relative labour demand

The table below summarizes the absolute number of job offers and the number of
offers per 100,000 people in the labor force. This allows us to compare
both the scale of observed hiring and its intensity relative to each
country's labour supply. Click a column header to sort the table.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

{
  const rows = reportRows.map(d => ({
    country: d.name,
    group: d.group,
    income_group: d.income_group,
    offers: d.offers,
    offers_per_100k: d.offers_per_100k,
    real_gdp_growth_2025: d.real_gdp_growth_2025,
  }));

  const table = d3.create("table")
    .attr("class", "table table-sm align-middle market-table");

  const columns = [
    { key: "country", label: "Country", type: "text" },
    { key: "income_group", label: "Income group", type: "text" },
    { key: "offers", label: "Job offers", type: "number" },
    { key: "offers_per_100k", label: "Offers per 100k labor force", type: "number" },
    { key: "real_gdp_growth_2025", label: "Real GDP growth (2025)", type: "number" },
  ];

  let sortKey = "income_group";
  let sortDirection = "asc";

  const thead = table.append("thead");
  const headerRow = thead.append("tr");
  const tbody = table.append("tbody");

  const sortRows = () => {
    const sorted = [...rows].sort((a, b) => {
      if (sortKey === "income_group") {
        const cmp = groupOrder[a.group] - groupOrder[b.group];
        if (cmp !== 0) return sortDirection === "asc" ? cmp : -cmp;
        return b.offers - a.offers;
      }
      const av = a[sortKey];
      const bv = b[sortKey];
      if (av == null && bv == null) return 0;
      if (av == null) return 1;
      if (bv == null) return -1;
      const cmp = columns.find(c => c.key === sortKey).type === "text"
        ? String(av).localeCompare(String(bv))
        : av - bv;
      return sortDirection === "asc" ? cmp : -cmp;
    });
    return sorted;
  };

  const renderBody = () => {
    tbody.selectAll("tr").remove();
    sortRows().forEach(row => {
      const tr = tbody.append("tr")
        .attr("class", `market-row-${row.group}`);
      tr.append("td").text(row.country);
      tr.append("td").text(row.income_group);
      tr.append("td").style("text-align", "right").text(fmtInt(row.offers));
      tr.append("td")
        .style("text-align", "right")
        .text(row.offers_per_100k == null ? "n/a" : fmtRate(row.offers_per_100k));
      tr.append("td")
        .style("text-align", "right")
        .text(row.real_gdp_growth_2025 == null ? "n/a" : `${fmtRate(row.real_gdp_growth_2025)}%`);
    });
  };

  columns.forEach(col => {
    headerRow.append("th")
      .attr("class", col.key === sortKey ? "active-sort" : null)
      .text(`${col.label}${col.key === sortKey ? (sortDirection === "asc" ? " ↑" : " ↓") : ""}`)
      .on("click", function() {
        if (sortKey === col.key) {
          sortDirection = sortDirection === "asc" ? "desc" : "asc";
        } else {
          sortKey = col.key;
          sortDirection = col.type === "text" ? "asc" : "desc";
        }
        headerRow.selectAll("th")
          .attr("class", d => null)
          .text((d, i) => {
            const c = columns[i];
            return `${c.label}${c.key === sortKey ? (sortDirection === "asc" ? " ↑" : " ↓") : ""}`;
          });
        headerRow.selectAll("th")
          .filter((d, i) => columns[i].key === sortKey)
          .attr("class", "active-sort");
        renderBody();
      });
  });

  renderBody();

  return table.node();
}
```

## Data and Methodology

::: {.section-card}
### Data collection

We collect job advertisements from **Indeed** and **Careerjet**, two large
aggregators with country-specific sites across the markets covered in this
study. The analytical sample shown here comprises **1,982,965 postings**
covering March 2025 – April 2026. Collection ran **daily for a full year**
because high-volume portals often stop returning results after a limited
number of pages. Collecting every day reduced the risk of missing vacancies
that would no longer be reachable if the portals were queried less frequently.

```{=html}
<button type="button" class="modal-link-btn" data-bs-toggle="modal" data-bs-target="#dataCollectionModal">
  Read more
  <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
</button>

<div class="modal fade" id="dataCollectionModal" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="dataCollectionModalLabel" aria-hidden="true">
  <div class="modal-dialog modal-lg modal-dialog-scrollable">
    <div class="modal-content">
      <div class="modal-header">
        <h5 class="modal-title" id="dataCollectionModalLabel">Data collection details</h5>
        <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal" aria-label="Close"></button>
      </div>
      <div class="modal-body">
        <p>We use two aggregators: <strong>Indeed</strong>, the most established platform in the sample, and <strong>Careerjet</strong>, a newer but growing platform. We selected them because both provide dedicated country-level sites across the markets included in the analysis.</p>
        <p>For all country-platform combinations, we developed Python web scrapers that retrieve job postings and extract core information such as job title, job description, company name, salary, job and company location, posting date, contract type, remote-work status, industry, company size and revenue, and the original job-post URL.</p>
        <p>Because attribute availability varies across postings, we restrict the analytical sample to offers containing at least a job title, a job description, and the original URL. We additionally remove duplicates with identical titles and descriptions, both within each job board and across boards.</p>
        <p>Both portals impose practical result limits for broad queries. Indeed typically exposes up to 1,000 postings and Careerjet up to 2,000. To improve coverage, we run multiple searches by region within each country and monitor cases where the maximum visible result count is returned, since that suggests that additional postings may be omitted.</p>
        <p>The collection pipeline ran daily over a full year. This high-frequency collection schedule helped us capture changing posting intensity over time, while also reducing the risk that short-lived vacancies would be systematically missed.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

:::

::: {.section-card}
### Postings per employer

Online vacancies are not evenly spread across firms: in every market a small
number of high-volume recruiters and large employers account for a
disproportionate share of postings, while most companies appear only once or
twice. The cards below show the **average number of postings per employer**,
with the median shown alongside it as a robust reference point, together with
the distribution of employer posting volumes in each country. Click a country to
see its **top 10 employers by posting volume**.

```{ojs}
{
  const data = employerStats;
  const groups = ["East Asia", "Benchmark"];
  const byGroup = g => Object.keys(data)
    .filter(c => data[c].group === g)
    .sort((a, b) => data[b].mean - data[a].mean || data[b].gini - data[a].gini);

  const bucketKeys = ["1", "2", "3-5", "6-10", "11+"];
  const bucketColors = {"1": "#cbd5e1", "2": "#93c5fd", "3-5": "#60a5fa", "6-10": "#3b82f6", "11+": "#1d4ed8"};
  const bucketLabel = {"1": "1 posting", "2": "2", "3-5": "3–5", "6-10": "6–10", "11+": "11+"};
  const fmt = d3.format(",");
  const numfmt = v => Number.isInteger(v) ? `${v}` : v.toFixed(1);

  const root = d3.create("div").style("font-family", "system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif");

  // legend
  const legend = root.append("div")
    .style("display", "flex").style("flex-wrap", "wrap").style("gap", "0.4rem 1rem")
    .style("align-items", "center").style("font-size", "0.8rem").style("color", "#475569")
    .style("margin", "0 0 0.9rem 0");
  legend.append("span").style("font-weight", "600").text("Employers by posting volume:");
  bucketKeys.forEach(k => {
    const it = legend.append("span").style("display", "inline-flex").style("align-items", "center").style("gap", "0.3rem");
    it.append("span").style("width", "11px").style("height", "11px").style("border-radius", "3px").style("background", bucketColors[k]);
    it.append("span").text(bucketLabel[k]);
  });

  function card(grid, c) {
    const d = data[c];
    const card = grid.append("div")
      .style("border", "1px solid #e2e8f0").style("border-radius", "10px")
      .style("padding", "0.9rem 1rem").style("cursor", "pointer")
      .style("transition", "box-shadow .15s, border-color .15s").style("background", "#fff");
    card.on("mouseover", function () { d3.select(this).style("box-shadow", "0 4px 14px rgba(15,23,42,.10)").style("border-color", "#cbd5e1"); });
    card.on("mouseout", function () { d3.select(this).style("box-shadow", "none").style("border-color", "#e2e8f0"); });
    card.on("click", () => openModal(c));

    const head = card.append("div").style("display", "flex").style("justify-content", "space-between").style("align-items", "baseline");
    head.append("div").style("font-weight", "700").style("font-size", "0.98rem").text(c);
    head.append("div").style("font-size", "0.72rem").style("color", "#3b82f6").style("font-weight", "600").text("Top 10 ↗");

    const big = card.append("div").style("margin", "0.5rem 0 0.1rem 0").style("display", "flex").style("align-items", "baseline").style("gap", "0.4rem");
    big.append("span").style("font-size", "1.7rem").style("font-weight", "800").style("color", "#0f172a").text(d.mean.toFixed(1));
    big.append("span").style("font-size", "0.8rem").style("color", "#64748b").text(`median ${numfmt(d.median)}`);
    card.append("div").style("font-size", "0.74rem").style("color", "#64748b").style("margin-bottom", "0.1rem").text("avg postings per employer");
    card.append("div").style("font-size", "0.74rem").style("color", "#94a3b8")
      .text(`${fmt(d.n_employers)} employers · ${fmt(d.n_ads)} ads`);

    const barWrap = card.append("div").style("margin-top", "0.7rem");
    const bar = barWrap.append("div")
      .style("display", "flex").style("height", "14px").style("border-radius", "4px")
      .style("overflow", "hidden").style("background", "#f1f5f9");
    bucketKeys.forEach(k => {
      const v = d.dist[k] || 0;
      if (v <= 0) return;
      bar.append("div")
        .style("width", `${v}%`).style("background", bucketColors[k])
        .attr("title", `${bucketLabel[k]}: ${v}% of employers`);
    });
  }

  groups.forEach(g => {
    const members = byGroup(g);
    if (!members.length) return;
    root.append("div")
      .style("font-size", "0.72rem").style("font-weight", "700").style("letter-spacing", "0.05em")
      .style("text-transform", "uppercase").style("color", "#94a3b8")
      .style("margin", g === groups[0] ? "0 0 0.5rem 0" : "1.3rem 0 0.5rem 0")
      .text(g);
    const grid = root.append("div")
      .style("display", "grid")
      .style("grid-template-columns", "repeat(auto-fill, minmax(250px, 1fr))")
      .style("gap", "0.9rem");
    members.forEach(c => card(grid, c));
  });

  // ---- Gini concentration chart ----
  root.append("h5")
    .style("margin", "1.8rem 0 0.2rem 0").style("font-size", "1rem")
    .text("Concentration of postings across employers (Gini)");
  root.append("p")
    .style("margin", "0 0 0.9rem 0").style("font-size", "0.85rem").style("color", "#475569")
    .text("Online vacancy postings are highly concentrated across employers in every market, with Gini values ranging from 0.48 to 0.84 — meaning a small number of recruiters account for a disproportionate share of advertised vacancies everywhere. Concentration is highest in Thailand, Poland and Indonesia, and notably lower in South Korea. These figures capture the concentration of online posting activity rather than underlying labour-market structure, and elevated values are commonly driven by recruitment agencies and job aggregators that post at volume on behalf of multiple employers.");

  const gColor = c => data[c].group === "Benchmark" ? "#f59e0b" : "#2563eb";
  const rowH = 26, labelW = 110, valW = 46;
  const gx = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0, 1]).range([0, 100]);
  const giniWrap = root.append("div").style("margin-top", "0.3rem");
  groups.forEach((g, idx) => {
    const giniOrder = Object.keys(data)
      .filter(c => data[c].group === g)
      .sort((a, b) => data[b].gini - data[a].gini);
    if (!giniOrder.length) return;
    giniWrap.append("div")
      .style("font-size", "0.72rem").style("font-weight", "700").style("letter-spacing", "0.05em")
      .style("text-transform", "uppercase").style("color", "#94a3b8")
      .style("margin", idx === 0 ? "0 0 0.35rem 0" : "0.9rem 0 0.35rem 0")
      .text(g);
    giniOrder.forEach(c => {
      const d = data[c];
      const r = giniWrap.append("div").style("display", "flex").style("align-items", "center").style("height", `${rowH}px`).style("gap", "0.5rem");
      r.append("div").style("width", `${labelW}px`).style("flex", "none").style("font-size", "0.82rem").style("text-align", "right").style("color", "#334155").text(c);
      const track = r.append("div").style("flex", "1").style("background", "#f1f5f9").style("border-radius", "4px").style("height", "13px").style("position", "relative");
      track.append("div").style("height", "100%").style("border-radius", "4px").style("background", gColor(c)).style("width", `${gx(d.gini)}%`);
      r.append("div").style("width", `${valW}px`).style("flex", "none").style("font-size", "0.82rem").style("font-weight", "700").style("color", "#0f172a").text(d.gini.toFixed(3));
    });
  });
  const gl = giniWrap.append("div").style("display", "flex").style("gap", "1.2rem").style("margin-top", "0.5rem").style("font-size", "0.78rem").style("color", "#64748b");
  [["East Asia", "#2563eb"], ["Benchmark", "#f59e0b"]].forEach(([lab, col]) => {
    const it = gl.append("span").style("display", "inline-flex").style("align-items", "center").style("gap", "0.3rem");
    it.append("span").style("width", "11px").style("height", "11px").style("border-radius", "3px").style("background", col);
    it.append("span").text(lab);
  });

  // ---- modal ----
  const overlay = d3.select("body").append("div")
    .style("position", "fixed").style("inset", "0").style("background", "rgba(15,23,42,.45)")
    .style("display", "none").style("align-items", "center").style("justify-content", "center")
    .style("z-index", "2000").style("padding", "1rem");
  overlay.on("click", function (e) { if (e.target === this) overlay.style("display", "none"); });

  const dialog = overlay.append("div")
    .style("background", "#fff").style("border-radius", "12px").style("max-width", "560px")
    .style("width", "100%").style("max-height", "85vh").style("overflow", "auto")
    .style("box-shadow", "0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.3)").style("font-family", "system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif");

  function openModal(c) {
    const d = data[c];
    dialog.selectAll("*").remove();
    const hd = dialog.append("div")
      .style("display", "flex").style("justify-content", "space-between").style("align-items", "center")
      .style("padding", "1rem 1.3rem").style("border-bottom", "1px solid #e2e8f0").style("position", "sticky").style("top", "0").style("background", "#fff");
    hd.append("div").call(g => {
      g.append("div").style("font-weight", "700").style("font-size", "1.05rem").text(`${c} — top 10 employers`);
      g.append("div").style("font-size", "0.78rem").style("color", "#64748b")
        .text(`avg ${d.mean.toFixed(1)} · median ${numfmt(d.median)} · Gini ${d.gini.toFixed(3)} · ${fmt(d.n_employers)} employers · ${fmt(d.n_ads)} postings`);
    });
    hd.append("button").style("border", "none").style("background", "transparent").style("font-size", "1.5rem")
      .style("cursor", "pointer").style("color", "#64748b").style("line-height", "1").html("&times;")
      .on("click", () => overlay.style("display", "none"));

    const body = dialog.append("div").style("padding", "0.6rem 1.3rem 1.2rem 1.3rem");
    d.top.forEach((t, i) => {
      const row = body.append("div")
        .style("display", "flex").style("align-items", "baseline").style("gap", "0.55rem")
        .style("padding", "0.5rem 0")
        .style("border-bottom", i < d.top.length - 1 ? "1px solid #f1f5f9" : "none");
      row.append("span").style("color", "#94a3b8").style("font-weight", "700").style("font-size", "0.8rem").style("min-width", "1.5rem").text(`${i + 1}.`);
      const nameCell = row.append("span").style("flex", "1").style("min-width", "0");
      nameCell.append("span").style("font-weight", "600").style("font-size", "0.9rem").text(t.employer);
      if (t.employer_en) {
        nameCell.append("span").style("display", "block").style("font-size", "0.76rem").style("color", "#94a3b8").text(t.employer_en);
      }
      row.append("span").style("font-size", "0.9rem").style("font-weight", "700").style("color", "#0f172a").text(fmt(t.ads));
      row.append("span").style("font-size", "0.8rem").style("color", "#94a3b8").style("min-width", "3rem").style("text-align", "right").text(`${t.share}%`);
    });
    overlay.style("display", "flex");
  }

  return root.node();
}
```

:::


::: {.section-card}
### Processing pipeline

Raw job postings arrive in different languages and contain noisy,
unstructured information. We transform them into a standardised analytic
dataset in six steps: we first identify the posting language, translate
non-English text into a common language, isolate skill-relevant
sentences, map extracted skills to ESCO, standardise job titles to ESCO
occupations using both titles and skill context for disambiguation, and
then enrich each posting with sector information by assigning ISIC/NACE
economic activity codes.

## Results

### Online demand vs. actual employment structure

The table below contrasts the occupational composition of online job
postings (**demand**) with actual employment shares from national
labour force surveys reported to the ILO (**employment**), both at
the ISCO-08 Major Group level (1-digit). Armed forces are excluded
from both the online-posting and official-employment distributions.
For Taiwan, the employment benchmark comes from the official DGBAS
Manpower Survey rather than ILOSTAT; it uses Taiwan's ROC occupational
classification, which is based on ISCO-08 but not ILOSTAT-harmonised.

For each country we compute the **Index of Dissimilarity**, originally
developed to measure residential segregation by race and gender. The
same functional form is widely applied in labour market mismatch
research — for instance,
<a class="paper-link" href="https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s11135-023-01707-7" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Beręsewicz et al. (2024)<span class="source-link-ext">↗</span></a>
uses it to quantify educational and occupational mismatch between
online job postings and employer-survey data in Poland.

$$
\text{Mismatch}_j = \frac{1}{2} \sum_{i} \left| D_{ij} - E_{ij} \right|
$$

where $D_{ij}$ is the share of online job postings in ISCO group $i$
for country $j$ and $E_{ij}$ is the corresponding employment share
from national labour force surveys. The index expresses the percentage
of the employment structure that would need to shift between
occupational groups to match the composition of online demand.

Use the country selector below to browse the detailed breakdown.
The summary bar chart ranks all countries by mismatch.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

{
  const isco1ds = await FileAttachment("isco1_demand_supply.json").json();
  const eaList = ["JP","KR","TW","TH","MY","SG","ID","VN","PH"];
  const bmList = ["IN","MX","PL"];
  const allList = [...eaList, ...bmList];
  const countryFull = {JP:"Japan",KR:"S. Korea",TW:"Taiwan",TH:"Thailand",MY:"Malaysia",SG:"Singapore",ID:"Indonesia",VN:"Vietnam",PH:"Philippines",IN:"India",MX:"Mexico",PL:"Poland"};
  const iscoNames = {
    "0":"Armed forces","1":"Managers","2":"Professionals",
    "2+3":"Professionals & Technicians",
    "3":"Technicians & assoc. prof.","4":"Clerical support",
    "5":"Service & sales","6":"Skilled agriculture",
    "7":"Craft & trades","8":"Plant & machine operators",
    "9":"Elementary occupations"
  };
  const iscoKeys = ["1","2","3","4","5","6","7","8","9"];
  const d = isco1ds;

  const wrap = d3.create("div")
    .style("font-family","system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif")
    .style("font-size","13px").style("max-width","920px");

  /* ──── shared toggle helper ──── */
  const btnStyle = (active) =>
    `padding:6px 18px;font-size:12px;font-weight:${active?700:500};cursor:pointer;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;`
    + `background:${active?"#0f172a":"#fff"};color:${active?"#fff":"#475569"};transition:all .15s`;

  /* ──── 1. MISMATCH BAR CHART ──── */
  wrap.append("div").style("font-weight","700").style("font-size","14px")
    .style("margin-bottom","10px").style("color","#0f172a")
    .text("Index of Dissimilarity by country (pp)");

  const barToggle = wrap.append("div").style("display","flex").style("gap","0").style("margin-bottom","12px");
  const barBtnEA = barToggle.append("button").attr("style", btnStyle(true)+";border-radius:6px 0 0 6px").text("East Asia");
  const barBtnBM = barToggle.append("button").attr("style", btnStyle(false)+";border-radius:0 6px 6px 0;border-left:none").text("Benchmarks");

  const barHost = wrap.append("div").style("margin-bottom","24px");

  function renderBars(countries, color) {
    barHost.html("");
    const ranked = countries
      .filter(cc => d[cc] && d[cc].mismatch != null)
      .map(cc => ({cc, m: d[cc].mismatch}))
      .sort((a,b) => a.m - b.m);
    const maxM = Math.max(...ranked.map(r => r.m), 1);

    ranked.forEach(r => {
      const row = barHost.append("div")
        .style("display","flex").style("align-items","center")
        .style("margin-bottom","3px");
      const label = (r.cc === "JP" || r.cc === "MY" || r.cc === "TW") ? r.cc + "*" : r.cc;
      row.append("div").style("width","34px").style("text-align","right")
        .style("font-weight","600").style("font-size","11px")
        .style("color","#0f172a").style("margin-right","8px")
        .text(label);
      const barWrap = row.append("div")
        .style("flex","1").style("height","18px")
        .style("background","#f1f5f9").style("border-radius","4px")
        .style("position","relative").style("overflow","hidden");
      barWrap.append("div")
        .style("height","100%").style("border-radius","4px")
        .style("background", color)
        .style("width", `${(r.m / (maxM * 1.1)) * 100}%`);
      row.append("div").style("width","40px").style("text-align","right")
        .style("font-size","11px").style("font-weight","600")
        .style("color","#475569").style("margin-left","6px")
        .text(r.m.toFixed(1));
    });

    const hasJP = countries.includes("JP");
    const hasMY = countries.includes("MY");
    const hasTW = countries.includes("TW");
    if (hasJP || hasMY || hasTW) {
      const notes = [];
      if (hasJP) notes.push("JP: Japan's JSOC merges ISCO groups 2+3; group 7 from 2023 (dropped from 2024).");
      if (hasTW) notes.push("TW: DGBAS/ROC occupational classification, ISCO-08-based but not ILOSTAT-harmonised.");
      if (hasMY) notes.push("MY: employment data from 2024.");
      barHost.append("div").style("font-size","10px").style("color","#94a3b8")
        .style("margin-top","6px").style("font-style","italic")
        .html("* " + notes.join(" "));
    }
  }

  renderBars(eaList, "#3b82f6");
  barBtnEA.on("click", () => {
    barBtnEA.attr("style", btnStyle(true)+";border-radius:6px 0 0 6px");
    barBtnBM.attr("style", btnStyle(false)+";border-radius:0 6px 6px 0;border-left:none");
    renderBars(eaList, "#3b82f6");
  });
  barBtnBM.on("click", () => {
    barBtnEA.attr("style", btnStyle(false)+";border-radius:6px 0 0 6px");
    barBtnBM.attr("style", btnStyle(true)+";border-radius:0 6px 6px 0;border-left:none");
    renderBars(bmList, "#94a3b8");
  });

  /* ──── 2. COUNTRY DETAIL TABLE ──── */
  wrap.append("div").style("font-weight","700").style("font-size","14px")
    .style("margin","8px 0 10px").style("color","#0f172a")
    .text("Detailed ISCO breakdown by country");

  const ctrl = wrap.append("div")
    .style("display","flex").style("gap","10px")
    .style("align-items","center").style("margin-bottom","12px")
    .style("flex-wrap","wrap");

  const detBtnBar = ctrl.append("div").style("display","flex").style("gap","0");
  const detBtnEA = detBtnBar.append("button").attr("style", btnStyle(true)+";border-radius:6px 0 0 6px").text("East Asia");
  const detBtnBM = detBtnBar.append("button").attr("style", btnStyle(false)+";border-radius:0 6px 6px 0;border-left:none").text("Benchmarks");

  ctrl.append("label").style("font-weight","600").style("font-size","12px").text("Country:");
  const selCC = ctrl.append("select")
    .style("padding","5px 10px").style("border","1px solid #cbd5e1")
    .style("border-radius","6px").style("font-size","12px");

  function populateSelect(countries) {
    selCC.selectAll("option").remove();
    countries.forEach(cc => {
      const yr = d[cc] ? (d[cc].supply_year || "n/a") : "n/a";
      const star = (cc === "JP" || cc === "MY" || cc === "TW") ? " *" : "";
      selCC.append("option").attr("value", cc)
        .text(`${countryFull[cc]} (${cc})${star} — empl. ${yr}`);
    });
  }
  populateSelect(eaList);

  detBtnEA.on("click", () => {
    detBtnEA.attr("style", btnStyle(true)+";border-radius:6px 0 0 6px");
    detBtnBM.attr("style", btnStyle(false)+";border-radius:0 6px 6px 0;border-left:none");
    populateSelect(eaList);
    renderDetail(eaList[0]);
  });
  detBtnBM.on("click", () => {
    detBtnEA.attr("style", btnStyle(false)+";border-radius:6px 0 0 6px");
    detBtnBM.attr("style", btnStyle(true)+";border-radius:0 6px 6px 0;border-left:none");
    populateSelect(bmList);
    renderDetail(bmList[0]);
  });

  const detailHost = wrap.append("div");

  function renderDetail(cc) {
    detailHost.html("");
    const cd = d[cc];
    if (!cd) return;
    const dem = cd.demand || {};
    const sup = cd.supply || {};
    const yr = cd.supply_year || "n/a";
    const mm = cd.mismatch;
    const merging = cd.merge_2_3 === true;

    /* mismatch badge */
    const badge = detailHost.append("div")
      .style("display","inline-block").style("padding","6px 14px")
      .style("border-radius","8px").style("margin-bottom","10px")
      .style("background", mm > 50 ? "#fef2f2" : mm > 30 ? "#fffbeb" : "#f0fdf4")
      .style("border", `1px solid ${mm > 50 ? "#fca5a5" : mm > 30 ? "#fde68a" : "#86efac"}`);
    badge.append("span").style("font-weight","700").style("font-size","18px")
      .style("color","#0f172a").text(mm != null ? mm.toFixed(1) : "n/a");
    badge.append("span").style("font-size","11px").style("color","#64748b")
      .style("margin-left","6px").text("pp mismatch");

    /* table */
    const tbl = detailHost.append("table")
      .style("border-collapse","collapse").style("width","100%")
      .style("max-width","640px");

    const hdr = tbl.append("thead").append("tr")
      .style("border-bottom","2px solid #e2e8f0");
    hdr.append("th").style("text-align","left").style("padding","6px 8px")
      .style("font-size","11px").style("color","#64748b").text("ISCO-08 Major Group");
    hdr.append("th").style("text-align","right").style("padding","6px 8px")
      .style("font-size","11px").style("color","#3b82f6").text("Demand (%)");
    hdr.append("th").style("text-align","right").style("padding","6px 8px")
      .style("font-size","11px").style("color","#64748b").text(`Empl. (%) ${yr}`);
    hdr.append("th").style("text-align","right").style("padding","6px 8px")
      .style("font-size","11px").style("color","#475569").text("Gap (pp)");
    hdr.append("th").style("text-align","left").style("padding","6px 8px")
      .style("font-size","11px").style("color","#94a3b8").style("width","120px").text("");

    const tbody = tbl.append("tbody");
    const barScale = 30;

    const rowKeys = merging
      ? ["1","2+3","4","5","6","7","8","9"]
      : iscoKeys;

    rowKeys.forEach((k,i) => {
      let di, ei, label;
      if (k === "2+3") {
        di = (dem["2"] || 0) + (dem["3"] || 0);
        ei = sup["2"] || 0;
        label = "2+3  " + iscoNames["2+3"];
      } else {
        di = dem[k] || 0;
        ei = sup[k] || 0;
        label = k + "  " + (iscoNames[k] || k);
      }
      const hasSup = ei > 0;
      const gap = hasSup ? di - ei : null;
      const gapColor = gap == null ? "#94a3b8" : gap > 2 ? "#16a34a" : gap < -2 ? "#dc2626" : "#64748b";
      const bg = i % 2 === 0 ? "#f8fafc" : "#fff";

      const tr = tbody.append("tr").style("background",bg);
      tr.append("td").style("padding","4px 8px").style("font-size","12px")
        .style("white-space","nowrap").text(label);
      tr.append("td").style("text-align","right").style("padding","4px 8px")
        .style("font-size","12px").style("font-variant-numeric","tabular-nums")
        .style("color","#0f172a").text(di.toFixed(1));
      tr.append("td").style("text-align","right").style("padding","4px 8px")
        .style("font-size","12px").style("font-variant-numeric","tabular-nums")
        .style("color","#64748b").text(hasSup ? ei.toFixed(1) : "n/a");
      tr.append("td").style("text-align","right").style("padding","4px 8px")
        .style("font-size","12px").style("font-weight","600")
        .style("font-variant-numeric","tabular-nums")
        .style("color", gapColor)
        .text(gap != null ? (gap > 0 ? "+" : "") + gap.toFixed(1) : "—");

      /* mini diverging bar */
      const barTd = tr.append("td").style("padding","4px 8px");
      if (gap != null) {
        const barDiv = barTd.append("div")
          .style("display","flex").style("align-items","center")
          .style("height","12px");
        const mid = 60;
        const barW = Math.min(Math.abs(gap) / barScale * mid, mid);
        if (gap < 0) {
          barDiv.append("div").style("flex","1").style("display","flex")
            .style("justify-content","flex-end")
            .append("div").style("height","8px").style("border-radius","2px")
            .style("background","#fca5a5").style("width", barW + "px");
          barDiv.append("div").style("width","1px").style("height","12px")
            .style("background","#cbd5e1");
          barDiv.append("div").style("flex","1");
        } else {
          barDiv.append("div").style("flex","1");
          barDiv.append("div").style("width","1px").style("height","12px")
            .style("background","#cbd5e1");
          barDiv.append("div").style("flex","1").style("display","flex")
            .style("justify-content","flex-start")
            .append("div").style("height","8px").style("border-radius","2px")
            .style("background","#86efac").style("width", barW + "px");
        }
      }
    });

    /* country-specific caveats */
    if (cc === "JP") {
      detailHost.append("div").style("margin-top","6px").style("font-size","10px")
        .style("color","#94a3b8").style("font-style","italic")
        .html("Note: Japan's Standard Occupational Classification (JSOC) merges ISCO groups 2 and 3 into one category. "
          + "Groups 2+3 are shown combined for comparability. Group 7 last reported in 2023 (merged into 8 from 2024). "
          + "Mismatch index computed on comparable groups.");
    }
    if (cc === "MY") {
      detailHost.append("div").style("margin-top","6px").style("font-size","10px")
        .style("color","#94a3b8").style("font-style","italic")
        .text("Note: Malaysia employment data are from 2024.");
    }
    if (cc === "TW") {
      detailHost.append("div").style("margin-top","6px").style("font-size","10px")
        .style("color","#94a3b8").style("font-style","italic")
        .text("Note: Taiwan employment shares are from DGBAS Manpower Survey Table 52 (2024), using the ROC Standard Occupational Classification. It is ISCO-08-based but not ILOSTAT-harmonised.");
    }
  }

  renderDetail("JP");
  selCC.on("change", function() { renderDetail(this.value); });

  /* ──── 3. FOOTNOTE ──── */
  const fn = wrap.append("div").style("margin-top","14px").style("font-size","10px")
    .style("color","#94a3b8").style("line-height","1.6");
  fn.html(`<b>Demand</b> = share of online job postings (this study, 03.2025–04.2026). `
    + `<b>Employment</b> = share of civilian employment from national labour force surveys reported to `
    + `<a class="paper-link" href="https://ilostat.ilo.org/topics/employment/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">ILOSTAT<span class="source-link-ext">↗</span></a> `
    + `(indicator <code>EMP_TEMP_SEX_OCU_NB</code>, latest available year per country), except Taiwan from DGBAS Table 52. `
    + `<b>Gap</b> = demand − employment (pp). `
    + `Green bars indicate demand exceeds employment; red bars indicate employment exceeds demand. `
    + `Armed forces excluded from both distributions. Taiwan uses ROC occupational classification, ISCO-08-based but not ILOSTAT-harmonised. `
    + `Malaysia: employment data from 2024. `
    + `Japan: JSOC merges ISCO 2+3; group 7 from 2023 (dropped from 2024). Mismatch computed on comparable groups.`);

  return wrap.node();
}
```


### Skill content of job postings

::: {.section-card}
#### Skills per offer

The number of identifiable skills per posting varies substantially
across countries, reflecting differences not only in underlying labour
demand but also in how online vacancies are written and used. In some
markets, postings resemble detailed job descriptions and explicitly
list technical, language, and transversal requirements, often in more
standardized HR formats; in others, they are shorter and function
primarily as vacancy notices, with much of the screening and
clarification taking place later in the recruitment process.
Cross-country differences may also partly reflect variation in the
occupational composition of online demand, as professional and
technical roles tend to generate more skill-rich vacancy texts than
more generic or less formal postings. The indicator should therefore
be interpreted primarily as capturing the explicitness and
codification of skill demand in online recruitment, rather than as a
direct measure of job complexity across countries.

The table below reports the distribution of ESCO-mapped skills per
posting. Click a column header to sort.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

{
  const rows = [
    { country: "India", mean: 7.6, p10: 1, p25: 3, median: 6, p75: 11, p90: 16 },
    { country: "Indonesia", mean: 5.5, p10: 1, p25: 1, median: 3, p75: 8, p90: 14 },
    { country: "Japan", mean: 5.5, p10: 1, p25: 2, median: 5, p75: 8, p90: 11 },
    { country: "S. Korea", mean: 3.3, p10: 0, p25: 1, median: 2, p75: 4, p90: 9 },
    { country: "Malaysia", mean: 7.9, p10: 1, p25: 2, median: 7, p75: 12, p90: 17 },
    { country: "Mexico", mean: 6.3, p10: 1, p25: 3, median: 5, p75: 9, p90: 13 },
    { country: "Philippines", mean: 8.2, p10: 1, p25: 3, median: 7, p75: 11, p90: 16 },
    { country: "Poland", mean: 10.0, p10: 3, p25: 6, median: 10, p75: 13, p90: 17 },
    { country: "Singapore", mean: 9.0, p10: 2, p25: 5, median: 8, p75: 12, p90: 17 },
    { country: "Thailand", mean: 5.8, p10: 1, p25: 1, median: 4, p75: 9, p90: 14 },
    { country: "Taiwan", mean: 8.7, p10: 0, p25: 2, median: 7, p75: 12, p90: 20 },
    { country: "Vietnam", mean: 9.7, p10: 3, p25: 6, median: 9, p75: 13, p90: 17 },
    { country: "Overall", mean: 7.2, p10: 1, p25: 2, median: 6, p75: 10, p90: 15, overall: true },
  ];

  const table = d3.create("table")
    .attr("class", "table table-sm align-middle market-table");

  const columns = [
    { key: "country", label: "Country", align: "left", type: "text" },
    { key: "mean", label: "Mean", align: "right", type: "number" },
    { key: "p25", label: "P25", align: "right", type: "number" },
    { key: "median", label: "Median", align: "right", type: "number" },
    { key: "p75", label: "P75", align: "right", type: "number" },
    { key: "p90", label: "P90", align: "right", type: "number" },
  ];

  let sortKey = "mean";
  let sortDirection = "desc";

  const thead = table.append("thead");
  const header = thead.append("tr");
  const tbody = table.append("tbody");

  const sortRows = () => {
    const baseRows = rows.filter(d => !d.overall);
    const overall = rows.find(d => d.overall);
    const sorted = [...baseRows].sort((a, b) => {
      const av = a[sortKey];
      const bv = b[sortKey];
      const cmp = columns.find(c => c.key === sortKey).type === "text"
        ? String(av).localeCompare(String(bv))
        : av - bv;
      return sortDirection === "asc" ? cmp : -cmp;
    });
    return overall ? [...sorted, overall] : sorted;
  };

  const renderBody = () => {
    tbody.selectAll("tr").remove();
    sortRows().forEach(row => {
      const tr = tbody.append("tr")
        .style("font-weight", row.overall ? "700" : null)
        .style("background", row.overall ? "#f8fafc" : null);
      tr.append("td").text(row.country);
      tr.append("td").style("text-align", "right").style("font-variant-numeric", "tabular-nums").text(fmtRate(row.mean));
      tr.append("td").style("text-align", "right").style("font-variant-numeric", "tabular-nums").text(fmtRate(row.p25));
      tr.append("td").style("text-align", "right").style("font-variant-numeric", "tabular-nums").text(fmtRate(row.median));
      tr.append("td").style("text-align", "right").style("font-variant-numeric", "tabular-nums").text(fmtRate(row.p75));
      tr.append("td").style("text-align", "right").style("font-variant-numeric", "tabular-nums").text(fmtRate(row.p90));
    });
  };

  columns.forEach(col => header.append("th")
    .attr("class", col.key === sortKey ? "active-sort" : null)
    .style("text-align", col.align)
    .style("font-variant-numeric", col.align === "right" ? "tabular-nums" : null)
    .text(`${col.label}${col.key === sortKey ? (sortDirection === "asc" ? " ↑" : " ↓") : ""}`)
    .on("click", function() {
      if (sortKey === col.key) {
        sortDirection = sortDirection === "asc" ? "desc" : "asc";
      } else {
        sortKey = col.key;
        sortDirection = col.type === "text" ? "asc" : "desc";
      }
      header.selectAll("th")
        .attr("class", null)
        .text((d, i) => {
          const c = columns[i];
          return `${c.label}${c.key === sortKey ? (sortDirection === "asc" ? " ↑" : " ↓") : ""}`;
        });
      header.selectAll("th")
        .filter((d, i) => columns[i].key === sortKey)
        .attr("class", "active-sort");
      renderBody();
    }));

  renderBody();

  return table.node();
}
```
