### Sectoral demand structure (ISIC/NACE)

::: {.section-card}
#### Sectoral heatmap

Each job posting is assigned an economic sector via the ISIC/NACE
classification derived from the ESCO occupation mapping (see
[Step 06](#pipeline-step-06) above). At the 2-digit division level used
in this analysis, NACE Rev. 2.1 and ISIC Rev. 5 are identical. The
heatmap below shows the share of postings in each ISIC/NACE section
(1-digit) per country. Clicking on any section row expands a 2-digit
breakdown showing how demand is distributed across divisions within
that sector.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

{
  const nace2d = await FileAttachment("nace_2digit_detail.json").json();
  const eaList = ["JP","KR","TW","TH","MY","SG","ID","VN","PH"];
  const bmList = ["IN","MX","PL"];
  const countryFull = {JP:"Japan",KR:"S. Korea",TW:"Taiwan",TH:"Thailand",MY:"Malaysia",SG:"Singapore",ID:"Indonesia",VN:"Vietnam",PH:"Philippines",IN:"India",MX:"Mexico",PL:"Poland"};
  const sections = [
    {l:"N",n:"Professional, scientific & technical"},
    {l:"G",n:"Wholesale & retail trade"},
    {l:"O",n:"Administrative & support"},
    {l:"K",n:"Telecom, IT & information services"},
    {l:"I",n:"Accommodation & food service"},
    {l:"C",n:"Manufacturing"},
    {l:"H",n:"Transportation & storage"},
    {l:"R",n:"Human health & social work"},
    {l:"Q",n:"Education"},
    {l:"S",n:"Arts, sports & recreation"},
    {l:"L",n:"Financial & insurance"},
    {l:"T",n:"Other service activities"},
    {l:"F",n:"Construction"},
    {l:"P",n:"Public administration & defence"},
    {l:"U",n:"Households as employers"},
    {l:"J",n:"Publishing & broadcasting"},
    {l:"M",n:"Real estate"},
    {l:"A",n:"Agriculture & fishing"},
    {l:"D",n:"Electricity & gas"},
    {l:"E",n:"Water supply & waste"},
    {l:"B",n:"Mining & quarrying"}
  ];
  const sectionData = await FileAttachment("nace_section_analysis.json").json();
  const pct = {};
  Object.entries(sectionData).forEach(([sec, o]) => { pct[sec] = o.countries; });
  const detail = nace2d;

  const color = d3.scaleSequential(d3.interpolateYlOrRd).domain([0, 33]);
  const subColor = d3.scaleSequential(d3.interpolateBlues).domain([0, 100]);

  const wrap = d3.create("div")
    .style("font-family","system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif")
    .style("font-size","12px");

  /* ── toggle buttons ── */
  const btnBar = wrap.append("div")
    .style("display","flex").style("gap","0").style("margin-bottom","12px");

  const btnStyle = (active) =>
    `padding:6px 18px;font-size:12px;font-weight:${active?700:500};cursor:pointer;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;`
    + `background:${active?"#0f172a":"#fff"};color:${active?"#fff":"#475569"};`
    + `transition:all .15s`;

  const btnEA = btnBar.append("button")
    .attr("style", btnStyle(true) + ";border-radius:6px 0 0 6px")
    .text("East Asia");
  const btnBM = btnBar.append("button")
    .attr("style", btnStyle(false) + ";border-radius:0 6px 6px 0;border-left:none")
    .text("Benchmarks");

  /* ── table host ── */
  const tableHost = wrap.append("div");
  const legendHost = wrap.append("div")
    .style("margin-top","10px").style("font-size","11px")
    .style("color","#64748b").style("line-height","1.6");

  function shortName(name, n) {
    return name.length > n ? name.slice(0, n - 1) + "\u2026" : name;
  }

  function cellBg(val, scale) {
    const bg = scale(val);
    return `background:${bg};color:${val > 18 ? "#fff" : "#1e293b"}`;
  }

  function buildTable(countries) {
    tableHost.html("");
    legendHost.html("");

    const tbl = tableHost.append("table")
      .style("border-collapse","collapse").style("width","auto");

    /* header */
    const ch = tbl.append("thead").append("tr");
    ch.append("th").style("text-align","right").style("padding","2px 6px")
      .style("font-size","10px").style("color","#94a3b8").text("ISIC/NACE section");
    countries.forEach(c => {
      ch.append("th").style("padding","2px 6px").style("text-align","center")
        .style("font-size","11px").style("font-weight","700")
        .style("color","#334155").style("min-width","48px").text(c);
    });

    const tbody = tbl.append("tbody");

    sections.forEach(s => {
      const divs = detail[s.l] || [];
      const hasDivs = divs.length > 1;

      const tr = tbody.append("tr").style("cursor", hasDivs ? "pointer" : "default");
      const labelTd = tr.append("td")
        .style("text-align","right").style("padding","3px 6px")
        .style("white-space","nowrap").style("font-size","11px")
        .style("color","#475569");
      labelTd.html(`${hasDivs ? '<span class="nace-arrow" style="display:inline-block;width:14px;font-size:9px;transition:transform .2s">\u25B6</span>' : '<span style="display:inline-block;width:14px"></span>'}${s.l}\u2002${s.n}`);

      countries.forEach(c => {
        const val = pct[s.l][c];
        tr.append("td")
          .attr("style", `text-align:center;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:3px;font-size:10px;font-weight:${val >= 10 ? 700 : 400};${cellBg(val, color)}`)
          .text(val.toFixed(1));
      });

      const subRows = [];
      if (hasDivs) {
        divs.forEach(d => {
          const sr = tbody.append("tr").style("display","none");
          sr.append("td")
            .style("text-align","right").style("padding","2px 6px 2px 24px")
            .style("font-size","10px").style("color","#94a3b8")
            .style("white-space","nowrap")
            .text(`${d.div} ${shortName(d.name, 38)}`);
          countries.forEach(c => {
            const val = d.pct[c] || 0;
            sr.append("td")
              .attr("style", `text-align:center;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:3px;font-size:9px;${cellBg(val, subColor)}`)
              .text(val.toFixed(0));
          });
          subRows.push(sr);
        });

        let open = false;
        tr.on("click", () => {
          open = !open;
          labelTd.select(".nace-arrow").style("transform", open ? "rotate(90deg)" : "rotate(0deg)");
          subRows.forEach(sr => sr.style("display", open ? "table-row" : "none"));
        });
      }
    });

    /* legend */
    const items = countries.map(c =>
      `<span style="font-weight:700">${c}</span>\u2009${countryFull[c]}`
    );
    legendHost.html(items.join(" \u00b7 "));
  }

  /* initial render */
  buildTable(eaList);

  btnEA.on("click", () => {
    btnEA.attr("style", btnStyle(true) + ";border-radius:6px 0 0 6px");
    btnBM.attr("style", btnStyle(false) + ";border-radius:0 6px 6px 0;border-left:none");
    buildTable(eaList);
  });
  btnBM.on("click", () => {
    btnEA.attr("style", btnStyle(false) + ";border-radius:6px 0 0 6px");
    btnBM.attr("style", btnStyle(true) + ";border-radius:0 6px 6px 0;border-left:none");
    buildTable(bmList);
  });

  return wrap.node();
}
```

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
##### Statistical test: do countries differ in sectoral composition?

A global $\chi^2$ test of independence on the 12×21 contingency table
(country × ISIC/NACE section) yields $\chi^2 = 413{,}673$, $df = 220$,
$p < 0.001$, confirming that sectoral demand structures differ
significantly across the 12 countries. The overall effect size is
Cramér's $V = 0.14$, indicating a moderate but meaningful departure
from homogeneity.

**Pairwise similarity** (Cramér's $V$, lower = more similar):

| Most similar pairs | $V$  | Most different pairs | $V$  |
|-----|------|------|------|
| Indonesia – Malaysia    | 0.11 | S. Korea – Thailand  | 0.43 |
| Vietnam – Philippines   | 0.13 | Poland – Thailand    | 0.42 |
| Malaysia – Thailand     | 0.16 | Indonesia – S. Korea | 0.41 |
| Singapore – Vietnam     | 0.18 | S. Korea – Singapore | 0.40 |
:::

#### Macroeconomic and demographic context

The tables below provide a reference frame for interpreting the sectoral
demand patterns. All data are from the
<a class="paper-link" href="https://data.worldbank.org/indicator" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">World Bank Open Data<span class="source-link-ext">↗</span></a>
(latest available year, 2023–2024), except Taiwan, for which data are
sourced from the National Statistics Bureau and the National Development
Council.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

{
  const macroCtx = await FileAttachment("macro_context.json").json();
  const eaList = ["JP","KR","TW","TH","MY","SG","ID","VN","PH"];
  const bmList = ["IN","MX","PL"];
  const countryFull = {JP:"Japan",KR:"S. Korea",TW:"Taiwan",TH:"Thailand",
    MY:"Malaysia",SG:"Singapore",ID:"Indonesia",VN:"Vietnam",
    PH:"Philippines",IN:"India",MX:"Mexico",PL:"Poland"};
  const d = macroCtx;

  const wrap = d3.create("div")
    .style("font-family","system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif")
    .style("font-size","12px");

  /* ── toggle ── */
  const btnBar = wrap.append("div").style("display","flex").style("gap","0")
    .style("margin-bottom","12px");
  const btnStyle = (active) =>
    `padding:6px 18px;font-size:12px;font-weight:${active?700:500};`
    + `cursor:pointer;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;`
    + `background:${active?"#0f172a":"#fff"};color:${active?"#fff":"#475569"};`
    + `transition:all .15s`;
  const btnEA = btnBar.append("button")
    .attr("style", btnStyle(true)+";border-radius:6px 0 0 6px")
    .text("East Asia");
  const btnBM = btnBar.append("button")
    .attr("style", btnStyle(false)+";border-radius:0 6px 6px 0;border-left:none")
    .text("Benchmarks");

  const host = wrap.append("div");

  /* ── helpers ── */
  function fmt(v,dec) {
    return v!=null ? v.toLocaleString("en",{minimumFractionDigits:dec,
      maximumFractionDigits:dec}) : "\u2014";
  }
  function fmtK(v) {
    return v!=null ? v.toLocaleString("en",{maximumFractionDigits:0}) : "\u2014";
  }

  const incomeOrder = {"High":3,"Upper-middle":2,"Lower-middle":1,"Low":0};
  const incomeColor = {"High":"#16a34a","Upper-middle":"#3b82f6",
    "Lower-middle":"#f59e0b"};

  /* ── generic sortable table builder ── */
  function sortableTable(parent, title, cols, rows, defaultSortCol,
                         defaultAsc, sourceHtml) {
    parent.append("div").style("font-weight","700").style("font-size","12px")
      .style("margin","18px 0 6px").style("color","#0f172a").text(title);

    const tblWrap = parent.append("div");
    let sortCol = defaultSortCol;
    let sortAsc = defaultAsc;

    function render() {
      tblWrap.html("");
      const sorted = [...rows].sort((a,b) => {
        const va = a.vals[sortCol], vb = b.vals[sortCol];
        if (va == null && vb == null) return 0;
        if (va == null) return 1;
        if (vb == null) return -1;
        const cmp = typeof va === "string"
          ? va.localeCompare(vb) : va - vb;
        return sortAsc ? cmp : -cmp;
      });

      const tbl = tblWrap.append("table")
        .style("border-collapse","collapse").style("margin-bottom","4px");
      const thead = tbl.append("thead").append("tr");
      cols.forEach((c,i) => {
        const arrow = sortCol === i
          ? (sortAsc ? " \u25B2" : " \u25BC") : "";
        thead.append("th")
          .style("text-align", c.align || "right")
          .style("padding","4px 10px")
          .style("font-size","10px").style("color","#94a3b8")
          .style("font-weight","600")
          .style("border-bottom","1px solid #e2e8f0")
          .style("white-space","nowrap")
          .style("cursor","pointer")
          .style("user-select","none")
          .text(c.label + arrow)
          .on("click", () => {
            if (sortCol === i) sortAsc = !sortAsc;
            else { sortCol = i; sortAsc = c.defaultAsc ?? false; }
            render();
          });
      });

      sorted.forEach(row => {
        const tr = tbl.append("tbody").append("tr");
        cols.forEach((c,i) => {
          const v = row.vals[i];
          const td = tr.append("td")
            .style("padding","3px 10px")
            .style("text-align", c.align || "right")
            .style("font-size","11px")
            .style("font-variant-numeric","tabular-nums");
          if (c.render) c.render(td, v, row);
          else td.text(v != null ? v : "\u2014");
        });
      });

      if (sourceHtml) {
        tblWrap.append("div").style("font-size","9px").style("color","#b0b8c4")
          .style("margin-top","2px").style("line-height","1.4").html(sourceHtml);
      }
    }
    render();
  }

  /* ── build all tables ── */
  function build(countries) {
    host.html("");

    /* ── Table 1: Demographics ── */
    const rows1 = countries.map(cc => {
      const r = d[cc]||{};
      return {cc, vals: [
        countryFull[cc],
        r.income_group || "",
        r.gdp_cap_ppp,
        r.old_age_dep,
        r.fertility
      ]};
    });
    const cols1 = [
      {label:"Country", align:"left", defaultAsc:true,
        render:(td,v)=>td.style("font-weight","600").text(v)},
      {label:"Income group", align:"left", defaultAsc:false,
        render:(td,v,row)=>{
          td.style("font-size","10px").style("font-weight","600")
            .style("color",incomeColor[v]||"#475569").text(v);
          row.vals[1] = incomeOrder[v]||0;
        }},
      {label:"GDP/cap PPP ($)", defaultAsc:false,
        render:(td,v)=>td.text(fmtK(v))},
      {label:"Old-age dep. ratio", defaultAsc:false,
        render:(td,v)=>{
          const c = v>=25?"#dc2626":v>=15?"#f59e0b":"#475569";
          td.style("color",c).style("font-weight",v>=25?"700":"400")
            .text(fmt(v,1));
        }},
      {label:"Fertility rate", defaultAsc:true,
        render:(td,v)=>{
          const c = v<1.3?"#dc2626":v<1.8?"#f59e0b":"#475569";
          td.style("color",c).style("font-weight",v<1.3?"700":"400")
            .text(fmt(v,2));
        }}
    ];
    sortableTable(host, "Demographic structure and income level",
      cols1, rows1, 3, false,
      "WDI: <code>NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.CD</code>, <code>SP.POP.DPND.OL</code>, "
      + "<code>SP.DYN.TFRT.IN</code>. "
      + "Taiwan: DGBAS National Accounts &amp; MOI Demographic Statistics.");

    /* ── Table 2: FDI ── */
    const rows2 = countries.map(cc => {
      const r = d[cc]||{};
      return {cc, vals: [
        countryFull[cc],
        r.fdi_pct_2024,
        r.fdi_pct_avg,
        r.fdi_bn_2024,
        r.fdi_bn_avg
      ]};
    });
    const barRender = (td,v) => {
      td.style("min-width","90px");
      td.append("div").style("text-align","right").style("font-size","11px")
        .style("font-variant-numeric","tabular-nums").text(fmt(v,1));
      const barW = Math.min((v||0)/30*100,100);
      td.append("div").style("width","100%").style("height","4px")
        .style("background","#e2e8f0").style("border-radius","2px")
        .style("margin-top","2px")
        .append("div").style("width",barW+"%").style("height","100%")
        .style("background","#3b82f6").style("border-radius","2px")
        .style("min-width", v>0?"2px":"0");
    };
    const cols2 = [
      {label:"Country", align:"left", defaultAsc:true,
        render:(td,v)=>td.style("font-weight","600").text(v)},
      {label:"FDI % GDP (2024)", defaultAsc:false, render:barRender},
      {label:"FDI % GDP (5-yr avg)", defaultAsc:false, render:barRender},
      {label:"FDI US$ bn (2024)", defaultAsc:false,
        render:(td,v)=>td.text(fmt(v,1))},
      {label:"FDI US$ bn (5-yr avg)", defaultAsc:false,
        render:(td,v)=>td.text(fmt(v,1))}
    ];
    sortableTable(host, "Foreign direct investment, net inflows",
      cols2, rows2, 1, false,
      "WDI: <code>BX.KLT.DINV.WD.GD.ZS</code>, "
      + "<code>BX.KLT.DINV.CD.WD</code>. 5-yr avg = 2020\u20132024. "
      + "Taiwan: Investment Commission, MOEA. "
      + "Singapore FDI/GDP reflects its financial-hub role "
      + "(gross flows exceed GDP).");

    /* ── Table 3: Economic structure ── */
    const rows3 = countries.map(cc => {
      const r = d[cc]||{};
      return {cc, vals: [
        countryFull[cc],
        r.manuf_pct,
        r.services_pct,
        r.exports_pct
      ]};
    });
    const cols3 = [
      {label:"Country", align:"left", defaultAsc:true,
        render:(td,v)=>td.style("font-weight","600").text(v)},
      {label:"Manufacturing (% GDP)", defaultAsc:false,
        render:(td,v)=>td.text(fmt(v,1))},
      {label:"Services (% GDP)", defaultAsc:false,
        render:(td,v)=>td.text(fmt(v,1))},
      {label:"Exports (% GDP)", defaultAsc:false,
        render:(td,v)=>td.text(fmt(v,1))}
    ];
    sortableTable(host, "Economic structure",
      cols3, rows3, 1, false,
      "WDI: <code>NV.IND.MANF.ZS</code>, <code>NV.SRV.TOTL.ZS</code>, "
      + "<code>NE.EXP.GNFS.ZS</code>. "
      + "Taiwan: DGBAS National Accounts.");

    /* ── definitions ── */
    host.append("div").style("font-size","10px").style("color","#94a3b8")
      .style("margin-top","12px").style("line-height","1.5")
      .html("<b>Old-age dependency ratio</b> = number of people aged 65+ "
        + "per 100 working-age population (15\u201364); higher values "
        + "indicate a larger elderly population relative to working-age "
        + "adults (e.g.\u00a0Japan\u2019s 50.7 means roughly one senior "
        + "for every two workers). "
        + "<b>Fertility rate</b> (total, births per woman) = average "
        + "number of children born per woman over her lifetime; a rate "
        + "below ~2.1 implies the population will shrink without "
        + "net immigration (e.g.\u00a0South Korea\u2019s 0.75 is the "
        + "lowest recorded globally). Click any column header to sort.");
  }

  build(eaList);
  btnEA.on("click", () => {
    btnEA.attr("style", btnStyle(true)+";border-radius:6px 0 0 6px");
    btnBM.attr("style", btnStyle(false)
      +";border-radius:0 6px 6px 0;border-left:none");
    build(eaList);
  });
  btnBM.on("click", () => {
    btnEA.attr("style", btnStyle(false)+";border-radius:6px 0 0 6px");
    btnBM.attr("style", btnStyle(true)
      +";border-radius:0 6px 6px 0;border-left:none");
    build(bmList);
  });

  return wrap.node();
}
```

#### Top occupation groups by sector

The table below shows the five most frequent ISCO-08 occupation groups
(4-digit level) within each ISIC/NACE section, per country. Use the
selectors to browse sectors and compare across countries.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

{
  const isco4data = await FileAttachment("nace_isco4_top5.json").json();
  const eaList = ["JP","KR","TW","TH","MY","SG","ID","VN","PH"];
  const bmList = ["IN","MX","PL"];
  const countryFull = {JP:"Japan",KR:"S. Korea",TW:"Taiwan",TH:"Thailand",MY:"Malaysia",SG:"Singapore",ID:"Indonesia",VN:"Vietnam",PH:"Philippines",IN:"India",MX:"Mexico",PL:"Poland"};
  const d = isco4data;

  const sectionKeys = Object.keys(d).sort();
  const sectionOpts = sectionKeys.map(k => ({key:k, label:`${k}  ${d[k].name}`}));

  const wrap = d3.create("div")
    .style("font-family","system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif")
    .style("font-size","12px");

  /* ── controls ── */
  const ctrl = wrap.append("div")
    .style("display","flex").style("gap","16px")
    .style("align-items","center").style("margin-bottom","12px")
    .style("flex-wrap","wrap");

  /* toggle East Asia / Benchmarks */
  const btnBar = ctrl.append("div").style("display","flex").style("gap","0");
  const btnStyle = (active) =>
    `padding:5px 14px;font-size:11px;font-weight:${active?700:500};cursor:pointer;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;`
    + `background:${active?"#0f172a":"#fff"};color:${active?"#fff":"#475569"};transition:all .15s`;
  const btnEA = btnBar.append("button").attr("style", btnStyle(true)+";border-radius:6px 0 0 6px").text("East Asia");
  const btnBM = btnBar.append("button").attr("style", btnStyle(false)+";border-radius:0 6px 6px 0;border-left:none").text("Benchmarks");

  ctrl.append("label").style("font-weight","600").style("font-size","12px").text("Sector:");
  const selSect = ctrl.append("select")
    .style("padding","4px 8px").style("border","1px solid #cbd5e1")
    .style("border-radius","6px").style("font-size","12px");
  sectionOpts.forEach(o => {
    selSect.append("option").attr("value", o.key).text(o.label);
  });
  selSect.property("value", "N");

  const tableHost = wrap.append("div");

  let activeGroup = "ea";

  function shortOcc(name, n) {
    return name.length > n ? name.slice(0, n - 1) + "\u2026" : name;
  }

  function render(letter) {
    tableHost.html("");
    const sect = d[letter];
    if (!sect) return;

    const countries = activeGroup === "ea" ? eaList : bmList;
    const barMax = 60;

    const grid = tableHost.append("div")
      .style("display","grid")
      .style("grid-template-columns","repeat(auto-fill, minmax(320px, 1fr))")
      .style("gap","10px");

    countries.forEach(cc => {
      const cd = sect.countries[cc];
      if (!cd || cd.total === 0) return;

      const card = grid.append("div")
        .style("border","1px solid #e2e8f0").style("border-radius","8px")
        .style("padding","8px 12px").style("background","#fff");

      card.append("div")
        .style("font-weight","700").style("font-size","12px").style("color","#0f172a")
        .style("margin-bottom","4px")
        .html(`${countryFull[cc]} <span style="font-weight:400;color:#94a3b8;font-size:11px">${cc} \u00b7 ${cd.total.toLocaleString()} postings</span>`);

      const tbl = card.append("table")
        .style("width","100%").style("border-collapse","collapse");

      cd.top.forEach((item, idx) => {
        const tr = tbl.append("tr");
        tr.append("td")
          .style("padding","2px 4px").style("font-size","10px")
          .style("color","#94a3b8").style("width","36px")
          .style("text-align","right").style("font-variant-numeric","tabular-nums")
          .text(item.code);
        const nameTd = tr.append("td")
          .style("padding","2px 6px").style("font-size","11px");
        nameTd.append("div").style("margin-bottom","1px").text(shortOcc(item.name, 40));
        nameTd.append("div").style("display","flex").style("align-items","center").style("gap","4px");
        nameTd.select("div:last-child").append("div")
          .style("height","6px").style("border-radius","3px")
          .style("background","#3b82f6")
          .style("width", `${Math.max(item.pct / barMax * 100, 2)}%`)
          .style("min-width","3px");
        nameTd.select("div:last-child").append("span")
          .style("font-size","10px").style("color","#64748b")
          .style("white-space","nowrap")
          .text(`${item.pct}%`);
      });
    });
  }

  render("N");
  selSect.on("change", function() { render(this.value); });
  btnEA.on("click", () => {
    activeGroup = "ea";
    btnEA.attr("style", btnStyle(true)+";border-radius:6px 0 0 6px");
    btnBM.attr("style", btnStyle(false)+";border-radius:0 6px 6px 0;border-left:none");
    render(selSect.property("value"));
  });
  btnBM.on("click", () => {
    activeGroup = "bm";
    btnEA.attr("style", btnStyle(false)+";border-radius:6px 0 0 6px");
    btnBM.attr("style", btnStyle(true)+";border-radius:0 6px 6px 0;border-left:none");
    render(selSect.property("value"));
  });

  return wrap.node();
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

{
  /* ───────── COUNTRY PROFILES ───────── */
  const allProfiles = await FileAttachment("nace_distinctive_profiles.json").json();
  const profiles = Object.fromEntries(["JP","KR","TW","TH","MY","SG","ID","VN","PH"].map(cc => [cc, allProfiles[cc]]));
  const benchProfiles = Object.fromEntries(["IN","MX","PL"].map(cc => [cc, allProfiles[cc]]));

  const overColor = "#dcfce7";
  const underColor = "#fee2e2";

  function makeCard(card, p) {
    card.append("div")
      .style("font-weight","700").style("font-size","13px")
      .style("margin-bottom","2px").style("color","#0f172a")
      .html(`${p.full} <span style="font-weight:400;color:#64748b">(${p.n} postings)</span>`);
    const tbl = card.append("table")
      .style("width","100%").style("border-collapse","collapse").style("margin-top","6px");
    const renderRow = (item, bg) => {
      const tr = tbl.append("tr");
      tr.append("td").style("padding","1px 4px").style("border-radius","4px")
        .style("background",bg).style("font-weight","600")
        .style("text-align","center").style("width","36px").text(`${item.r}\u00d7`);
      tr.append("td").style("padding","1px 6px").text(`${item.s} ${item.n}`);
      tr.append("td").style("padding","1px 4px").style("text-align","right")
        .style("color","#64748b").text(`${item.p}%`);
    };
    p.over.forEach(item => renderRow(item, overColor));
    p.under.forEach(item => renderRow(item, underColor));
  }

  const wrap = d3.create("div").style("font-family","system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif").style("font-size","12px");

  wrap.append("div").style("font-weight","700").style("font-size","14px")
    .style("margin","0.6rem 0 8px").style("color","#0f172a").text("East Asia");
  const eaGrid = wrap.append("div")
    .style("display","grid").style("grid-template-columns","repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr))")
    .style("gap","12px");
  for (const [cc, p] of Object.entries(profiles)) {
    const card = eaGrid.append("div")
      .style("border","1px solid #e2e8f0").style("border-radius","10px")
      .style("padding","10px 14px").style("background","#fff");
    makeCard(card, p);
  }

  wrap.append("div").style("font-weight","700").style("font-size","14px")
    .style("margin","1.2rem 0 8px").style("color","#64748b").text("Benchmark countries");
  const bmGrid = wrap.append("div")
    .style("display","grid").style("grid-template-columns","repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr))")
    .style("gap","12px");
  for (const [cc, p] of Object.entries(benchProfiles)) {
    const card = bmGrid.append("div")
      .style("border","1px solid #e2e8f0").style("border-radius","10px")
      .style("padding","10px 14px").style("background","#fff")
      .style("border-color","#cbd5e1");
    makeCard(card, p);
  }

  return wrap.node();
}
```

The cards above show each country's **most distinctive sectors**
relative to the 12-country average. Green values indicate
overrepresentation ($> 1\times$ average), red values indicate
underrepresentation ($< 1\times$ average).

:::

### Skill composition

::: {.section-card}
#### Cross-country comparison

The heatmaps below compare the composition of mapped ESCO concepts across
**all countries at once**. Shares are normalised within each country
separately for **skills**, **transversal skills**, and **knowledge**, so
each column sums to 100% within the respective panel. The knowledge panel
shows the most frequent 3-digit knowledge categories. Columns are labelled
with ISO2 country codes and rows with short skill/knowledge codes — see
the legends below each panel, and hover over any cell for the full labels
and the exact share. Use the **descriptions** button to read the ESCO
or ISCED-F definition behind each code.
Language and other ESCO concept types are excluded from this specific view.

By default the panels show the **post-stratified** composition: each
country's skill mix is reweighted so that occupation (ISCO-08) strata match
its official employment structure, correcting for the over- or
under-representation of occupations in online vacancies. Use the
**Stratified / Raw** switch to compare with the unweighted sample, and the
**method & sources** button for the full weighting methodology and the
per-country reference data.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

{
  const data = await FileAttachment("esco_category_shares.json").json();
  const strat = await FileAttachment("esco_category_shares_stratified.json").json();
  const viewState = { mode: "stratified", estimator: "pooled" };

  const iso2 = {
    "Japan": "JP", "South Korea": "KR", "Taiwan": "TW", "Thailand": "TH",
    "Malaysia": "MY", "Singapore": "SG", "Indonesia": "ID", "Vietnam": "VN",
    "Philippines": "PH", "India": "IN", "Mexico": "MX", "Poland": "PL"
  };
  const eastAsia = ["Japan", "South Korea", "Taiwan", "Thailand", "Malaysia", "Singapore", "Indonesia", "Vietnam", "Philippines"];
  const benchmark = ["India", "Mexico", "Poland"];
  const baseCountries = [...eastAsia, ...benchmark].filter(c => strat.countries[c]);
  const dimShares = (country, dim) => strat.countries[country]?.[dim]?.[viewState.estimator]?.[viewState.mode] || {};
  const regionPalette = { "East Asia": "#2563eb", "Benchmark": "#7c3aed" };
  const regionFor = c => benchmark.includes(c) ? "Benchmark" : "East Asia";
  const skillCodes = ["S1", "S2", "S3", "S4", "S5", "S6", "S7", "S8"];
  const transversalCodes = ["T1", "T2", "T3", "T4", "T5", "T6"];
  const pct = d3.format(".1%");
  const pctExport = v => Math.round((v || 0) * 1000) / 10;

  const wrap = d3.create("div").style("position", "relative");
  const tip = wrap.append("div").attr("class", "heat-tip").style("opacity", 0);
  const descModal = wrap.append("div")
    .attr("role", "dialog")
    .attr("aria-modal", "true")
    .style("display", "none")
    .style("position", "fixed")
    .style("inset", "0")
    .style("z-index", "1050")
    .style("background", "rgba(15,23,42,0.42)")
    .style("align-items", "center")
    .style("justify-content", "center")
    .style("padding", "1rem");
  const descCard = descModal.append("div")
    .style("width", "min(760px, 96vw)")
    .style("max-height", "82vh")
    .style("overflow", "auto")
    .style("background", "#ffffff")
    .style("border-radius", "16px")
    .style("box-shadow", "0 24px 70px rgba(15,23,42,0.32)")
    .style("padding", "1rem 1.1rem");
  descModal.on("click", event => {
    if (event.target === descModal.node()) descModal.style("display", "none");
  });

  const methodModal = wrap.append("div")
    .attr("role", "dialog")
    .attr("aria-modal", "true")
    .style("display", "none")
    .style("position", "fixed")
    .style("inset", "0")
    .style("z-index", "1050")
    .style("background", "rgba(15,23,42,0.42)")
    .style("align-items", "center")
    .style("justify-content", "center")
    .style("padding", "1rem");
  const methodCard = methodModal.append("div")
    .style("width", "min(820px, 96vw)")
    .style("max-height", "84vh")
    .style("overflow", "auto")
    .style("background", "#ffffff")
    .style("border-radius", "16px")
    .style("box-shadow", "0 24px 70px rgba(15,23,42,0.32)")
    .style("padding", "1.1rem 1.2rem");
  methodModal.on("click", event => {
    if (event.target === methodModal.node()) methodModal.style("display", "none");
  });

  function showMethod() {
    methodCard.selectAll("*").remove();
    const head = methodCard.append("div")
      .style("display", "flex").style("align-items", "center")
      .style("justify-content", "space-between").style("gap", "0.8rem")
      .style("margin-bottom", "0.7rem");
    head.append("div")
      .style("font-size", "1.05rem").style("font-weight", "850").style("color", "#0f172a")
      .text("Post-stratification — method & sources");
    head.append("button")
      .attr("type", "button").attr("aria-label", "Close")
      .style("border", "1px solid #e2e8f0").style("background", "#f8fafc")
      .style("border-radius", "999px").style("padding", "0.28rem 0.58rem")
      .style("font-weight", "800").style("color", "#475569").style("cursor", "pointer")
      .text("Close")
      .on("click", () => methodModal.style("display", "none"));

    const body = methodCard.append("div")
      .style("font-size", "0.9rem").style("line-height", "1.55").style("color", "#334155");
    body.append("p").html(
      "Online vacancies over- or under-represent occupations relative to the "
      + "actual workforce. We correct this with <b>post-stratification</b>: the "
      + "skill composition is reweighted so that occupation strata match official "
      + "employment shares.");
    body.append("p").html(
      "<b>Strata</b> are ISCO-08 occupation groups taken from each ad's "
      + "standardised job title, mapped to ESCO through our NLP pipeline. We use <b>2-digit</b> groups, "
      + "collapsing a cell to its <b>1-digit</b> parent when it holds fewer than "
      + `<b>${strat.meta.min_cell}</b> ads or the official reference has no `
      + "matching 2-digit detail. Armed forces (ISCO 0) are excluded on both sides.");
    body.append("p").html(
      "<b>Weights.</b> For stratum <i>h</i> with official employment share "
      + "<i>W<sub>h</sub></i>, the stratified share of category <i>k</i> is "
      + "&Sigma;<sub>h</sub> <i>W<sub>h</sub></i> &middot; <i>p<sub>h</sub></i>(<i>k</i>), "
      + "where <i>p<sub>h</sub></i>(<i>k</i>) is the within-stratum share of <i>k</i>. "
      + "<b>Raw</b> shows the same vacancy sample with no reweighting.");
    body.append("div")
      .style("font-weight", "800").style("color", "#0f172a")
      .style("margin", "0.6rem 0 0.3rem").text("Estimator: Pooled vs Within-posting");
    body.append("p").html(
      "<b>Pooled</b> counts every skill mention equally: the share of bucket "
      + "<i>S<sub>k</sub></i> is its mentions divided by all mentions in the sample, "
      + "so postings with many skills weigh more.");
    body.append("p").html(
      "<b>Within-posting</b> gives every posting equal weight. For each posting "
      + "<i>i</i> we compute the composition (the % of its skills that fall in "
      + "each bucket) and then average those compositions across postings: "
      + "<i>p&#770;<sub>S<sub>k</sub></sub></i> = (1/N) &Sigma;<sub>i</sub> "
      + "(skills in bucket <i>S<sub>k</sub></i> in posting <i>i</i> / all skills in posting <i>i</i>). "
      + "This avoids letting skill-heavy postings dominate. The switch applies to "
      + "both the raw and stratified views.");
    body.append("p").html(
      "<b>Two national exceptions.</b> Korea's reference uses KSCO, whose major "
      + "groups do not map 1:1 to ISCO, so Korea is stratified on a harmonised "
      + "1-digit scheme (ISCO 2+3 &rarr; professionals incl. technicians; "
      + "ISCO 5 &rarr; service + sales). Malaysia has no official 2-digit detail, "
      + "so it uses 1-digit strata.");

    body.append("div")
      .style("font-weight", "800").style("color", "#0f172a")
      .style("margin", "0.6rem 0 0.3rem").text("Reference employment data");
    body.append("p").html(
      "Sample: online vacancies whose job titles were standardised to ESCO occupation groups through our NLP pipeline (~100% of the "
      + "ESCO-mapped ads). Reference: <i>official ISCO "
      + "employment shares</i> compiled from ILOSTAT and national statistical "
      + "offices — DGBAS (Taiwan), KOSIS (Korea), DOSM (Malaysia) — latest "
      + "available year; see the technical annex for per-country sources and years.");

    const tbl = body.append("table")
      .style("width", "100%").style("border-collapse", "collapse")
      .style("font-size", "0.82rem").style("margin-top", "0.35rem");
    const thr = tbl.append("thead").append("tr");
    ["Country", "Vacancies (coded)", "Strata", "Stratification level"].forEach((h, i) => {
      thr.append("th").text(h)
        .style("text-align", i === 0 ? "left" : "right")
        .style("padding", "0.3rem 0.4rem").style("border-bottom", "1px solid #e2e8f0")
        .style("color", "#475569").style("font-weight", "800");
    });
    const tb = tbl.append("tbody");
    baseCountries.forEach(c => {
      const d = strat.countries[c];
      const tr = tb.append("tr");
      tr.append("td").text(c)
        .style("padding", "0.28rem 0.4rem").style("border-bottom", "1px solid #f1f5f9").style("font-weight", "700");
      tr.append("td").text((d.n_offers_eligible || 0).toLocaleString("en-US"))
        .style("padding", "0.28rem 0.4rem").style("text-align", "right").style("border-bottom", "1px solid #f1f5f9");
      tr.append("td").text(d.strata.n_strata)
        .style("padding", "0.28rem 0.4rem").style("text-align", "right").style("border-bottom", "1px solid #f1f5f9");
      tr.append("td").text(d.strata.level)
        .style("padding", "0.28rem 0.4rem").style("text-align", "right").style("border-bottom", "1px solid #f1f5f9").style("color", "#475569");
    });
    methodModal.style("display", "flex");
  }

  const controls = wrap.append("div").attr("class", "heat-panel-tools")
    .style("margin-bottom", "0.7rem").style("align-items", "center");
  const modeWrap = controls.append("div")
    .style("display", "inline-flex").style("border", "1px solid #cbd5e1")
    .style("border-radius", "999px").style("overflow", "hidden");
  const modeButtons = {};
  [["stratified", "Stratified"], ["raw", "Raw"]].forEach(([value, label]) => {
    modeButtons[value] = modeWrap.append("button")
      .attr("type", "button")
      .style("border", "none").style("padding", "0.32rem 0.85rem")
      .style("font-weight", "800").style("font-size", "0.82rem").style("cursor", "pointer")
      .text(label)
      .on("click", () => setMode(value));
  });

  const estWrap = controls.append("div")
    .style("display", "inline-flex").style("border", "1px solid #cbd5e1")
    .style("border-radius", "999px").style("overflow", "hidden");
  const estButtons = {};
  [["pooled", "Pooled"], ["within", "Within-posting"]].forEach(([value, label]) => {
    estButtons[value] = estWrap.append("button")
      .attr("type", "button")
      .style("border", "none").style("padding", "0.32rem 0.85rem")
      .style("font-weight", "800").style("font-size", "0.82rem").style("cursor", "pointer")
      .text(label)
      .on("click", () => setEstimator(value));
  });

  controls.append("button")
    .attr("type", "button").attr("class", "heat-export-btn")
    .text("method & sources")
    .on("click", showMethod);

  function paintMode() {
    Object.entries(modeButtons).forEach(([value, btn]) => {
      const on = value === viewState.mode;
      btn.style("background", on ? "#2563eb" : "#ffffff")
         .style("color", on ? "#ffffff" : "#475569");
    });
    Object.entries(estButtons).forEach(([value, btn]) => {
      const on = value === viewState.estimator;
      btn.style("background", on ? "#0f766e" : "#ffffff")
         .style("color", on ? "#ffffff" : "#475569");
    });
  }

  const clegend = wrap.append("div").attr("class", "heat-legend-box");
  clegend.append("div").attr("class", "heat-legend-title").text("Countries");
  const clegendItems = clegend.append("div").attr("class", "heat-legend");
  baseCountries.forEach(c => {
    const item = clegendItems.append("div").attr("class", "heat-legend-item");
    item.append("span").attr("class", "heat-legend-code")
      .style("color", regionPalette[regionFor(c)]).text(iso2[c]);
    item.append("span").attr("class", "heat-legend-label").text(c);
  });

  const chartHost = wrap.append("div").attr("class", "compare-charts");

  async function ensureXlsx() {
    if (window.XLSX) return window.XLSX;
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const script = document.createElement("script");
      script.src = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/xlsx@0.18.5/dist/xlsx.full.min.js";
      script.async = true;
      script.onload = resolve;
      script.onerror = reject;
      document.head.appendChild(script);
    });
    return window.XLSX;
  }

  function sortedRows(rows, countrySort) {
    if (countrySort === "default") return [...rows];
    return [...rows].sort((a, b) =>
      (b.values[countrySort] || 0) - (a.values[countrySort] || 0) ||
      a.code.localeCompare(b.code)
    );
  }

  function sortedCountries(rows, categorySort) {
    if (categorySort === "default") return [...baseCountries];
    const row = rows.find(d => d.code === categorySort);
    if (!row) return [...baseCountries];
    const sorter = (a, b) =>
      (row.values[b] || 0) - (row.values[a] || 0) ||
      iso2[a].localeCompare(iso2[b]);
    return [
      ...eastAsia.filter(c => baseCountries.includes(c)).sort(sorter),
      ...benchmark.filter(c => baseCountries.includes(c)).sort(sorter)
    ];
  }

  function drawHeatmap({ rows, columns, paletteInterpolator, metaLookup, groupedColumns }) {
    const eastAsiaCount = columns.filter(c => regionFor(c) === "East Asia").length;
    const groupGap = groupedColumns ? 18 : 0;
    const margin = { top: groupedColumns ? 44 : 28, right: 12, bottom: 6, left: 40 };
    const cellW = 46, cellH = 26, pad = 3;
    const xForCol = i => margin.left + i * cellW + (groupedColumns && i >= eastAsiaCount ? groupGap : 0);
    const width = margin.left + columns.length * cellW + groupGap + margin.right;
    const height = margin.top + rows.length * cellH + margin.bottom;
    const maxShare = d3.max(rows.flatMap(r => columns.map(c => r.values[c] || 0))) || 0.001;
    const color = d3.scaleSequential([0, maxShare], paletteInterpolator);

    const svg = d3.create("svg")
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("width", width).attr("height", height)
      .style("max-width", "100%").style("height", "auto")
      .style("font-family", "system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif");

    if (groupedColumns) {
      const groups = [
        { label: "East Asia", start: 0, count: eastAsiaCount },
        { label: "Benchmark", start: eastAsiaCount, count: columns.length - eastAsiaCount }
      ].filter(g => g.count > 0);
      groups.forEach(g => {
        const sx = xForCol(g.start);
        const ex = xForCol(g.start + g.count - 1) + cellW - pad;
        svg.append("text")
          .attr("x", (sx + ex) / 2).attr("y", 13)
          .attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 10).attr("font-weight", 800)
          .attr("letter-spacing", "0.06em").attr("fill", regionPalette[g.label])
          .text(g.label.toUpperCase());
      });
    }

    columns.forEach((c, i) => {
      svg.append("text")
        .attr("x", xForCol(i) + (cellW - pad) / 2)
        .attr("y", margin.top - 8)
        .attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 11).attr("font-weight", 700)
        .attr("fill", regionPalette[regionFor(c)])
        .text(iso2[c]);
    });

    rows.forEach((row, r) => {
      const y = margin.top + r * cellH;
      svg.append("text")
        .attr("x", margin.left - 8).attr("y", y + cellH / 2 + 3)
        .attr("text-anchor", "end").attr("font-size", 10).attr("font-weight", 700)
        .attr("fill", "#475569").text(row.code);

      columns.forEach((c, ci) => {
        const value = row.values[c] || 0;
        const x = xForCol(ci);
        const cell = svg.append("g").style("cursor", "default")
          .on("mousemove", (event) => {
            const [mx, my] = d3.pointer(event, wrap.node());
            tip.style("opacity", 1)
              .style("left", (mx + 16) + "px")
              .style("top", (my + 16) + "px")
              .html(
                '<div class="heat-tip-c"><b>' + iso2[c] + '</b> ' + c + '</div>'
                + '<div class="heat-tip-r">' + row.code + ' - ' + metaLookup(row.code) + '</div>'
                + '<div class="heat-tip-v">' + pct(value) + '</div>'
              );
          })
          .on("mouseleave", () => tip.style("opacity", 0));
        cell.append("rect")
          .attr("x", x).attr("y", y)
          .attr("width", cellW - pad).attr("height", cellH - pad)
          .attr("rx", 4).attr("fill", color(value)).attr("stroke", "#ffffff");
        cell.append("text")
          .attr("x", x + (cellW - pad) / 2).attr("y", y + cellH / 2 + 3)
          .attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 8.2).attr("font-weight", 600)
          .attr("pointer-events", "none")
          .attr("fill", value > maxShare * 0.5 ? "#ffffff" : "#0f172a")
          .text(pct(value));
      });
    });

    return svg.node();
  }

  function showDescriptions(panel, rows) {
    descCard.selectAll("*").remove();
    const head = descCard.append("div")
      .style("display", "flex")
      .style("align-items", "center")
      .style("justify-content", "space-between")
      .style("gap", "0.8rem")
      .style("margin-bottom", "0.8rem");
    head.append("div")
      .style("font-size", "1rem")
      .style("font-weight", "850")
      .style("color", "#0f172a")
      .text(`${panel.title} descriptions`);
    head.append("button")
      .attr("type", "button")
      .attr("aria-label", "Close descriptions")
      .style("border", "1px solid #e2e8f0")
      .style("background", "#f8fafc")
      .style("border-radius", "999px")
      .style("padding", "0.28rem 0.58rem")
      .style("font-weight", "800")
      .style("color", "#475569")
      .style("cursor", "pointer")
      .text("Close")
      .on("click", () => descModal.style("display", "none"));

    const list = descCard.append("div")
      .style("display", "grid")
      .style("gap", "0.65rem");
    rows.forEach(row => {
      const item = list.append("div")
        .style("border", "1px solid #e2e8f0")
        .style("border-radius", "12px")
        .style("padding", "0.7rem 0.8rem")
        .style("background", "#f8fafc");
      const title = item.append("div")
        .style("display", "flex")
        .style("gap", "0.45rem")
        .style("align-items", "baseline")
        .style("margin-bottom", "0.25rem");
      title.append("span")
        .style("font-weight", "850")
        .style("color", panel.accent)
        .text(row.code);
      title.append("span")
        .style("font-weight", "780")
        .style("color", "#0f172a")
        .text(panel.metaLookup(row.code));
      item.append("div")
        .style("font-size", "0.86rem")
        .style("line-height", "1.5")
        .style("color", "#475569")
        .text(panel.descriptionLookup(row.code) || "No description available.");
    });
    descModal.style("display", "flex");
  }

  function codeLegend(host, codes, metaLookup, accent) {
    host.selectAll("*").remove();
    const leg = host.append("div").attr("class", "heat-legend");
    codes.forEach(code => {
      const item = leg.append("div").attr("class", "heat-legend-item");
      item.append("span").attr("class", "heat-legend-code").style("color", accent).text(code);
      item.append("span").attr("class", "heat-legend-label").text(metaLookup(code));
    });
  }

  function exportRows({ title, rows, columns, metaLookup, descriptionLookup }) {
    return rows.map(row => {
      const rec = {
        Code: row.code,
        Category: metaLookup(row.code),
        Description: descriptionLookup(row.code) || "",
      };
      columns.forEach(c => { rec[`${iso2[c]} (%)`] = pctExport(row.values[c] || 0); });
      return rec;
    });
  }

  function countryLegendRows(columns) {
    return columns.map(c => ({ ISO2: iso2[c], Country: c, Group: regionFor(c) }));
  }

  async function exportXlsx(panel) {
    try {
      const XLSX = await ensureXlsx();
      const rows = sortedRows(panel.baseRows, panel.state.countrySort);
      const columns = sortedCountries(panel.baseRows, panel.state.categorySort);
      const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
      XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(
        wb,
        XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(exportRows({
          title: panel.title,
          rows,
          columns,
          metaLookup: panel.metaLookup,
          descriptionLookup: panel.descriptionLookup
        })),
        panel.title
      );
      XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(countryLegendRows(columns)), "Country legend");
      XLSX.writeFile(wb, `skill_composition_${panel.title.toLowerCase()}.xlsx`);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      alert("Could not load the XLSX exporter. Please check your internet connection and try again.");
    }
  }

  function makeSelect(host, label, options, onChange) {
    const select = host.append("select")
      .attr("class", "heat-sort-select")
      .attr("aria-label", label)
      .on("change", event => onChange(event.target.value));
    select.selectAll("option")
      .data(options)
      .join("option")
      .attr("value", d => d.value)
      .text(d => d.label);
    return select;
  }

  const panels = [];

  function buildRows(dim, codes) {
    return codes.map(code => ({
      code,
      values: Object.fromEntries(baseCountries.map(c => [c, dimShares(c, dim)[code] || 0]))
    }));
  }

  function createPanel({ title, dim, codes, metaLookup, descriptionLookup, accent, paletteInterpolator }) {
    const state = { countrySort: "default", categorySort: "default" };
    const baseRows = buildRows(dim, codes);
    const panel = chartHost.append("div");
    const head = panel.append("div").attr("class", "heat-panel-head");
    head.append("div").attr("class", "compare-panel-title").text(title);
    const tools = head.append("div").attr("class", "heat-panel-tools");
    const panelRef = { title, dim, codes, baseRows, metaLookup, descriptionLookup, accent, paletteInterpolator, state };
    panels.push(panelRef);

    makeSelect(
      tools,
      `${title}: sort rows by country`,
      [{ value: "default", label: "Rows: default" }, ...baseCountries.map(c => ({ value: c, label: `Rows by ${iso2[c]}` }))],
      value => { state.countrySort = value; renderPanel(panelRef); }
    );
    makeSelect(
      tools,
      `${title}: sort columns by row`,
      [{ value: "default", label: "Columns: default" }, ...baseRows.map(r => ({ value: r.code, label: `Columns by ${r.code}` }))],
      value => { state.categorySort = value; renderPanel(panelRef); }
    );
    tools.append("button")
      .attr("type", "button")
      .attr("class", "heat-export-btn")
      .text("descriptions")
      .on("click", () => showDescriptions(panelRef, sortedRows(panelRef.baseRows, panelRef.state.countrySort)));
    tools.append("button")
      .attr("type", "button")
      .attr("class", "heat-export-btn")
      .text("xlsx")
      .on("click", () => exportXlsx(panelRef));

    panelRef.chart = panel.append("div");
    panelRef.legend = panel.append("div");
    renderPanel(panelRef);
    return panelRef;
  }

  function renderPanel(panel) {
    const rows = sortedRows(panel.baseRows, panel.state.countrySort);
    const columns = sortedCountries(panel.baseRows, panel.state.categorySort);
    panel.chart.selectAll("*").remove();
    panel.chart.append(() => drawHeatmap({
      rows,
      columns,
      paletteInterpolator: panel.paletteInterpolator,
      metaLookup: panel.metaLookup,
      groupedColumns: true
    }));
    codeLegend(panel.legend, rows.map(r => r.code), panel.metaLookup, panel.accent);
  }

  function rebuildPanels() {
    panels.forEach(panel => {
      panel.baseRows = buildRows(panel.dim, panel.codes);
      renderPanel(panel);
    });
  }

  function setMode(mode) {
    viewState.mode = mode;
    paintMode();
    rebuildPanels();
  }

  function setEstimator(estimator) {
    viewState.estimator = estimator;
    paintMode();
    rebuildPanels();
  }

  // Knowledge row order: fixed by overall prominence so the layout stays
  // stable when toggling estimator/mode.
  const knowledgeCodes = [...strat.top_knowledge_codes].sort((a, b) =>
    d3.mean(baseCountries.map(c => strat.countries[c]?.knowledge?.pooled?.stratified?.[b] || 0)) -
    d3.mean(baseCountries.map(c => strat.countries[c]?.knowledge?.pooled?.stratified?.[a] || 0))
  );

  const skillMeta = code => data.skill_meta[code] || code;
  const transversalMeta = code => data.transversal_meta[code] || code;
  const knowledgeMeta = code => data.knowledge_meta[code] || code;
  const skillDescription = code => data.skill_descriptions?.[code] || "";
  const transversalDescription = code => data.transversal_descriptions?.[code] || "";
  const knowledgeDescription = code => data.knowledge_descriptions?.[code] || "";

  createPanel({
    title: "Skills",
    dim: "skills",
    codes: skillCodes,
    metaLookup: skillMeta,
    descriptionLookup: skillDescription,
    accent: "#2563eb",
    paletteInterpolator: t => d3.interpolateRgb("#eff6ff", "#2563eb")(t)
  });

  createPanel({
    title: "Transversal",
    dim: "transversal",
    codes: transversalCodes,
    metaLookup: transversalMeta,
    descriptionLookup: transversalDescription,
    accent: "#059669",
    paletteInterpolator: t => d3.interpolateRgb("#ecfdf5", "#059669")(t)
  });

  createPanel({
    title: "Knowledge",
    dim: "knowledge",
    codes: knowledgeCodes,
    metaLookup: knowledgeMeta,
    descriptionLookup: knowledgeDescription,
    accent: "#ea580c",
    paletteInterpolator: t => d3.interpolateRgb("#fff7ed", "#ea580c")(t)
  });

  paintMode();

  return wrap.node();
}
```
:::

### Skill Distribution By ISCO Group

::: {.section-card}
#### High-, Medium-, And Low-Skilled Occupations

The panels below split ESCO-mapped **skills** and **transversal skills** by
broad occupation group: **high-skilled** occupations (ISCO 1-3),
**medium-skilled** occupations (ISCO 4-8), and **low-skilled** occupations
(ISCO 9). Each occupation group is shown as a separate full-width card, with
shares normalised separately for each country and group. Use the
**Pooled / Within-posting** switch to choose the estimator, and the
**about shares** button for what each one means.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

{
  const dist = await FileAttachment("skill_distribution_by_isco_group.json").json();
  const meta = await FileAttachment("esco_category_shares.json").json();

  const iso2 = {
    "Japan": "JP", "South Korea": "KR", "Taiwan": "TW", "Thailand": "TH",
    "Malaysia": "MY", "Singapore": "SG", "Indonesia": "ID", "Vietnam": "VN",
    "Philippines": "PH", "India": "IN", "Mexico": "MX", "Poland": "PL"
  };
  const eastAsia = ["Japan", "South Korea", "Taiwan", "Thailand", "Malaysia", "Singapore", "Indonesia", "Vietnam", "Philippines"];
  const benchmark = ["India", "Mexico", "Poland"];
  const countries = [...eastAsia, ...benchmark].filter(c => dist.countries[c]);
  const regionPalette = { "East Asia": "#2563eb", "Benchmark": "#7c3aed" };
  const regionFor = c => benchmark.includes(c) ? "Benchmark" : "East Asia";
  const pct = d3.format(".1%");

  const skillCodes = ["S1", "S2", "S3", "S4", "S5", "S6", "S7", "S8"];
  const transversalCodes = ["T1", "T2", "T3", "T4", "T5", "T6"];

  const skillMeta = code => meta.skill_meta[code] || code;
  const transversalMeta = code => meta.transversal_meta[code] || code;
  const skillDescription = code => meta.skill_descriptions?.[code] || "";
  const transversalDescription = code => meta.transversal_descriptions?.[code] || "";

  const dimensions = [
    {
      key: "skills",
      title: "Skill Distribution",
      codes: skillCodes,
      metaLookup: skillMeta,
      descriptionLookup: skillDescription,
      accent: "#2563eb",
      color: t => d3.interpolateRgb("#eff6ff", "#2563eb")(t)
    },
    {
      key: "transversal",
      title: "Transversal distribution",
      codes: transversalCodes,
      metaLookup: transversalMeta,
      descriptionLookup: transversalDescription,
      accent: "#059669",
      color: t => d3.interpolateRgb("#ecfdf5", "#059669")(t)
    }
  ];

  const groups = ["high", "medium", "low"];
  const estState = { value: "pooled" };
  const wrap = d3.create("div").style("position", "relative");
  const tip = wrap.append("div").attr("class", "heat-tip").style("opacity", 0);
  const descModal = wrap.append("div")
    .attr("role", "dialog")
    .attr("aria-modal", "true")
    .style("display", "none")
    .style("position", "fixed")
    .style("inset", "0")
    .style("z-index", "1050")
    .style("background", "rgba(15,23,42,0.42)")
    .style("align-items", "center")
    .style("justify-content", "center")
    .style("padding", "1rem");
  const descCard = descModal.append("div")
    .style("width", "min(760px, 96vw)")
    .style("max-height", "82vh")
    .style("overflow", "auto")
    .style("background", "#ffffff")
    .style("border-radius", "16px")
    .style("box-shadow", "0 24px 70px rgba(15,23,42,0.32)")
    .style("padding", "1rem 1.1rem");
  descModal.on("click", event => {
    if (event.target === descModal.node()) descModal.style("display", "none");
  });

  const clegend = wrap.append("div").attr("class", "heat-legend-box");
  clegend.append("div").attr("class", "heat-legend-title").text("Countries");
  const clegendItems = clegend.append("div").attr("class", "heat-legend");
  countries.forEach(c => {
    const item = clegendItems.append("div").attr("class", "heat-legend-item");
    item.append("span").attr("class", "heat-legend-code")
      .style("color", regionPalette[regionFor(c)]).text(iso2[c]);
    item.append("span").attr("class", "heat-legend-label").text(c);
  });

  function shareFor(c, group, dim, code) {
    return dist.countries[c]?.groups?.[group]?.[dim.key]?.[estState.value]?.[code] || 0;
  }

  function rowsFor(dim, group) {
    return dim.codes.map(code => ({
      code,
      values: Object.fromEntries(countries.map(c => [c, shareFor(c, group, dim, code)]))
    }));
  }

  function drawHeatmap({ dim, group, rows }) {
    const eastAsiaCount = countries.filter(c => regionFor(c) === "East Asia").length;
    const groupGap = 18;
    const margin = { top: 42, right: 12, bottom: 6, left: 40 };
    const cellW = 46, cellH = 24, pad = 3;
    const xForCol = i => margin.left + i * cellW + (i >= eastAsiaCount ? groupGap : 0);
    const width = margin.left + countries.length * cellW + groupGap + margin.right;
    const height = margin.top + rows.length * cellH + margin.bottom;
    const maxShare = d3.max(rows.flatMap(r => countries.map(c => r.values[c] || 0))) || 0.001;
    const color = d3.scaleSequential([0, maxShare], dim.color);

    const svg = d3.create("svg")
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("width", width).attr("height", height)
      .style("max-width", "100%").style("height", "auto")
      .style("font-family", "system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif");

    [
      { label: "East Asia", start: 0, count: eastAsiaCount },
      { label: "Benchmark", start: eastAsiaCount, count: countries.length - eastAsiaCount }
    ].filter(g => g.count > 0).forEach(g => {
      const sx = xForCol(g.start);
      const ex = xForCol(g.start + g.count - 1) + cellW - pad;
      svg.append("text")
        .attr("x", (sx + ex) / 2).attr("y", 13)
        .attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 10).attr("font-weight", 800)
        .attr("letter-spacing", "0.06em").attr("fill", regionPalette[g.label])
        .text(g.label.toUpperCase());
    });

    countries.forEach((c, i) => {
      svg.append("text")
        .attr("x", xForCol(i) + (cellW - pad) / 2)
        .attr("y", margin.top - 8)
        .attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 11).attr("font-weight", 700)
        .attr("fill", regionPalette[regionFor(c)])
        .text(iso2[c]);
    });

    rows.forEach((row, r) => {
      const y = margin.top + r * cellH;
      svg.append("text")
        .attr("x", margin.left - 8).attr("y", y + cellH / 2 + 3)
        .attr("text-anchor", "end").attr("font-size", 10).attr("font-weight", 700)
        .attr("fill", "#475569").text(row.code);

      countries.forEach((c, ci) => {
        const value = row.values[c] || 0;
        const offerCount = dist.countries[c]?.offers?.[group] || 0;
        const x = xForCol(ci);
        const cell = svg.append("g").style("cursor", "default")
          .on("mousemove", (event) => {
            const [mx, my] = d3.pointer(event, wrap.node());
            tip.style("opacity", 1)
              .style("left", (mx + 16) + "px")
              .style("top", (my + 16) + "px")
              .html(
                '<div class="heat-tip-c"><b>' + iso2[c] + '</b> ' + c + '</div>'
                + '<div class="heat-tip-r">' + dist.groups[group].label + ' (' + dist.groups[group].isco + ')</div>'
                + '<div class="heat-tip-r">' + row.code + ' - ' + dim.metaLookup(row.code) + '</div>'
                + '<div class="heat-tip-v">' + pct(value) + '</div>'
                + '<div class="heat-tip-r">Ads in group: ' + offerCount.toLocaleString("en-US") + '</div>'
              );
          })
          .on("mouseleave", () => tip.style("opacity", 0));
        cell.append("rect")
          .attr("x", x).attr("y", y)
          .attr("width", cellW - pad).attr("height", cellH - pad)
          .attr("rx", 4).attr("fill", color(value)).attr("stroke", "#ffffff");
        cell.append("text")
          .attr("x", x + (cellW - pad) / 2).attr("y", y + cellH / 2 + 3)
          .attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 8).attr("font-weight", 600)
          .attr("pointer-events", "none")
          .attr("fill", value > maxShare * 0.5 ? "#ffffff" : "#0f172a")
          .text(pct(value));
      });
    });

    return svg.node();
  }

  function codeLegend(host, codes, metaLookup, accent) {
    host.selectAll("*").remove();
    const leg = host.append("div").attr("class", "heat-legend");
    codes.forEach(code => {
      const item = leg.append("div").attr("class", "heat-legend-item");
      item.append("span").attr("class", "heat-legend-code").style("color", accent).text(code);
      item.append("span").attr("class", "heat-legend-label").text(metaLookup(code));
    });
  }

  async function ensureXlsx() {
    if (window.XLSX) return window.XLSX;
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const script = document.createElement("script");
      script.src = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/xlsx@0.18.5/dist/xlsx.full.min.js";
      script.async = true;
      script.onload = resolve;
      script.onerror = reject;
      document.head.appendChild(script);
    });
    return window.XLSX;
  }

  function showDescriptions(dim) {
    descCard.selectAll("*").remove();
    const head = descCard.append("div")
      .style("display", "flex")
      .style("align-items", "center")
      .style("justify-content", "space-between")
      .style("gap", "0.8rem")
      .style("margin-bottom", "0.8rem");
    head.append("div")
      .style("font-size", "1rem")
      .style("font-weight", "850")
      .style("color", "#0f172a")
      .text(`${dim.title} descriptions`);
    head.append("button")
      .attr("type", "button")
      .attr("aria-label", "Close descriptions")
      .style("border", "1px solid #e2e8f0")
      .style("background", "#f8fafc")
      .style("border-radius", "999px")
      .style("padding", "0.28rem 0.58rem")
      .style("font-weight", "800")
      .style("color", "#475569")
      .style("cursor", "pointer")
      .text("Close")
      .on("click", () => descModal.style("display", "none"));

    const list = descCard.append("div")
      .style("display", "grid")
      .style("gap", "0.65rem");
    dim.codes.forEach(code => {
      const item = list.append("div")
        .style("border", "1px solid #e2e8f0")
        .style("border-radius", "12px")
        .style("padding", "0.7rem 0.8rem")
        .style("background", "#f8fafc");
      const title = item.append("div")
        .style("display", "flex")
        .style("gap", "0.45rem")
        .style("align-items", "baseline")
        .style("margin-bottom", "0.25rem");
      title.append("span")
        .style("font-weight", "850")
        .style("color", dim.accent)
        .text(code);
      title.append("span")
        .style("font-weight", "780")
        .style("color", "#0f172a")
        .text(dim.metaLookup(code));
      item.append("div")
        .style("font-size", "0.86rem")
        .style("line-height", "1.5")
        .style("color", "#475569")
        .text(dim.descriptionLookup(code) || "No description available.");
    });
    descModal.style("display", "flex");
  }

  function exportRows(dim) {
    const out = [];
    groups.forEach(group => {
      dim.codes.forEach(code => {
        const rec = {
          Group: dist.groups[group].label,
          ISCO: dist.groups[group].isco,
          Code: code,
          Category: dim.metaLookup(code),
          Description: dim.descriptionLookup(code) || "",
        };
        countries.forEach(c => {
          rec[`${iso2[c]} (%)`] = Math.round(shareFor(c, group, dim, code) * 1000) / 10;
          rec[`${iso2[c]} ads`] = dist.countries[c]?.offers?.[group] || 0;
        });
        out.push(rec);
      });
    });
    return out;
  }

  async function exportXlsx(dim) {
    try {
      const XLSX = await ensureXlsx();
      const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
      XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(exportRows(dim)), dim.title);
      XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(
        wb,
        XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(countries.map(c => ({ ISO2: iso2[c], Country: c, Group: regionFor(c) }))),
        "Country legend"
      );
      XLSX.writeFile(wb, `isco_group_${dim.key}_distribution_${estState.value}.xlsx`);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      alert("Could not load the XLSX exporter. Please check your internet connection and try again.");
    }
  }

  function showInfo() {
    descCard.selectAll("*").remove();
    const head = descCard.append("div")
      .style("display", "flex").style("align-items", "center")
      .style("justify-content", "space-between").style("gap", "0.8rem")
      .style("margin-bottom", "0.8rem");
    head.append("div")
      .style("font-size", "1rem").style("font-weight", "850").style("color", "#0f172a")
      .text("How these shares are computed");
    head.append("button")
      .attr("type", "button").attr("aria-label", "Close")
      .style("border", "1px solid #e2e8f0").style("background", "#f8fafc")
      .style("border-radius", "999px").style("padding", "0.28rem 0.58rem")
      .style("font-weight", "800").style("color", "#475569").style("cursor", "pointer")
      .text("Close")
      .on("click", () => descModal.style("display", "none"));
    const body = descCard.append("div")
      .style("font-size", "0.9rem").style("line-height", "1.55").style("color", "#334155");
    body.append("p").html(
      "Each posting's standardised job title is mapped to an ESCO occupation "
      + "(ISCO-08) through our NLP pipeline, and grouped into <b>high</b> (ISCO 1-3), "
      + "<b>medium</b> (ISCO 4-8) and <b>low</b> (ISCO 9) skilled occupations. "
      + "Shares are normalised separately for each country and occupation group.");
    body.append("p").html(
      "<b>Pooled</b> counts every skill mention equally: a bucket's share is its "
      + "mentions divided by all mentions in that country-group, so skill-heavy "
      + "postings weigh more.");
    body.append("p").html(
      "<b>Within-posting</b> gives every posting equal weight. For each posting "
      + "<i>i</i> we take the % of its skills in each bucket and average across "
      + "postings: <i>p&#770;<sub>S<sub>k</sub></sub></i> = (1/N) &Sigma;<sub>i</sub> "
      + "(skills in bucket <i>S<sub>k</sub></i> in posting <i>i</i> / all skills in posting <i>i</i>).");
    descModal.style("display", "flex");
  }

  const controls = wrap.append("div").attr("class", "heat-panel-tools")
    .style("margin-bottom", "0.7rem").style("align-items", "center");
  const estWrap = controls.append("div")
    .style("display", "inline-flex").style("border", "1px solid #cbd5e1")
    .style("border-radius", "999px").style("overflow", "hidden");
  const estButtons = {};
  [["pooled", "Pooled"], ["within", "Within-posting"]].forEach(([value, label]) => {
    estButtons[value] = estWrap.append("button")
      .attr("type", "button")
      .style("border", "none").style("padding", "0.32rem 0.85rem")
      .style("font-weight", "800").style("font-size", "0.82rem").style("cursor", "pointer")
      .text(label)
      .on("click", () => setEstimator(value));
  });
  controls.append("button")
    .attr("type", "button").attr("class", "heat-export-btn")
    .text("about shares")
    .on("click", showInfo);

  function paintEstimator() {
    Object.entries(estButtons).forEach(([value, btn]) => {
      const on = value === estState.value;
      btn.style("background", on ? "#0f766e" : "#ffffff")
         .style("color", on ? "#ffffff" : "#475569");
    });
  }

  const host = wrap.append("div").style("display", "grid").style("gap", "1.1rem");

  function renderAll() {
    host.selectAll("*").remove();
    dimensions.forEach(dim => {
      const section = host.append("div").style("display", "grid").style("gap", "0.65rem");
      const head = section.append("div").attr("class", "heat-panel-head");
      head.append("div")
        .attr("class", "compare-panel-title")
        .style("color", dim.accent)
        .text(dim.title);
      const tools = head.append("div").attr("class", "heat-panel-tools");
      tools.append("button")
        .attr("type", "button")
        .attr("class", "heat-export-btn")
        .text("descriptions")
        .on("click", () => showDescriptions(dim));
      tools.append("button")
        .attr("type", "button")
        .attr("class", "heat-export-btn")
        .text("xlsx")
        .on("click", () => exportXlsx(dim));

      const grid = section.append("div")
        .style("display", "grid")
        .style("gap", "0.75rem");

      groups.forEach(group => {
        const panel = grid.append("div")
          .style("border", "1px solid #e2e8f0")
          .style("border-radius", "14px")
          .style("padding", "0.75rem")
          .style("background", "#ffffff");
        panel.append("div")
          .style("font-weight", "850")
          .style("font-size", "0.94rem")
          .style("color", "#0f172a")
          .text(`${dist.groups[group].label} (${dist.groups[group].isco})`);
        panel.append("div")
          .style("font-size", "0.78rem")
          .style("color", "#64748b")
          .style("margin-bottom", "0.35rem")
          .text(estState.value === "within"
            ? "Within-posting average; each country column sums to 100% within this occupation group."
            : "Pooled mentions; each country column sums to 100% within this occupation group.");
        panel.append(() => drawHeatmap({ dim, group, rows: rowsFor(dim, group) }));
      });

      const legend = section.append("div");
      codeLegend(legend, dim.codes, dim.metaLookup, dim.accent);
    });
  }

  function setEstimator(value) {
    estState.value = value;
    paintEstimator();
    renderAll();
  }

  paintEstimator();
  renderAll();

  return wrap.node();
}
```
