### Digital skills

::: {.section-card}
#### Digital skills prevalence

Using an adapted version of the digital-skill classification from
<a class="paper-link" href="https://openknowledge.worldbank.org/entities/publication/fff2f3aa-3e52-4623-94de-db5f8067d112" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Chenin &amp; Montorsi (2025)<span class="source-link-ext">↗</span><span class="paper-tooltip" role="tooltip">Chenin, M., &amp; Montorsi, C. (2025). <em>Exploring Digital Skills Demand: Key Insights from Online Job Vacancies in South Africa, Nigeria, Kenya, and Uganda.</em> Education Working Paper Series, No. 21. Washington, DC: World Bank.</span></a>,
the chart below shows the current **composition of digital skill mentions**
after deduplication and the ICT-offer merge. Within each country, Basic,
Intermediate, and Advanced sum to 100% of classified digital-skill mentions.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

{
  const data = await FileAttachment("digital_skill_bia_by_country_after_ict_merge.csv").csv({typed: true});
  const levelOrder = ["Basic", "Intermediate", "Advanced"];
  const eastAsiaCountries = new Set([
    "Japan", "South Korea", "Singapore", "Taiwan",
    "Malaysia", "Thailand", "Indonesia", "Vietnam", "Philippines"
  ]);
  const regionPalette = {
    "East Asia": "#2563eb",
    "Benchmark": "#7c3aed"
  };
  const palette = {
    Basic: "#93c5fd",
    Intermediate: "#3b82f6",
    Advanced: "#1d4ed8"
  };
  const regionForCountry = country => (
    eastAsiaCountries.has(country) ? "East Asia" : "Benchmark"
  );

  const baseRows = [...data]
    .map(d => ({
      country: d.country,
      mentions: d.digital_mentions,
      Basic: d.basic_mentions_pct / 100,
      Intermediate: d.intermediate_mentions_pct / 100,
      Advanced: d.advanced_mentions_pct / 100
    }));

  const wrap = d3.create("div");
  const controls = wrap.append("div").attr("class", "compare-controls");
  controls.append("button")
    .attr("type", "button")
    .attr("class", "heat-export-btn")
    .text("xlsx")
    .on("click", exportXlsx);
  wrap.append("div")
    .attr("class", "compare-note")
    .text("Shares of classified digital-skill mentions; bars sum to 100% within each country.");
  const chartHost = wrap.append("div");

  async function ensureXlsx() {
    if (window.XLSX) return window.XLSX;
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const script = document.createElement("script");
      script.src = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/xlsx@0.18.5/dist/xlsx.full.min.js";
      script.async = true;
      script.onload = resolve;
      script.onerror = reject;
      document.head.appendChild(script);
    });
    return window.XLSX;
  }

  async function exportXlsx() {
    try {
      const XLSX = await ensureXlsx();
      const rows = orderedRows().rows.map(row => ({
        Country: row.country,
        Group: regionForCountry(row.country),
        "Basic (%)": row.Basic * 100,
        "Intermediate (%)": row.Intermediate * 100,
        "Advanced (%)": row.Advanced * 100,
        "Digital skill mentions": row.mentions
      }));
      const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
      XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(rows), "Digital skills BIA");
      XLSX.writeFile(wb, "digital_skills_bia_composition.xlsx");
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      alert("Could not load the XLSX exporter. Please check your internet connection and try again.");
    }
  }

  const orderedRows = () => {
    const byAdvanced = (a, b) => b.Advanced - a.Advanced;
    const eaRows = baseRows
      .filter(row => regionForCountry(row.country) === "East Asia")
      .sort(byAdvanced);
    const benchmarkRows = baseRows
      .filter(row => regionForCountry(row.country) === "Benchmark")
      .sort(byAdvanced);
    return {
      rows: [...eaRows, ...benchmarkRows],
      groups: [
        { label: "East Asia", count: eaRows.length, startIndex: 0 },
        { label: "Benchmark", count: benchmarkRows.length, startIndex: eaRows.length },
      ].filter(group => group.count > 0),
    };
  };

  function render() {
    const { rows, groups } = orderedRows();
    const margin = {top: 34, right: 24, bottom: 28, left: 150};
    const rowH = 30;
    const width = 900;
    const groupGap = groups.length > 1 ? 22 : 0;
    const benchmarkStartIndex = groups.length > 1 ? groups[1].startIndex : null;
    const yForRow = i => margin.top + i * rowH + (benchmarkStartIndex != null && i >= benchmarkStartIndex ? groupGap : 0);
    const height = margin.top + rows.length * rowH + groupGap + margin.bottom;

    chartHost.selectAll("*").remove();

    const svg = d3.create("svg")
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .style("max-width", "100%")
      .style("height", "auto");

    const x = d3.scaleLinear()
      .domain([0, 1])
      .range([margin.left, width - margin.right]);

    const legend = svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${margin.left}, 14)`);

    levelOrder.forEach((level, i) => {
      const g = legend.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${i * 160}, 0)`);
      g.append("rect")
        .attr("width", 14)
        .attr("height", 14)
        .attr("rx", 3)
        .attr("fill", palette[level]);
      g.append("text")
        .attr("x", 20)
        .attr("y", 11)
        .attr("font-size", 12)
        .attr("font-weight", 700)
        .attr("fill", "#334155")
        .text(level);
    });

    groups.forEach(group => {
      const y = yForRow(group.startIndex) - 8;
      svg.append("text")
        .attr("x", margin.left - 12)
        .attr("y", y)
        .attr("text-anchor", "end")
        .attr("font-size", 11)
        .attr("font-weight", 800)
        .attr("letter-spacing", "0.06em")
        .attr("fill", regionPalette[group.label])
        .text(group.label.toUpperCase());
    });

    rows.forEach((row, i) => {
      const y0 = yForRow(i);

      svg.append("text")
        .attr("x", margin.left - 12)
        .attr("y", y0 + 17)
        .attr("text-anchor", "end")
        .attr("font-size", 12)
        .attr("font-weight", 700)
        .attr("fill", "#334155")
        .text(row.country);

      let x0 = margin.left;
      levelOrder.forEach((level, j) => {
        const value = row[level];
        const w = x(value) - x(0);
        svg.append("rect")
          .attr("x", x0)
          .attr("y", y0 + 5)
          .attr("width", w)
          .attr("height", 20)
          .attr("rx", 6)
          .attr("fill", palette[level]);

        if (w > 54) {
          svg.append("text")
            .attr("x", x0 + w / 2)
            .attr("y", y0 + 19)
            .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
            .attr("font-size", 11)
            .attr("font-weight", 700)
            .attr("fill", j === 0 ? "#1e3a8a" : "#ffffff")
            .text(d3.format(".1%")(value));
        }
        x0 += w;
      });
    });

    chartHost.append(() => svg.node());
  }

  render();
  return wrap.node();
}
```

:::

::: {.section-card}
#### Digital skill mix over time

The previous section presents the composition of digital-skill demand as a
single snapshot. This section examines how the mix changes over time by tracking
the monthly distribution of digital skill mentions across three proficiency
bands: Basic, Intermediate, and Advanced. To reduce short-term volatility, the
series are presented as 3-month rolling averages. Within each country-month, the
three bands sum to 100 percent.

The analysis is based on the composition of digital skill mentions rather than
on the share of job postings that include at least one skill from a given
proficiency band. This approach provides a more consistent measure of skill
demand, as it focuses on the relative structure of extracted digital skills
within each country and month. It also reduces sensitivity to differences in the
number of skills extracted per posting, which may vary across data sources,
occupations, posting formats, and processing conditions.

The monthly series are not directly comparable to the aggregate statistics
presented above. For Japan, Korea, and Taiwan, a subset of postings from job
portals contained only year-level information in 2026 and could therefore not be
assigned to a specific month. These postings are included in the aggregate
statistics but excluded from the monthly time-series analysis. As a result, the
monthly estimates for these countries are based on a narrower subset of postings
and may show a different skill composition. In particular, the aggregate data
indicate a higher share of Advanced digital skills than is visible in the
monthly series.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

digMix = FileAttachment("digital_level_composition.json").json()
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

{
  const data = digMix;
  const months = data.months;
  const LEVELS = [
    { key: "Basic",        label: "Basic",        color: "#60a5fa" },
    { key: "Intermediate", label: "Intermediate", color: "#2563eb" },
    { key: "Advanced",     label: "Advanced",     color: "#1e3a8a" }
  ];
  const eastAsia = Object.entries(data.countries).filter(([, m]) => m.group === "East Asia").map(([n]) => n).sort(d3.ascending);
  const benchmark = Object.entries(data.countries).filter(([, m]) => m.group === "Benchmark").map(([n]) => n).sort(d3.ascending);
  const countriesAll = [...eastAsia, ...benchmark];
  const WIN = data.rolling_window_months || 3;

  // Distinct palette for the country-comparison view.
  const cpalette = {
    "Japan": "#dc2626", "South Korea": "#ea580c", "Taiwan": "#d97706",
    "Singapore": "#0d9488", "Thailand": "#0891b2", "Malaysia": "#7c3aed",
    "Indonesia": "#9333ea", "Vietnam": "#2563eb", "Philippines": "#4f46e5",
    "India": "#64748b", "Mexico": "#94a3b8", "Poland": "#16a34a"
  };

  const state = { country: "Indonesia" };

  // precomputed composition share (%) for a country-month-level
  const share = (country, ym, key) => {
    const r = (data.raw || {})[country];
    const v = r && r[ym] ? r[ym][key] : null;
    return (v == null) ? null : v;
  };
  // 3-month trailing rolling average of the composition share
  const rolling = (country, key) => months.map((ym, i) => {
    const win = [];
    for (let k = Math.max(0, i - WIN + 1); k <= i; k++) {
      const v = share(country, months[k], key);
      if (v != null) win.push(v);
    }
    return { i, ym, v: win.length ? d3.mean(win) : null };
  }).filter(d => d.v != null);

  const fmtMonth = ym => { const [yy, mm] = ym.split("-"); return ["Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"][+mm - 1] + " " + yy; };

  const wrap = d3.create("div").style("font-family", "system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif").style("position", "relative");
  const ctrlRow = wrap.append("div").style("margin", "0.1rem 0 0.6rem 0");
  const plot = wrap.append("div");
  const tip = wrap.append("div").attr("class", "cs-tooltip");

  function pill(host, txt, active, onClick, dotColor) {
    const b = host.append("button").attr("type", "button")
      .style("display", "inline-flex").style("align-items", "center").style("gap", "0.4rem")
      .style("padding", "3px 10px").style("margin", "0 0.35rem 0.35rem 0").style("border", "1px solid #e2e8f0").style("border-radius", "999px")
      .style("background", "#fff").style("cursor", "pointer").style("font-size", "12px").style("font-weight", "600")
      .style("opacity", active ? 1 : 0.45).style("color", active ? "#1e293b" : "#94a3b8");
    if (dotColor) b.append("span").style("width", "10px").style("height", "10px").style("border-radius", "50%").style("background", dotColor);
    b.append("span").text(txt);
    b.on("click", onClick);
    return b;
  }

  function buildControls() {
    ctrlRow.selectAll("*").remove();
    ctrlRow.append("div").style("font-size", "11px").style("font-weight", "600").style("color", "#94a3b8").style("text-transform", "uppercase").style("letter-spacing", "0.04em").style("margin-bottom", "0.3rem").text("Market");
    renderGroups(ctrlRow, c => state.country === c, c => { state.country = c; buildControls(); render(); }, false);
  }

  // East Asia and Benchmark rendered as separate, alphabetically ordered groups.
  function renderGroups(host, isActive, onClick, withDot) {
    [["East Asia", eastAsia], ["Benchmark", benchmark]].forEach(([gLabel, list]) => {
      if (!list.length) return;
      const row = host.append("div").style("display", "flex").style("align-items", "baseline").style("flex-wrap", "wrap").style("gap", "0.1rem 0.5rem").style("margin-bottom", "0.35rem");
      row.append("span").style("font-size", "10px").style("font-weight", "700").style("color", "#cbd5e1").style("text-transform", "uppercase").style("letter-spacing", "0.04em").style("min-width", "70px").text(gLabel);
      const pills = row.append("div");
      list.forEach(c => pill(pills, c, isActive(c), () => onClick(c), withDot ? cpalette[c] : null));
    });
  }

  function render() {
    plot.selectAll("*").remove();
    const series = LEVELS.map(L => ({ label: L.label, color: L.color, pts: rolling(state.country, L.key) }));
    const ymax = Math.min(100, (d3.max(series.flatMap(s => s.pts.map(d => d.v))) || 1) * 1.15);

    const W = 760, H = 340, m = { t: 30, r: 120, b: 44, l: 46 };
    const iw = W - m.l - m.r, ih = H - m.t - m.b;
    const svg = plot.append("svg").attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${W} ${H}`).style("width", "100%").style("max-width", `${W}px`).style("height", "auto").style("font-family", "system-ui,sans-serif");
    const gph = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${m.l},${m.t})`);
    const x = d3.scalePoint().domain(d3.range(months.length)).range([0, iw]).padding(0.5);
    const y = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0, ymax]).range([ih, 0]).nice();
    y.ticks(5).forEach(t => {
      gph.append("line").attr("x1", 0).attr("x2", iw).attr("y1", y(t)).attr("y2", y(t)).attr("stroke", "#eef2f7");
      gph.append("text").attr("x", -8).attr("y", y(t)).attr("dy", "0.32em").attr("text-anchor", "end").attr("font-size", "10px").attr("fill", "#94a3b8").text(t + "%");
    });
    months.forEach((mn, i) => {
      gph.append("text").attr("x", x(i)).attr("y", ih + 22).attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", "9.5px").attr("fill", "#94a3b8").text(mn.slice(2));
    });
    gph.append("text").attr("x", 0).attr("y", -16).attr("font-size", "10px").attr("fill", "#64748b").text(`${state.country} · % of digital mentions · ${WIN}-mo avg`);

    const seg2 = d3.line().x(d => x(d.i)).y(d => y(d.v));
    series.forEach(s => {
      for (let k = 1; k < s.pts.length; k++) {
        const a = s.pts[k - 1], b = s.pts[k], gap = b.i - a.i > 1;
        gph.append("path").datum([a, b]).attr("fill", "none").attr("stroke", s.color)
          .attr("stroke-width", 2.2).attr("stroke-dasharray", gap ? "4 4" : null).attr("opacity", gap ? 0.5 : 1).attr("d", seg2);
      }
      const last = s.pts[s.pts.length - 1];
      if (last) gph.append("text").attr("x", x(last.i) + 8).attr("y", y(last.v)).attr("dy", "0.32em").attr("font-size", "10px").attr("font-weight", "600").attr("fill", s.color).text(s.label);
      gph.selectAll(null).data(s.pts).join("circle").attr("cx", d => x(d.i)).attr("cy", d => y(d.v)).attr("r", 2.6).attr("fill", s.color).style("cursor", "pointer")
        .on("mouseenter", function (event, d) {
          d3.select(this).interrupt().transition().duration(90).attr("r", 5).attr("stroke", "#fff").attr("stroke-width", 2);
          tip.style("opacity", 1).html(`<div class="cs-tip-h">${s.label} · ${fmtMonth(d.ym)}</div><div class="cs-tip-v">${d.v.toFixed(1)}%<span>${WIN}-mo avg of digital mentions</span></div>`);
        })
        .on("mousemove", function (event) { const [mx, my] = d3.pointer(event, wrap.node()); tip.style("left", (mx + 16) + "px").style("top", (my + 12) + "px"); })
        .on("mouseleave", function () { d3.select(this).interrupt().transition().duration(130).attr("r", 2.6).attr("stroke", null); tip.style("opacity", 0); });
    });

    plot.append("div").style("font-size", "0.78rem").style("color", "#94a3b8").style("margin-top", "0.4rem")
      .html(`${WIN}-month trailing rolling average of the digital-skill mention mix (the three bands sum to 100% within each country-month). Composition conditions on a digital mention, so it is not distorted by how many skills are extracted per posting.`);
  }

  buildControls();
  render();
  return wrap.node();
}
```

:::

::: {.section-card}
#### Advanced and intermediate digital profiles

The table below summarises each country's digital profile. Use the toggles to
switch between the **Advanced** and **Intermediate** layers, between the two
ranking methods, and between the **Limited** and **Wide** skill classifications.
For each country it separates the most frequently mentioned concepts
(**Common**) from those that are statistically over-represented relative to the
rest of the sample (**Distinctive**); distinctive labels exclude any concept
already shown as common.

The digital-skill classification is supplied externally (World Bank) and is
offered in two variants. **Wide** uses the classification exactly as received.
**Limited** is a cleaned view that resets a small set of false positives —
concepts without genuine IT content (e.g. domain engineering, finance, teaching,
or logistics labels mistakenly tagged as digital) — to non-digital, with totals
and baselines recomputed accordingly. Limited is the preferred view; Wide is kept
for transparency.

##### Identifying distinctive digital skills by country

To identify which digital skills characterise each country's labour market, we
draw on methods originally developed for computational text analysis —
specifically, keyness analysis. The core intuition is straightforward: a skill is
"distinctive" for a country not simply because it appears frequently there, but
because it appears more often than one would expect given how common that skill is
across all countries combined. This controls for the fact that some skills
(e.g. communication tools) are universally demanded, while others are genuinely
country-specific signals.

Concretely, we treat each country's pool of job postings as a corpus and each
digital skill as a vocabulary item. For every skill, we compare its relative
frequency in a given country against its relative frequency in the remaining eight
countries pooled together. A skill that is over-represented in one country
relative to this baseline is flagged as distinctive for that country; a skill that
is under-represented is flagged as comparatively absent.

We apply two complementary measures. The first, the log-likelihood ratio
(G², Dunning 1993), is a standard statistical test of whether the observed
difference in frequency could plausibly arise by chance. The second, the weighted
log-odds ratio (Monroe, Colaresi &amp; Quinn 2008), goes a step further: it
accounts for the fact that estimates based on rare skills are inherently less
reliable than those based on common ones. By incorporating a smoothing prior and
standardising by the uncertainty of each estimate, this approach prevents skills
that happen to appear in only a handful of postings from dominating the rankings.
We use the log-odds measure as our primary ranking criterion and G² as a
robustness check; results are consistent across both.

The analysis is conducted separately for intermediate and advanced digital
skills, with each level's ranking computed relative to its own baseline frequency
— ensuring that the two tiers are not conflated. The output for each country is a
ranked list of skills that are distinctively over-represented, providing a
compact, interpretable signature of each country's digital skill demand profile.

{
  const order = ["Japan", "South Korea", "Singapore", "Taiwan", "Malaysia", "Thailand", "Indonesia", "Vietnam", "Philippines"];
  const state = { classification: "limited", level: "Advanced", method: "logodds" };
  const methodLabel = { logodds: "Log-odds (Monroe)", g2: "G² (Dunning)" };
  const classLabel = { wide: "Wide classification", limited: "Limited classification" };
  const scoreName = { logodds: "z", g2: "G²" };
  const N_DISTINCT = 2;
  const profilesFor = () => digitalProfilesData[state.classification];

  const wrap = d3.create("div").style("font-family", "system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif");

  // ---- toggles ----
  const bar = wrap.append("div").style("display", "flex").style("flex-wrap", "wrap").style("gap", "1.2rem").style("margin", "0.2rem 0 0.8rem 0").style("align-items", "center");
  const btnStyle = active =>
    `padding:6px 16px;font-size:12px;font-weight:${active ? 700 : 500};cursor:pointer;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;`
    + `background:${active ? "#0f172a" : "#fff"};color:${active ? "#fff" : "#475569"};transition:all .15s`;

  function group(parent, label, options, key) {
    const g = parent.append("div").style("display", "flex").style("align-items", "center").style("gap", "0.5rem");
    g.append("span").style("font-size", "11px").style("font-weight", "600").style("color", "#94a3b8").style("text-transform", "uppercase").style("letter-spacing", "0.04em").text(label);
    const box = g.append("div").style("display", "flex");
    const btns = options.map(([val, txt], i) => {
      const radius = i === 0 ? "6px 0 0 6px" : (i === options.length - 1 ? "0 6px 6px 0" : "0");
      const b = box.append("button").attr("style", btnStyle(state[key] === val) + `;border-radius:${radius}` + (i > 0 ? ";border-left:none" : "")).text(txt);
      b.on("click", () => { state[key] = val; refreshBtns(); render(); });
      return { val, b, radius, first: i === 0 };
    });
    return btns;
  }

  const levelBtns = group(bar, "Layer", [["Advanced", "Advanced"], ["Intermediate", "Intermediate"]], "level");
  const methodBtns = group(bar, "Method", [["logodds", "Log-odds"], ["g2", "G²"]], "method");
  const classBtns = group(bar, "Classification", [["limited", "Limited"], ["wide", "Wide"]], "classification");

  function refreshBtns() {
    levelBtns.forEach(o => o.b.attr("style", btnStyle(state.level === o.val) + `;border-radius:${o.radius}` + (o.first ? "" : ";border-left:none")));
    methodBtns.forEach(o => o.b.attr("style", btnStyle(state.method === o.val) + `;border-radius:${o.radius}` + (o.first ? "" : ";border-left:none")));
    classBtns.forEach(o => o.b.attr("style", btnStyle(state.classification === o.val) + `;border-radius:${o.radius}` + (o.first ? "" : ";border-left:none")));
  }

  // legend
  const legend = wrap.append("div")
    .style("display", "flex").style("gap", "1.2rem").style("align-items", "center")
    .style("margin", "0 0 0.7rem 0").style("font-size", "0.88rem").style("flex-wrap", "wrap");
  legend.append("span").html('<span class="skill-pill-common" style="font-size:0.78rem;">example</span> = most frequent within the country (Common)');
  legend.append("span").html('<span class="skill-pill-distinctive" style="font-size:0.78rem;">example</span> = statistically over-represented vs. the rest of the sample (Distinctive)');

  const tableHost = wrap.append("div").style("overflow-x", "auto");

  const fwTitle = wrap.append("h5").style("margin", "1.6rem 0 0.2rem 0").style("font-size", "1rem");
  const fwSub = wrap.append("p").style("margin", "0 0 0.9rem 0").style("font-size", "0.85rem").style("color", "#475569");
  const fwHost = wrap.append("div").style("display", "grid").style("grid-template-columns", "repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr))").style("gap", "0.9rem 1.4rem");

  function distinctiveLabels(cd) {
    const out = [];
    for (const r of cd[state.method]) {
      if (cd.common.includes(r.label) || out.includes(r.label)) continue;
      out.push(r.label);
      if (out.length >= N_DISTINCT) break;
    }
    return out;
  }

  function render() {
    // table
    tableHost.selectAll("*").remove();
    const level = profilesFor()[state.level];
    const tbl = tableHost.append("table").style("width", "100%").style("border-collapse", "collapse").style("font-size", "0.95rem").style("text-align", "left");
    const thead = tbl.append("thead").append("tr").style("border-bottom", "2px solid #cbd5e1");
    thead.append("th").style("padding", "8px").style("text-align", "left").style("width", "150px").text("Country");
    thead.append("th").style("padding", "8px").style("text-align", "left").text("Characteristic labels");
    const tbody = tbl.append("tbody");
    order.forEach(country => {
      const cd = level[country];
      if (!cd) return;
      const tr = tbody.append("tr").style("border-bottom", "1px solid #e2e8f0");
      tr.append("td").style("padding", "8px").style("vertical-align", "top").html(`<strong>${country}</strong>`);
      const cell = tr.append("td").style("padding", "8px").style("vertical-align", "top");
      const commonRow = cell.append("div").attr("class", "skill-pill-row");
      cd.common.forEach(s => commonRow.append("span").attr("class", "skill-pill-common").text(s));
      const dist = distinctiveLabels(cd);
      if (dist.length) {
        const distRow = cell.append("div").style("margin-top", "6px").attr("class", "skill-pill-row");
        dist.forEach(s => distRow.append("span").attr("class", "skill-pill-distinctive").text(s));
      }
    });
    tableHost.append("div").style("text-align", "left").style("color", "#64748b").style("padding-top", "0.5rem").style("font-size", "0.85rem")
      .text(`${state.level} digital profiles across East Asia (${classLabel[state.classification]}), ranked by ${methodLabel[state.method]}. Each country row separates the most common concepts from the most distinctive ones relative to the rest of the sample.`);

    // fighting words
    fwTitle.text(`Most distinctive ${state.level.toLowerCase()} digital terms`);
    fwSub.text(`Ranked by ${methodLabel[state.method]} (${classLabel[state.classification]}). For each country, bars show the digital concepts most over-used relative to the rest of the sample.`);
    fwHost.selectAll("*").remove();
    const zMax = d3.max(order.flatMap(c => (level[c] ? level[c][state.method] : []).map(d => d.score))) || 1;
    const x = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0, zMax]).range([0, 100]);
    order.forEach(country => {
      const rows = level[country] ? level[country][state.method] : [];
      if (!rows.length) return;
      const card = fwHost.append("div").style("border", "1px solid #e2e8f0").style("border-radius", "8px").style("padding", "0.7rem 0.8rem");
      card.append("div").style("font-weight", "700").style("font-size", "0.9rem").style("margin-bottom", "0.5rem").text(country);
      rows.forEach(d => {
        const r = card.append("div").style("margin-bottom", "0.4rem");
        r.append("div").style("display", "flex").style("justify-content", "space-between").style("font-size", "0.78rem").style("color", "#334155").style("margin-bottom", "2px")
          .call(g => { g.append("span").text(d.label); g.append("span").style("color", "#94a3b8").style("padding-left", "0.5rem").text(`${scoreName[state.method]} ${d.score}`); });
        r.append("div").style("height", "6px").style("background", "#f1f5f9").style("border-radius", "3px")
          .append("div").style("height", "100%").style("border-radius", "3px").style("background", "#2563eb").style("width", `${x(d.score)}%`);
      });
    });
  }

  refreshBtns();
  render();
  return wrap.node();
}
```

:::





::: {.section-card}
#### Digital skill co-occurrences

This section examines how digital skills cluster together within a country's
job postings, and what broader competences a digital role tends to require. Two
complementary views are provided.

**Digital pairings** takes the most frequently requested digital skills and
measures the strength of association within each pair using normalised pointwise
mutual information (NPMI). NPMI adjusts for the underlying frequency of each
skill, so that a high score reflects genuine co-demand rather than the
prevalence of either skill on its own. Darker cells mark pairings that occur
more often than chance would predict. Each skill is labelled by ICT proficiency
level — Basic, Intermediate, or Advanced — making clusters readily visible, such
as groupings of advanced skills with one another or of basic skills with one
another.

**Digital × skill areas** extends the analysis beyond other digital skills to
the wider requirements of the role. For each broad ESCO area — skill groups
S1–S8, transversal competences T1–T6, and knowledge fields — it reports the
additional likelihood, in percentage points, that a digital posting features
that area relative to an average posting, disaggregated by ICT level. An
accompanying table lists the specific non-digital skills most over-represented
alongside digital roles at each level.

*Methodology.* Co-occurrence is measured at the mention level, using the same
ESCO mapping applied throughout this report. Digital skills are classified by
ICT proficiency level (Basic, Intermediate, Advanced). A posting is considered
to "feature" an area when it contains at least one non-digital skill belonging
to that area; the resulting premium therefore reflects the surrounding role
rather than the digital skills themselves.

digitalCooccurrenceData = FileAttachment("digital_cooccurrence_links.json").json()

//| echo: false

{
  const order = ["Japan", "South Korea", "Singapore", "Taiwan", "Malaysia", "Thailand", "Indonesia", "Vietnam", "Philippines"];
  const LEVELS = ["Basic", "Intermediate", "Advanced"];
  const LEVEL_COLOR = { Basic: "#93c5fd", Intermediate: "#3b82f6", Advanced: "#1d4ed8" };
  const PILLAR_COLOR = { Skills: "#4e79a7", Transversal: "#59a14f", Knowledge: "#e15759", Languages: "#b07aa1" };
  const state = { country: "Japan", view: "pairings", pillar: "all", partnerLevel: "Intermediate" };

  const escapeHtml = s => String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]));
  const truncS = (s, l) => (s.length > l ? s.slice(0, l - 1) + "…" : s);
  const fmtInt = d3.format(",");
  const levelDot = lv => `<span style="display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:${LEVEL_COLOR[lv] || "#94a3b8"};margin-right:5px;"></span>`;

  // ---- shared tooltip (single instance) ----
  d3.select("body").selectAll(".dcooc-tip").remove();
  const tip = d3.select("body").append("div").attr("class", "dcooc-tip")
    .style("position", "fixed").style("pointer-events", "none").style("z-index", 3000)
    .style("display", "none").style("max-width", "330px").style("padding", "8px 10px")
    .style("border-radius", "8px").style("background", "rgba(15,23,42,0.96)").style("color", "#fff")
    .style("font-size", "12px").style("line-height", "1.45").style("box-shadow", "0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.35)");
  function showTip(html, evt) { tip.html(html).style("display", "block"); moveTip(evt); }
  function moveTip(evt) {
    const el = tip.node(), pad = 14, w = el.offsetWidth, h = el.offsetHeight;
    let x = evt.clientX + pad, y = evt.clientY + pad;
    if (x + w > window.innerWidth - 8) x = evt.clientX - w - pad;
    if (y + h > window.innerHeight - 8) y = evt.clientY - h - pad;
    tip.style("left", x + "px").style("top", y + "px");
  }
  function hideTip() { tip.style("display", "none"); }

  // ---- button styling ----
  const pillStyle = active =>
    `padding:5px 12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:${active ? 700 : 600};cursor:pointer;border-radius:999px;`
    + `border:1px solid ${active ? "#0f172a" : "#cbd5e1"};background:${active ? "#0f172a" : "#fff"};`
    + `color:${active ? "#fff" : "#475569"};transition:all .15s`;
  const segStyle = (active, radius, noLeft) =>
    `padding:6px 14px;font-size:12px;font-weight:${active ? 700 : 500};cursor:pointer;`
    + `border:1px solid #cbd5e1;background:${active ? "#0f172a" : "#fff"};color:${active ? "#fff" : "#475569"};`
    + `border-radius:${radius};${noLeft ? "border-left:none;" : ""}transition:all .15s`;

  function labelledGroup(parent, label) {
    const g = parent.append("div").style("display", "flex").style("align-items", "center").style("gap", "0.5rem");
    g.append("span").style("font-size", "11px").style("font-weight", "600").style("color", "#94a3b8")
      .style("text-transform", "uppercase").style("letter-spacing", "0.04em").text(label);
    return g;
  }
  function segmented(parent, options, current, onSelect) {
    const box = parent.append("div").style("display", "flex");
    const btns = [];
    options.forEach(([val, txt], i) => {
      const radius = i === 0 ? "6px 0 0 6px" : (i === options.length - 1 ? "0 6px 6px 0" : "0");
      const b = box.append("button").text(txt).attr("style", segStyle(current() === val, radius, i > 0));
      b.on("click", () => { onSelect(val); btns.forEach(o => o.b.attr("style", segStyle(current() === o.val, o.radius, !o.first))); });
      btns.push({ val, b, radius, first: i === 0 });
    });
    return btns;
  }

  const wrap = d3.create("div").style("font-family", "system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif");

  // ---- top controls ----
  const ctrl = wrap.append("div").style("display", "flex").style("flex-wrap", "wrap")
    .style("gap", "1.2rem").style("align-items", "center").style("margin", "0.2rem 0 0.4rem 0");
  const countryBox = labelledGroup(ctrl, "Country");
  const countryPills = countryBox.append("div").style("display", "flex").style("flex-wrap", "wrap").style("gap", "6px");
  const cBtns = order.filter(c => digitalCooccurrenceData[c]).map(name => {
    const b = countryPills.append("button").text(name).attr("style", pillStyle(state.country === name));
    b.on("click", () => { state.country = name; cBtns.forEach(o => o.b.attr("style", pillStyle(state.country === o.name))); renderView(); });
    return { name, b };
  });
  const viewBox = labelledGroup(ctrl, "View");
  segmented(viewBox, [["pairings", "Digital pairings"], ["areas", "Digital × skill areas"]], () => state.view, v => { state.view = v; renderView(); });
  const exportWrap = ctrl.append("div").style("margin-left", "auto");
  exportWrap.append("button").attr("type", "button").attr("class", "heat-export-btn").text("xlsx").on("click", exportXlsx);

  const summary = wrap.append("div").style("font-size", "0.85rem").style("color", "#475569").style("margin", "0 0 0.6rem 0");
  const subBar = wrap.append("div").style("display", "flex").style("flex-wrap", "wrap").style("gap", "1rem").style("align-items", "center").style("margin", "0 0 0.6rem 0");
  const host = wrap.append("div");

  function current() { return digitalCooccurrenceData[state.country]; }

  function updateSummary() {
    summary.html("");
  }

  function renderView() {
    updateSummary();
    subBar.selectAll("*").remove();
    host.selectAll("*").remove();
    if (state.view === "pairings") renderPairings();
    else renderAreas();
  }

  // ====================== DIGITAL PAIRINGS (NPMI heatmap) =================
  function renderPairings() {
    const data = current();
    const nodes = data.nodes, n = nodes.length;
    if (n < 2) { host.append("div").style("color", "#64748b").text("Not enough digital skills to build a map for this country."); return; }

    const idx = {}; nodes.forEach((nd, i) => idx[nd.code] = i);
    const M = Array.from({ length: n }, () => Array(n).fill(null));
    const C = Array.from({ length: n }, () => Array(n).fill(0));
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) M[i][i] = 1;
    let maxv = 0.0001;
    data.edges.forEach(e => {
      const a = idx[e.a], b = idx[e.b];
      if (a == null || b == null) return;
      M[a][b] = e.npmi; M[b][a] = e.npmi; C[a][b] = e.cooc; C[b][a] = e.cooc;
      if (e.npmi > maxv) maxv = e.npmi;
    });

    const cell = 26, labelW = 270, labelTop = 232;
    const gridBottom = labelTop + n * cell;
    const legendY = gridBottom + 34;
    const W = Math.max(labelW + n * cell + 24, labelW + 240 + LEVELS.length * 96 + 10);
    const H = legendY + 30;
    const color = d3.scaleSequential(d3.interpolateBlues).domain([0, maxv]);
    const scroller = host.append("div").style("overflow", "auto").style("max-height", "680px");
    const svg = scroller.append("svg").attr("width", W).attr("height", H).style("font-family", "system-ui,sans-serif");

    svg.append("g").selectAll("rect").data(d3.range(n)).enter().append("rect")
      .attr("x", 0).attr("y", i => labelTop + i * cell).attr("width", W).attr("height", cell)
      .style("fill", i => i % 2 ? "#f1f5f9" : "transparent").style("opacity", 0.6);

    const cols = svg.append("g").selectAll("g").data(nodes).enter().append("g")
      .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(${labelW + i * cell + cell / 2}, ${labelTop - 8}) rotate(-50)`);
    cols.append("circle").attr("r", 4).attr("fill", d => LEVEL_COLOR[d.level] || "#94a3b8");
    cols.append("text").attr("x", 9).attr("y", 4).style("font-size", "10.5px")
      .attr("class", (d, i) => `dc-col-${i}`).style("fill", "#334155").style("text-anchor", "start").text(d => truncS(d.title, 26));
    const rl = svg.append("g").selectAll("g").data(nodes).enter().append("g")
      .attr("transform", (d, i) => `translate(0, ${labelTop + i * cell + cell / 2})`);
    rl.append("circle").attr("r", 4).attr("cx", labelW - 8).attr("fill", d => LEVEL_COLOR[d.level] || "#94a3b8");
    rl.append("text").attr("x", labelW - 16).attr("y", 4).style("font-size", "10.5px")
      .attr("class", (d, i) => `dc-row-${i}`).style("fill", "#334155").style("text-anchor", "end").text(d => truncS(d.title, 36));

    const hl = (i, j, on) => {
      [`.dc-col-${i}`, `.dc-row-${i}`, `.dc-col-${j}`, `.dc-row-${j}`].forEach(s => {
        const el = svg.select(s); if (!el.empty()) el.style("font-weight", on ? 700 : null);
      });
    };
    const grid = svg.append("g");
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
        const v = M[i][j], isDiag = i === j;
        grid.append("rect")
          .attr("x", labelW + j * cell).attr("y", labelTop + i * cell)
          .attr("width", cell - 2).attr("height", cell - 2).attr("rx", 2)
          .style("fill", isDiag ? "#e2e8f0" : (v && v > 0 ? color(v) : "#f1f5f9"))
          .style("stroke", "#fff").style("stroke-width", 1).style("cursor", "pointer")
          .on("mouseenter", function (evt) {
            hl(i, j, true);
            if (isDiag) {
              showTip(`<div style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:3px;">${levelDot(nodes[i].level)}${escapeHtml(nodes[i].title)}</div>`
                + `<div style="color:#b9c0cc;">${nodes[i].level} · in ${nodes[i].pct}% of postings</div>`, evt);
            } else {
              const txt = (v == null)
                ? '<span style="color:#b9c0cc;">no significant link</span>'
                : `<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;"><span style="color:#b9c0cc;">NPMI</span><span>${v.toFixed(3)}</span></div>`
                  + `<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;"><span style="color:#b9c0cc;">Co-occur in</span><span>${fmtInt(C[i][j])} postings</span></div>`;
              showTip(`<div style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:3px;">${escapeHtml(truncS(nodes[i].title, 34))} <span style="color:#b9c0cc;">×</span> ${escapeHtml(truncS(nodes[j].title, 34))}</div>${txt}`, evt);
            }
          })
          .on("mousemove", moveTip)
          .on("mouseleave", function () { hl(i, j, false); hideTip(); });
      }
    }

    // NPMI legend + level legend
    const defs = svg.append("defs");
    const grad = defs.append("linearGradient").attr("id", "dcNpmiGrad");
    d3.range(0, 1.01, 0.1).forEach(t => grad.append("stop").attr("offset", `${t * 100}%`).attr("stop-color", color(t * maxv)));
    const lg = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${labelW}, ${legendY})`);
    lg.append("text").attr("y", -4).style("font-size", "10px").style("fill", "#64748b").text("Pairing strength (NPMI)");
    lg.append("rect").attr("width", 180).attr("height", 10).attr("rx", 2).style("fill", "url(#dcNpmiGrad)");
    lg.append("text").attr("y", 24).style("font-size", "9px").style("fill", "#94a3b8").text("weaker");
    lg.append("text").attr("x", 180).attr("y", 24).style("font-size", "9px").style("fill", "#94a3b8").style("text-anchor", "end").text(`stronger (${maxv.toFixed(2)})`);
    const ll = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${labelW + 240}, ${legendY + 2})`);
    LEVELS.forEach((lv, i) => {
      const g = ll.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${i * 96}, 0)`);
      g.append("circle").attr("r", 5).attr("cy", -2).attr("fill", LEVEL_COLOR[lv]);
      g.append("text").attr("x", 10).attr("y", 2).style("font-size", "10px").style("fill", "#334155").text(lv);
    });
  }

  // ====================== DIGITAL × SKILL AREAS ===========================
  function renderAreas() {
    // pillar filter
    const pillarBox = labelledGroup(subBar, "Areas");
    segmented(pillarBox,
      [["all", "All"], ["Skills", "Skills (S)"], ["Transversal", "Transversal (T)"], ["Knowledge", "Knowledge"]],
      () => state.pillar, v => { state.pillar = v; drawAreaChart(); });

    const chartHost = host.append("div").style("overflow", "auto").style("max-height", "600px");
    drawAreaChart();

    function drawAreaChart() {
      chartHost.selectAll("*").remove();
      const data = current();
      let groups = data.groups.slice();
      if (state.pillar !== "all") groups = groups.filter(g => g.pillar === state.pillar);
      groups.sort((a, b) => (b.by_level.Advanced?.premium ?? b.by_level.All?.premium ?? 0) - (a.by_level.Advanced?.premium ?? a.by_level.All?.premium ?? 0));
      if (!groups.length) { chartHost.append("div").style("color", "#64748b").text("No areas in this group."); return; }

      const barH = 12, barGap = 2, labelW = 268, padL = labelW + 14, padR = 56, padT = 42, rowPad = 12;
      const rowH = LEVELS.length * barH + (LEVELS.length - 1) * barGap + rowPad;
      const W = 880, innerW = W - padL - padR, H = padT + groups.length * rowH + 16;

      let lo = 0, hi = 0;
      groups.forEach(g => LEVELS.forEach(l => { const v = g.by_level[l]?.premium; if (v == null) return; lo = Math.min(lo, v); hi = Math.max(hi, v); }));
      const span = Math.max(hi - lo, 1); lo -= span * 0.02; hi += span * 0.06;
      const x = d3.scaleLinear().domain([lo, hi]).range([padL, padL + innerW]).nice();
      const svg = chartHost.append("svg").attr("viewBox", [0, 0, W, H]).attr("width", W).attr("height", H)
        .style("max-width", "100%").style("height", "auto").style("font-family", "system-ui,sans-serif");

      const ticks = x.ticks(7);
      svg.append("g").selectAll("line").data(ticks).enter().append("line")
        .attr("x1", d => x(d)).attr("x2", d => x(d)).attr("y1", padT - 8).attr("y2", H - 8)
        .style("stroke", d => d === 0 ? "#94a3b8" : "#e2e8f0").style("stroke-width", d => d === 0 ? 1.5 : 1)
        .style("stroke-dasharray", d => d === 0 ? "none" : "2,3").style("opacity", 0.8);
      svg.append("g").selectAll("text").data(ticks).enter().append("text")
        .attr("x", d => x(d)).attr("y", padT - 12).style("font-size", "10px").style("fill", "#64748b").style("text-anchor", "middle")
        .text(d => (d > 0 ? "+" : "") + d + "pp");

      const lg = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(0, ${padT - 20})`);
      LEVELS.forEach((l, i) => {
        lg.append("rect").attr("x", i * 92).attr("y", -10).attr("width", 11).attr("height", 11).attr("rx", 2).style("fill", LEVEL_COLOR[l]);
        lg.append("text").attr("x", i * 92 + 16).attr("y", 0).style("font-size", "10px").style("fill", "#334155").text(l);
      });

      const rows = svg.append("g").selectAll("g.dc-arearow").data(groups).enter().append("g").attr("class", "dc-arearow");
      rows.each(function (g, gi) {
        const row = d3.select(this), y0 = padT + gi * rowH;
        row.append("rect").attr("x", 0).attr("y", y0 - rowPad / 2).attr("width", W).attr("height", rowH).style("fill", "transparent");
        const codeW = 42, labelRight = labelW - codeW;
        const blockCenterY = y0 + (LEVELS.length * barH + (LEVELS.length - 1) * barGap) / 2;
        const words = String(g.glabel).split(" "); const lines = []; let cur = "";
        words.forEach(w => { if ((cur + " " + w).trim().length > 28) { lines.push(cur.trim()); cur = w; } else { cur = (cur + " " + w).trim(); } });
        if (cur) lines.push(cur);
        const disp = lines.slice(0, 2);
        if (lines.length > 2) disp[1] = truncS(disp[1] + " " + lines.slice(2).join(" "), 26);
        const lt = row.append("text").attr("x", labelRight).attr("y", blockCenterY - (disp.length - 1) * 6 + 3)
          .style("font-size", "11px").style("fill", "#334155").style("text-anchor", "end");
        disp.forEach((ln, k) => lt.append("tspan").attr("x", labelRight).attr("dy", k === 0 ? 0 : 12).text(ln));
        row.append("text").attr("x", labelW).attr("y", blockCenterY + 3).style("font-size", "10px").style("font-weight", "600")
          .style("fill", "#94a3b8").style("text-anchor", "end").text(g.ghead);

        LEVELS.forEach((l, li) => {
          const d = g.by_level[l]; const v = d?.premium ?? 0;
          const yy = y0 + li * (barH + barGap);
          const x0 = Math.min(x(0), x(v)), bw = Math.max(1, Math.abs(x(v) - x(0)));
          row.append("rect").attr("x", x0).attr("y", yy).attr("width", bw).attr("height", barH).attr("rx", 2)
            .style("fill", LEVEL_COLOR[l]).style("cursor", "pointer")
            .on("mouseenter", function (evt) {
              showTip(`<div style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:3px;">${escapeHtml(g.glabel)} <span style="color:#b9c0cc;">(${g.ghead})</span></div>`
                + `<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;"><span style="color:#b9c0cc;">${levelDot(l)}${l} digital</span><span>${v > 0 ? "+" : ""}${v} pp</span></div>`
                + `<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;"><span style="color:#b9c0cc;">In these postings</span><span>${d?.dig}%</span></div>`
                + `<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;"><span style="color:#b9c0cc;">Baseline (all)</span><span>${d?.base}%</span></div>`, evt);
            }).on("mousemove", moveTip).on("mouseleave", hideTip);
          const wide = bw > 26;
          row.append("text").attr("x", v >= 0 ? (wide ? x(v) - 3 : x(v) + 3) : (wide ? x(v) + 3 : x(v) - 3))
            .attr("y", yy + barH - 2).style("font-size", "9px").style("pointer-events", "none")
            .style("fill", wide ? "#fff" : "#64748b").style("text-anchor", v >= 0 ? (wide ? "end" : "start") : (wide ? "start" : "end"))
            .text((v > 0 ? "+" : "") + v.toFixed(1));
        });
      });
    }

    // ---- top partner skills ----
    host.append("hr").style("margin", "1rem 0 0.6rem 0").style("border", "none").style("border-top", "1px solid #e2e8f0");
    const pHead = host.append("div").style("display", "flex").style("justify-content", "space-between")
      .style("align-items", "center").style("flex-wrap", "wrap").style("gap", "0.6rem").style("margin-bottom", "0.4rem");
    pHead.append("h5").style("margin", "0").style("font-size", "1rem").text("Top co-occurring skills by ICT level");
    const plBox = pHead.append("div");
    segmented(plBox, [["Basic", "Basic"], ["Intermediate", "Intermediate"], ["Advanced", "Advanced"]], () => state.partnerLevel, v => { state.partnerLevel = v; drawPartners(); });
    host.append("p").style("font-size", "0.82rem").style("color", "#64748b").style("margin", "0 0 0.5rem 0")
      .html("Specific non-digital skills most over-represented in postings that mention a digital skill of the chosen level. <em>Lift</em> = how many times more likely than an average posting; <em>premium</em> = extra share in pp.");
    const tableHost = host.append("div").style("overflow", "auto").style("max-height", "460px");
    drawPartners();

    function drawPartners() {
      tableHost.selectAll("*").remove();
      const rows = current().partners.filter(p => p.level === state.partnerLevel).sort((a, b) => b.premium_pp - a.premium_pp);
      if (!rows.length) { tableHost.append("div").style("color", "#64748b").text("No partners for this level."); return; }
      const tbl = tableHost.append("table").style("width", "100%").style("border-collapse", "collapse").style("font-size", "0.9rem");
      const th = tbl.append("thead").append("tr").style("border-bottom", "2px solid #cbd5e1");
      const cols = [["#", "left", "44px"], ["Skill", "left", ""], ["Area", "left", ""], ["Premium", "right", ""], ["Lift", "right", ""], ["In digital postings", "right", ""]];
      cols.forEach(([t, al, w]) => { const h = th.append("th").style("padding", "6px 8px").style("text-align", al).style("color", "#475569").text(t); if (w) h.style("width", w); });
      const tb = tbl.append("tbody");
      rows.forEach((p, i) => {
        const tr = tb.append("tr").style("border-bottom", "1px solid #e2e8f0");
        tr.append("td").style("padding", "5px 8px").style("color", "#94a3b8").text(i + 1);
        tr.append("td").style("padding", "5px 8px").text(p.title);
        tr.append("td").style("padding", "5px 8px").html(`<span title="${escapeHtml(p.glabel)}" style="display:inline-block;max-width:220px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;vertical-align:middle;background:${PILLAR_COLOR[p.pillar] || "#888"};color:#fff;padding:2px 9px;border-radius:999px;font-size:0.75rem;line-height:1.4;">${escapeHtml(truncS(p.glabel, 28))}</span>`);
        tr.append("td").style("padding", "5px 8px").style("text-align", "right").style("font-weight", "600").text(`+${p.premium_pp.toFixed(1)}pp`);
        tr.append("td").style("padding", "5px 8px").style("text-align", "right").text(`${p.lift.toFixed(1)}×`);
        tr.append("td").style("padding", "5px 8px").style("text-align", "right").text(`${p.dig_pct.toFixed(1)}%`);
      });
    }
  }

  // ---- XLSX export (whole country, all sheets) ----
  async function ensureXlsx() {
    if (window.XLSX) return window.XLSX;
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const s = document.createElement("script");
      s.src = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/xlsx@0.18.5/dist/xlsx.full.min.js";
      s.async = true; s.onload = resolve; s.onerror = reject; document.head.appendChild(s);
    });
    return window.XLSX;
  }
  async function exportXlsx() {
    try {
      const XLSX = await ensureXlsx();
      const data = current();
      const titleByCode = {}; data.nodes.forEach(nd => titleByCode[nd.code] = nd.title);
      const pairRows = data.edges.map(e => ({ "Skill A": titleByCode[e.a] || e.a, "Skill B": titleByCode[e.b] || e.b, NPMI: e.npmi, "Co-occurring postings": e.cooc }));
      const nodeRows = data.nodes.map((nd, i) => ({ Order: i + 1, Skill: nd.title, "ICT level": nd.level, Code: nd.code, "% of postings": nd.pct }));
      const areaRows = [];
      data.groups.forEach(g => ["All", "Basic", "Intermediate", "Advanced"].forEach(l => {
        const d = g.by_level[l]; if (!d) return;
        areaRows.push({ Area: g.glabel, "ESCO group": g.ghead, Pillar: g.pillar, Level: l, "Premium (pp)": d.premium, "Digital share %": d.dig, "Baseline share %": d.base, "Level offers": d.level_offers });
      }));
      const partnerRows = data.partners.map(p => ({ Level: p.level, Skill: p.title, Code: p.code, Area: p.glabel, Pillar: p.pillar, "Premium (pp)": p.premium_pp, Lift: p.lift, "In digital postings %": p.dig_pct, "Baseline %": p.base_pct, "Co-occurring postings": p.support }));
      const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
      XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(pairRows), "Digital pairings (NPMI)");
      XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(nodeRows), "Digital skills");
      XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(areaRows), "Area premium by level");
      XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(partnerRows), "Top partner skills");
      XLSX.writeFile(wb, `digital_cooccurrence_${state.country.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, "_")}.xlsx`);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      alert("Could not load the XLSX exporter. Please check your internet connection and try again.");
    }
  }

  renderView();
  return wrap.node();
}
```

### Engineers and technicians demand

We use the ESCO occupation assigned to each posting title by JobBERT to identify
vacancies for engineers and technicians. The chart can be switched between raw
counts, postings per 100,000 labour force, and the share of all offers. Dashed
reference lines show the average across East Asian markets and benchmark markets;
click any country to inspect which specific ESCO occupations make up the selected
category.

{
  const groups = { engineers: "Engineers", technicians: "Technicians" };
  const metrics = {
    n: { label: "Number of offers", short: "n", fmt: d3.format(","), value: r => r.offers },
    per100k: { label: "Offers per 100k labour force", short: "n / 100k LF", fmt: d3.format(".1f"), value: r => r.per100k },
    pct: { label: "% of all offers", short: "% offers", fmt: v => `${v.toFixed(2)}%`, value: r => r.pct_offers },
  };
  const state = { group: "engineers", metric: "pct" };

  const rowsFor = group => Object.entries(engineerTechData.countries).map(([country, d]) => {
    const g = d[group];
    const lf = (laborForceByIso3[d.iso3] || {}).value || null;
    return {
      country, iso3: d.iso3, region: d.group,
      total_offers: d.total_offers,
      offers: g.offers,
      pct_offers: g.pct_offers,
      per100k: lf ? 100000 * g.offers / lf : null,
      labor_force: lf,
      occupations: g.occupations || []
    };
  });

  const wrap = d3.create("div").style("font-family", "system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif");
  const controls = wrap.append("div").attr("class", "heat-panel-tools").style("margin-bottom", "0.9rem");
  const selectBox = (label, options, value, onChange) => {
    const box = controls.append("label").style("display", "inline-flex").style("align-items", "center").style("gap", "0.35rem").style("font-size", "0.84rem").style("font-weight", "700").style("color", "#334155");
    box.append("span").text(label);
    const sel = box.append("select").style("border", "1px solid #cbd5e1").style("border-radius", "8px").style("padding", "0.35rem 0.55rem").style("font-weight", "700").style("background", "#fff");
    options.forEach(([v, t]) => sel.append("option").attr("value", v).text(t));
    sel.property("value", value).on("change", ev => onChange(ev.target.value));
    return sel;
  };
  selectBox("Occupation group", Object.entries(groups), state.group, v => { state.group = v; render(); });
  selectBox("Metric", Object.entries(metrics).map(([k, v]) => [k, v.label]), state.metric, v => { state.metric = v; render(); });

  const note = wrap.append("div").attr("class", "compare-note").style("margin-bottom", "0.7rem");
  const chart = wrap.append("div");

  const modal = d3.select("body").append("div")
    .style("position", "fixed").style("inset", "0").style("background", "rgba(15,23,42,.45)")
    .style("display", "none").style("align-items", "center").style("justify-content", "center")
    .style("z-index", "2000").style("padding", "1rem");
  modal.on("click", function (e) { if (e.target === this) modal.style("display", "none"); });
  const card = modal.append("div")
    .style("background", "#fff").style("border-radius", "12px").style("max-width", "560px")
    .style("width", "100%").style("max-height", "85vh").style("overflow", "auto")
    .style("padding", "1.2rem 1.4rem").style("position", "relative")
    .style("box-shadow", "0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.3)").style("font-family", "system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif");
  card.append("button").html("&times;")
    .style("position", "absolute").style("top", "0.6rem").style("right", "0.8rem")
    .style("border", "none").style("background", "none").style("font-size", "1.6rem")
    .style("line-height", "1").style("cursor", "pointer").style("color", "#94a3b8")
    .on("click", () => modal.style("display", "none"));
  const modalTitle = card.append("h3").style("margin", "0 0 0.35rem 0").style("padding-right", "1.5rem");
  const modalSub = card.append("div").style("font-size", "0.86rem").style("color", "#64748b").style("margin-bottom", "0.8rem");
  const modalList = card.append("div");

  const groupAvg = (rows, region, metric) => {
    const vals = rows.filter(r => r.region === region).map(r => metrics[metric].value(r)).filter(v => v != null && Number.isFinite(v));
    return vals.length ? d3.mean(vals) : null;
  };

  function openModal(row) {
    modalTitle.text(`${row.country} — ${groups[state.group]}`);
    modalSub.text(`${d3.format(",")(row.offers)} postings · ${row.pct_offers.toFixed(2)}% of all offers` + (row.per100k == null ? "" : ` · ${row.per100k.toFixed(1)} per 100k labour force`));
    modalList.selectAll("*").remove();
    if (!row.occupations.length) {
      modalList.append("div").style("color", "#94a3b8").text("No matched occupations in this group.");
    } else {
      row.occupations.forEach((o, i) => {
        const item = modalList.append("div").style("display", "grid").style("grid-template-columns", "2rem 1fr auto").style("gap", "0.55rem").style("align-items", "baseline").style("padding", "0.38rem 0").style("border-bottom", "1px solid #eef2f7");
        item.append("div").style("font-size", "0.78rem").style("color", "#94a3b8").text(i + 1);
        const mid = item.append("div");
        mid.append("div").style("font-weight", "750").style("color", "#334155").text(o.title);
        mid.append("div").style("font-size", "0.74rem").style("color", "#94a3b8").text(o.code);
        item.append("div").style("text-align", "right").html(`<b>${o.pct_of_group.toFixed(1)}%</b><br><span style="color:#94a3b8;font-size:0.75rem">${d3.format(",")(o.offers)} offers</span>`);
      });
    }
    modal.style("display", "flex");
  }

  function render() {
    const metric = metrics[state.metric];
    const allRows = rowsFor(state.group);
    const ea = allRows.filter(r => r.region === "East Asia").sort((a, b) => d3.descending(metric.value(a) ?? -Infinity, metric.value(b) ?? -Infinity));
    const bench = allRows.filter(r => r.region === "Benchmark").sort((a, b) => d3.descending(metric.value(a) ?? -Infinity, metric.value(b) ?? -Infinity));
    const rows = [...ea, ...bench];
    const eaAvg = groupAvg(allRows, "East Asia", state.metric);
    const benchAvg = groupAvg(allRows, "Benchmark", state.metric);
    note.html(`<b>${groups[state.group]}</b>, ${metric.label.toLowerCase()}. Dashed lines show simple cross-country averages: East Asia ${eaAvg == null ? "n/a" : metric.fmt(eaAvg)}; Benchmark ${benchAvg == null ? "n/a" : metric.fmt(benchAvg)}.`);

    chart.selectAll("*").remove();
    const W = 900, rowH = 30, gap = 24;
    const margin = { top: 34, right: 140, bottom: 34, left: 138 };
    const benchStart = ea.length;
    const H = margin.top + rows.length * rowH + gap + margin.bottom;
    const xMax = d3.max(rows.map(r => metric.value(r)).concat([eaAvg || 0, benchAvg || 0])) || 1;
    const x = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0, xMax * 1.12]).nice().range([margin.left, W - margin.right]);
    const y = i => margin.top + i * rowH + (i >= benchStart ? gap : 0);
    const svg = chart.append("svg").attr("viewBox", [0, 0, W, H]).style("width", "100%").style("max-width", `${W}px`).style("height", "auto");

    x.ticks(5).forEach(t => {
      svg.append("line").attr("x1", x(t)).attr("x2", x(t)).attr("y1", margin.top - 18).attr("y2", H - margin.bottom + 5).attr("stroke", "#eef2f7");
      svg.append("text").attr("x", x(t)).attr("y", H - margin.bottom + 22).attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", 10).attr("fill", "#94a3b8").text(metric.fmt(t));
    });

    const avgLine = (v, label, color, dy) => {
      if (v == null) return;
      svg.append("line").attr("x1", x(v)).attr("x2", x(v)).attr("y1", margin.top - 24).attr("y2", H - margin.bottom).attr("stroke", color).attr("stroke-dasharray", "5 4").attr("stroke-width", 1.6);
      svg.append("text").attr("x", x(v) + 4).attr("y", margin.top - 22 + dy).attr("font-size", 10).attr("font-weight", 800).attr("fill", color).text(label);
    };
    avgLine(eaAvg, "EA avg", "#2563eb", 0);
    avgLine(benchAvg, "Benchmark avg", "#7c3aed", 12);

    [["EAST ASIA", 0, "#2563eb"], ["BENCHMARK", benchStart, "#7c3aed"]].forEach(([lab, idx, color]) => {
      if (idx >= rows.length) return;
      svg.append("text").attr("x", margin.left - 10).attr("y", y(idx) - 8).attr("text-anchor", "end").attr("font-size", 10.5).attr("font-weight", 900).attr("letter-spacing", "0.06em").attr("fill", color).text(lab);
    });

    rows.forEach((r, i) => {
      const v = metric.value(r) || 0;
      const yy = y(i);
      const color = r.region === "East Asia" ? "#2563eb" : "#7c3aed";
      svg.append("text").attr("x", margin.left - 10).attr("y", yy + 18).attr("text-anchor", "end").attr("font-size", 12).attr("font-weight", 750).attr("fill", "#334155").text(r.country);
      const g = svg.append("g").style("cursor", "pointer").on("click", () => openModal(r));
      g.append("rect").attr("x", margin.left).attr("y", yy + 6).attr("width", Math.max(1, x(v) - margin.left)).attr("height", 17).attr("rx", 4).attr("fill", color).attr("opacity", 0.82);
      g.append("title").text(`${r.country}
${groups[state.group]}: ${d3.format(",")(r.offers)} offers
${r.pct_offers.toFixed(2)}% of all offers`);
      svg.append("text").attr("x", x(v) + 6).attr("y", yy + 19).attr("font-size", 11).attr("font-weight", 800).attr("fill", "#475569").text(metric.fmt(v));
    });
  }

  render();
  return wrap.node();
}
```

::::

### Case study: semiconductors

Semiconductors are the strategic backbone of East Asia's technology economy, which
makes them a useful worked example of how the ESCO skill layer can isolate the
demand signal for a single industry. We first identified every ESCO concept that
explicitly refers to semiconductors or microelectronics — chip and
integrated-circuit design, wafer fabrication and processing, micro-electro-mechanical
systems (MEMS), and semiconductor inspection and testing — and then flagged any job
posting that mentions at least one of them (ESCO match score ≥ 0.50, de-duplicated
by posting). The toggle below switches between the raw number of semiconductor
postings, postings normalised per 100,000 people in the labour force, and the share
of all postings in each market.

::: {.section-card}

//| echo: false

{
  const data = semiData.countries;
  const codes = Object.keys(data);
  const groups = ["East Asia", "Benchmark"];
  const state = { metric: "pct" };
  const fmtInt = d3.format(",");
  const metricLabel = {
    count: "Semiconductor postings",
    per100k: "Postings per 100k labour force",
    pct: "Share of all postings",
  };
  const lfOf = c => (laborForceByIso3[data[c].iso3] || {}).value || null;
  const value = c => {
    const d = data[c];
    if (state.metric === "count") return d.semi_offers;
    if (state.metric === "per100k") { const lf = lfOf(c); return lf ? (d.semi_offers / lf) * 1e5 : null; }
    return d.pct;
  };
  const valueText = c => {
    const v = value(c);
    if (v == null) return "n/a";
    if (state.metric === "count") return fmtInt(v);
    if (state.metric === "per100k") return v.toFixed(1);
    return v.toFixed(2) + "%";
  };
  const gColor = c => data[c].group === "Benchmark" ? "#f59e0b" : "#2563eb";

  const wrap = d3.create("div").style("font-family", "system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif");

  // ---- metric toggle ----
  const bar = wrap.append("div").style("display", "flex").style("flex-wrap", "wrap").style("gap", "1.2rem").style("margin", "0.2rem 0 1rem 0").style("align-items", "center");
  const btnStyle = active =>
    `padding:6px 16px;font-size:12px;font-weight:${active ? 700 : 500};cursor:pointer;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;`
    + `background:${active ? "#0f172a" : "#fff"};color:${active ? "#fff" : "#475569"};transition:all .15s`;
  const opts = [["pct", "% of postings"], ["per100k", "per 100k LF"], ["count", "count"]];
  const g = bar.append("div").style("display", "flex").style("align-items", "center").style("gap", "0.5rem");
  g.append("span").style("font-size", "11px").style("font-weight", "600").style("color", "#94a3b8").style("text-transform", "uppercase").style("letter-spacing", "0.04em").text("Metric");
  const box = g.append("div").style("display", "flex");
  const btns = opts.map(([val, txt], i) => {
    const radius = i === 0 ? "6px 0 0 6px" : (i === opts.length - 1 ? "0 6px 6px 0" : "0");
    const b = box.append("button").attr("style", btnStyle(state.metric === val) + `;border-radius:${radius}` + (i > 0 ? ";border-left:none" : "")).text(txt);
    b.on("click", () => { state.metric = val; refreshBtns(); render(); });
    return { val, b, radius, first: i === 0 };
  });
  const refreshBtns = () => btns.forEach(o => o.b.attr("style", btnStyle(state.metric === o.val) + `;border-radius:${o.radius}` + (o.first ? "" : ";border-left:none")));

  // ---- chart ----
  const chart = wrap.append("div");
  const rowH = 28, labelW = 110, valW = 64;
  function render() {
    chart.selectAll("*").remove();
    const maxv = d3.max(codes.filter(c => value(c) != null), c => value(c)) || 1;
    const x = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0, maxv]).range([0, 100]);
    groups.forEach((grp, gi) => {
      const members = codes.filter(c => data[c].group === grp).sort((a, b) => (value(b) ?? -1) - (value(a) ?? -1));
      if (!members.length) return;
      chart.append("div")
        .style("font-size", "0.72rem").style("font-weight", "700").style("letter-spacing", "0.05em")
        .style("text-transform", "uppercase").style("color", "#94a3b8")
        .style("margin", gi === 0 ? "0 0 0.4rem 0" : "1rem 0 0.4rem 0")
        .text(grp);
      members.forEach(c => {
        const r = chart.append("div").style("display", "flex").style("align-items", "center").style("height", `${rowH}px`).style("gap", "0.5rem");
        r.append("div").style("width", `${labelW}px`).style("flex", "none").style("font-size", "0.84rem").style("text-align", "right").style("color", "#334155").text(c);
        const track = r.append("div").style("flex", "1").style("background", "#f1f5f9").style("border-radius", "4px").style("height", "15px");
        const v = value(c);
        track.append("div").style("height", "100%").style("border-radius", "4px").style("background", gColor(c)).style("width", `${v == null ? 0 : x(v)}%`);
        r.append("div").style("width", `${valW}px`).style("flex", "none").style("font-size", "0.84rem").style("font-weight", "700").style("color", "#0f172a").text(valueText(c));
      });
    });
    chart.append("div").style("font-size", "0.78rem").style("color", "#64748b").style("margin-top", "0.7rem")
      .text(`${metricLabel[state.metric]} · ${semiData.n_skills} ESCO semiconductor concepts · match score ≥ ${semiData.threshold}`);
  }

  refreshBtns();
  render();

  // ---- collapsible list of the ESCO concepts ----
  const det = wrap.append("details").style("margin-top", "1rem").style("font-size", "0.84rem").style("color", "#334155");
  det.append("summary").style("cursor", "pointer").style("font-weight", "600").style("color", "#2563eb").text(`The ${semiData.n_skills} ESCO concepts counted as "semiconductor"`);
  const lvlColor = { "Dig./Advanced ICT": "#1d4ed8", "Dig./Intermediate ICT": "#0d9488", "Non Digital": "#94a3b8" };
  const grid = det.append("div").style("display", "grid").style("grid-template-columns", "repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr))").style("gap", "0.3rem 1rem").style("margin-top", "0.6rem");
  semiData.skills.forEach(s => {
    const it = grid.append("div").style("display", "flex").style("align-items", "center").style("gap", "0.4rem").style("padding", "0.15rem 0");
    it.append("span").style("width", "9px").style("height", "9px").style("flex", "none").style("border-radius", "50%").style("background", lvlColor[s.level] || "#cbd5e1").attr("title", s.level);
    it.append("span").text(s.label);
  });

  return wrap.node();
}

:::

##### Is semiconductor demand rising over time?

To test whether semiconductor demand is trending, we track the monthly share of
postings that mention a semiconductor concept — semiconductor postings per 10,000
postings. The series runs from March 2025 to April 2026.

::: {.section-card}

{
  const months = semiData.months;
  const state = { series: "Taiwan" };
  const seriesList = [["Taiwan", "Taiwan"], ["Japan", "Japan"], ["South Korea", "South Korea"], ["Singapore", "Singapore"], ["Malaysia", "Malaysia"], ["Thailand", "Thailand"], ["Indonesia", "Indonesia"], ["Vietnam", "Vietnam"], ["Philippines", "Philippines"]];

  const erfc = x => {
    const z = Math.abs(x), t = 1 / (1 + 0.5 * z);
    const r = t * Math.exp(-z * z - 1.26551223 + t * (1.00002368 + t * (0.37409196 + t * (0.09678418 + t * (-0.18628806 + t * (0.27886807 + t * (-1.13520398 + t * (1.48851587 + t * (-0.82215223 + t * 0.17087277)))))))));
    return x >= 0 ? r : 2 - r;
  };
  const mannKendall = xs => {
    const n = xs.length;
    if (n < 4) return null;
    let s = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < n; j++) s += Math.sign(xs[j] - xs[i]);
    const v = n * (n - 1) * (2 * n + 5) / 18;
    const z = s > 0 ? (s - 1) / Math.sqrt(v) : (s < 0 ? (s + 1) / Math.sqrt(v) : 0);
    return { tau: s / (0.5 * n * (n - 1)), z, p: erfc(Math.abs(z) / Math.SQRT2) };
  };
  const ols = ys => {
    const n = ys.length, xs = d3.range(n);
    const mx = d3.mean(xs), my = d3.mean(ys);
    const sxx = d3.sum(xs, x => (x - mx) ** 2);
    const sxy = d3.sum(xs.map((x, i) => (x - mx) * (ys[i] - my)));
    const slope = sxx ? sxy / sxx : 0;
    return { slope, intercept: my - slope * mx };
  };

  const MIN_POSTINGS = 500;
  const countsFor = name => {
    const m = semiData.byCountryMonth[name];
    return { total: months.map(x => m[x].total), signal: months.map(x => m[x].semi) };
  };
  const seriesShare = name => {
    const { total, signal } = countsFor(name);
    return months.map((_, i) => total[i] >= MIN_POSTINGS ? 10000 * signal[i] / total[i] : null);
  };

  const wrap = d3.create("div").style("font-family", "system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif");
  const bar = wrap.append("div").style("display", "grid").style("grid-template-columns", "auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto").style("align-items", "start").style("gap", "0.45rem 0.75rem").style("margin", "0.1rem 0 1.25rem 0");
  bar.append("span").style("font-size", "11px").style("font-weight", "600").style("color", "#94a3b8").style("text-transform", "uppercase").style("letter-spacing", "0.04em").style("padding-top", "7px").text("Market");
  const btnStyle = active => `padding:5px 12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:${active ? 700 : 500};cursor:pointer;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;background:${active ? "#0f172a" : "#fff"};color:${active ? "#fff" : "#475569"}`;
  const box = bar.append("div").style("display", "flex").style("flex-wrap", "wrap").style("gap", "0.35rem");
  const btns = seriesList.map(([val, txt], i) => {
    const b = box.append("button").attr("style", btnStyle(state.series === val) + ";border-radius:6px").text(txt);
    b.on("click", () => { state.series = val; btns.forEach(o => o.b.attr("style", btnStyle(state.series === o.val) + ";border-radius:6px")); render(); });
    return { val, b };
  });
  // xlsx export of the plotted series (reliable months only; February omitted).
  async function ensureXlsx() {
    if (window.XLSX) return window.XLSX;
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const s = document.createElement("script");
      s.src = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/xlsx@0.18.5/dist/xlsx.full.min.js";
      s.async = true; s.onload = resolve; s.onerror = reject;
      document.head.appendChild(s);
    });
    return window.XLSX;
  }
  async function exportXlsx() {
    try {
      const XLSX = await ensureXlsx();
      const unreliable = new Set(semiData.unreliable_months || []);
      const { total, signal } = countsFor(state.series);
      const rows = [];
      months.forEach((mn, i) => {
        if (unreliable.has(mn) || total[i] < MIN_POSTINGS) return;
        rows.push({
          Month: mn,
          "Postings": total[i],
          "Semiconductor postings": signal[i],
          "Per 10,000 postings": total[i] ? +(10000 * signal[i] / total[i]).toFixed(2) : 0
        });
      });
      const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
      XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(rows), "Semiconductor trend");
      XLSX.writeFile(wb, `semiconductor_trend_${state.series.replace(/\s+/g, "_")}.xlsx`);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      alert("Could not load the XLSX exporter. Please check your internet connection and try again.");
    }
  }
  bar.append("button").attr("type", "button")
    .attr("style", "padding:5px 12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;color:#475569;white-space:nowrap")
    .text("xlsx").on("click", exportXlsx);
  const plot = wrap.append("div");
  wrap.style("position", "relative");
  const tip = wrap.append("div").attr("class", "cs-tooltip");
  const fmtMonth = ym => { const [yy, mm] = ym.split("-"); return ["Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"][+mm - 1] + " " + yy; };

  function render() {
    plot.selectAll("*").remove();
    const { total, signal } = countsFor(state.series);
    const unreliable = new Set(semiData.unreliable_months || []);
    // Reliable months need MIN_POSTINGS. Unreliable months (e.g. February) are
    // dropped from the plot; only the x-axis tick keeps an asterisk and the
    // dashed bridge spans the gap.
    const allPts = months.map((mn, i) => {
      const t = total[i], s = signal[i];
      if (unreliable.has(mn) || t < MIN_POSTINGS) return null;
      return { i, mn, v: 10000 * s / t, reliable: true, total: t };
    }).filter(d => d != null);
    const relPts = allPts.filter(d => d.reliable);
    const ys = relPts.map(d => d.v);            // trend stats use reliable months only
    const W = 720, H = 316, m = { t: 30, r: 16, b: 44, l: 46 };
    const iw = W - m.l - m.r, ih = H - m.t - m.b;
    const svg = plot.append("svg").attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${W} ${H}`).style("width", "100%").style("max-width", `${W}px`).style("height", "auto").style("font-family", "system-ui,sans-serif");
    const gph = svg.append("g").attr("transform", `translate(${m.l},${m.t})`);
    const x = d3.scalePoint().domain(d3.range(months.length)).range([0, iw]).padding(0.5);
    const ymax = (d3.max(ys) || 1) * 1.15;
    const y = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0, ymax]).range([ih, 0]).nice();
    y.ticks(5).forEach(t => {
      gph.append("line").attr("x1", 0).attr("x2", iw).attr("y1", y(t)).attr("y2", y(t)).attr("stroke", "#eef2f7");
      gph.append("text").attr("x", -8).attr("y", y(t)).attr("dy", "0.32em").attr("text-anchor", "end").attr("font-size", "10px").attr("fill", "#94a3b8").text(t);
    });
    months.forEach((mn, i) => {
      const isUn = unreliable.has(mn);
      gph.append("text").attr("x", x(i)).attr("y", ih + 22).attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", "9.5px").attr("fill", isUn ? "#b45309" : "#94a3b8").text(mn.slice(2));
    });
    gph.append("text").attr("x", 0).attr("y", -16).attr("font-size", "10px").attr("fill", "#64748b").text("per 10k postings");

    let fit = null;
    if (ys.length >= 2) {
      fit = ols(ys);
      gph.append("line").attr("x1", x(relPts[0].i)).attr("y1", y(fit.intercept)).attr("x2", x(relPts[relPts.length - 1].i)).attr("y2", y(fit.intercept + fit.slope * (ys.length - 1)))
        .attr("stroke", "#1d4ed8").attr("stroke-width", 1.6).attr("stroke-dasharray", "5 4").attr("opacity", 0.7);
    }
    // Data line: solid between adjacent reliable months; dashed bridge across any
    // gap (e.g. the unreliable February) to flag the discontinuity in coverage.
    const seg = d3.line().x(d => x(d.i)).y(d => y(d.v));
    for (let k = 1; k < relPts.length; k++) {
      const a = relPts[k - 1], b = relPts[k];
      const gap = b.i - a.i > 1;
      gph.append("path").datum([a, b]).attr("fill", "none").attr("stroke", "#2563eb")
        .attr("stroke-width", gap ? 1.8 : 2.2).attr("stroke-dasharray", gap ? "4 4" : null)
        .attr("opacity", gap ? 0.5 : 1).attr("d", seg);
    }
    gph.selectAll("circle.org").data(relPts).join("circle").attr("class", "org").attr("cx", d => x(d.i)).attr("cy", d => y(d.v)).attr("r", 3.4).attr("fill", "#2563eb").style("cursor", "pointer")
      .on("mouseenter", function (event, d) {
        d3.select(this).interrupt().transition().duration(90).attr("r", 6).attr("stroke", "#fff").attr("stroke-width", 2);
        tip.style("opacity", 1).html(
          `<div class="cs-tip-h">${fmtMonth(d.mn)}</div>`
          + `<div class="cs-tip-v">${d.v.toFixed(1)}<span>per 10k postings</span></div>`
          + `<div class="cs-tip-s">${d3.format(",")(signal[d.i])} semiconductor postings of ${d3.format(",")(d.total)}</div>`);
      })
      .on("mousemove", function (event) {
        const [mx, my] = d3.pointer(event, wrap.node());
        tip.style("left", (mx + 16) + "px").style("top", (my + 12) + "px");
      })
      .on("mouseleave", function () {
        d3.select(this).interrupt().transition().duration(130).attr("r", 3.4).attr("stroke", null);
        tip.style("opacity", 0);
      });

    const mk = mannKendall(ys);
    const meanShare = d3.mean(ys);
    const q = Math.max(1, Math.round(ys.length / 4));
    const firstAvg = d3.mean(ys.slice(0, q)), lastAvg = d3.mean(ys.slice(-q));
    const pctChange = firstAvg ? (100 * (lastAvg - firstAvg) / firstAvg) : null;
    const dir = !mk ? "" : (mk.tau > 0.05 ? "upward" : (mk.tau < -0.05 ? "downward" : "flat"));
    const sig = mk && mk.p < 0.05 ? "statistically significant" : "not statistically significant";
    const cap = plot.append("div").style("font-size", "0.85rem").style("color", "#334155").style("margin-top", "0.6rem").style("line-height", "1.5");
    cap.append("span").style("font-weight", "700").text(`Trend in semiconductor intensity (per 10k postings, reliable months only): ${dir || "n/a"} and ${sig}. `);
    if (mk && fit) cap.append("span").html(
      `Mann–Kendall &tau; = ${mk.tau.toFixed(2)} (p = ${mk.p.toFixed(2)}); OLS slope = ${fit.slope >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${fit.slope.toFixed(1)} per 10k per month; `
      + `mean ≈ ${meanShare.toFixed(0)} per 10k (≈ ${(meanShare / 100).toFixed(2)}% of postings); `
      + `${pctChange == null ? "" : (pctChange >= 0 ? "+" : "") + pctChange.toFixed(0) + "% comparing the first and last quarters."}`);
    plot.append("div").style("font-size", "0.78rem").style("color", "#94a3b8").style("margin-top", "0.25rem")
      .html("The series now extends to April 2026. <span style=\"color:#b45309;font-weight:600\">✳ February 2026</span> is shown for completeness only: owing to the timing of data collection that month is only partially covered, so its value is unreliable and is bridged with a dashed line. Trend statistics use reliable months only.");
  }

  render();
  return wrap.node();
}
```

::::

### Case study: artificial intelligence

We repeat the exercise for artificial intelligence, this time drawing on ESCO
**skills** (e.g. *utilise machine learning*, *develop computer vision system*,
*perform data mining*) and **knowledge** concepts (e.g. *principles of artificial
intelligence*, *machine learning*, *deep learning*, *natural language processing*).
The concepts are grouped into six families — general AI, machine learning & neural
networks, natural language & speech, computer vision, data mining & predictive
analytics, and robotics & automation — and the coloured dots throughout this
section encode that family (see the legend). The toggle switches between the raw
number of AI postings, postings per 100,000 labour force, and the share of all
postings; click any country to open a breakdown of which AI concepts drive its
demand.

::: {.section-card}
